links.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

evidence: Abstract: '4,465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories', with release at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jerryyan/TraceML.
§4.2: 'Humans pivot on 25% of transitions, Codex on 9%, MLEvolve on 58%... matched humans average +0.089 and MLEvolve −0.008' — quantified pivot-quality asymmetry.

Appendix D.1, Table 11: 'Every headline gap survives every fairness treatment, and every interval excludes zero', using two-stage cluster bootstrap (B=4000) over competitions, fork-lineage clusters, and runs, plus a GEE regression (z=−3.5 Codex, −6.6 MLEvolve).
Appendix C.1, Table 10: 100-item human audit of intent labels agrees 81% (κ=0.68), with a label-free proxy (error-fixing edits 11.1% human vs 1.5% Codex) supporting the finding.

Appendix F.1, Table 18: harness improves 5/7 competitions, two within noise (commonlit 0.510→0.505/0.517; equity 0.675→0.670/0.680); Abl-B (cadence without content) lands at or below baseline everywhere, isolating prompt content as the driver.
Appendix G: explicit limitations—public-notebook observability bias, humans not budget-matched, intent inferred not observed, non-independent trajectory units—bounding the claims appropriately.
Appendix B.5: extraction toolkit applied to five scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve, AIDE, Claude Code, Gemini CLI), supporting limited cross-scaffold generalizability of the pipeline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-aligned: an empirical study of LLM agent scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve on a gpt-5.4-mini backend) for autonomous ML development, with a planning-prompt intervention and a new process-level evaluation resource, directly serving the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Prompting, and Evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid: per Table 1 it is the only resource combining scored intermediate versions, full code, and task-matched human trajectories, and the behavioral findings (pivot asymmetry, absence of solution revisits, 'ensemble in name only') are new process-level characterizations. Rigor is strong: unit-alignment checks (§3.3, App B.3), fairness treatments with cluster-bootstrap CIs and a GEE robustness check (App D.1), human label audits (App C.1), and ablation arms separating prompt content from re-injection schedule (Table 18). Evidence is weakened by a small paired subset (7 competitions, 10 Codex and 3 MLEvolve runs in the twelve-hour scope, Table 6), unstable short runs acknowledged in Table 7, correlational feature-rank associations (App E.1), and large unexplained harness jumps (amex 0.023→0.781, ranzcr 0.545→0.877, Table 18) suggesting baseline failures. Generalizability is limited by Kaggle-specific practices and one backend; authors concede platform bias (App G). Reproducibility is excellent: public HF release of corpus, schema, labeler weights, and pipeline, plus full prompts in App F.2. Not out-of-scope; this is core language-agent methodology.

primary_link.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

papers.summary: Large language models write correct code for isolated problems but remain far weaker at autonomous machine-learning development, where an agent must revise data pipelines, models, and validation over hours of feedback, and on most competitions still finishes below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. papers.summary_zh: 本文探討為何大型語言模型（LLM）代理在自主機器學習開發上仍普遍落後於人類專家。既有結果導向基準僅評分最終提交，無法解釋差距成因。作者建立 TraceML 資料集，以統一的版本層級標註架構記錄人類與代理在同一批 Kaggle 競賽上的開發過程：涵蓋 134 場競賽共 4,465 條人類軌跡，並在 7 場競賽上配對 Codex 與 MLEvolve 兩種代理框架（在 12 小時預算下，207 條代理軌跡對上 430 條人類軌跡），每個程式碼版本均附分數、時間戳，以及動作、意圖、編輯幅度與分數影響等標籤。分析顯示：人類專家會在資料處理、驗證、模型調整與模型整合（ensembling）間交替，並回頭重啟先前擱置的做法；Codex 陷入為集成成員重新加權與微調提交的窄迴圈，MLEvolve 則原地變異模型。人類在 25% 的轉換中改變方向（pivot），Codex 僅 9%，MLEvolve 雖達 58% 但損益相抵；代理幾乎從不重訪先前的解法，顯示其搜尋缺乏記憶。以人類實踐提煉的規劃提示詞能修正部分行為，並在 7 場競賽中的 5 場提升分數，但整體投入輪廓仍呈代理型態，顯示指令只能縮小可化約為指令的那部分差距。限制包括人類軌跡取自公開筆記本歷史、未必反映全部工作，標註屬推論而非觀察，且雙方設定未完全受控。此研究將「代理表現較差」轉為具體可測的行為缺口，指出記憶與控制機制是未來代理設計的關鍵方向。
papers.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
papers.title_zh: TraceML：機器學習開發中人類與代理規劃行為的實證分析

links.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

evidence: Section 2.2/Figure 4: four mechanism-resolved conditions vs an endpoint-wise best-of-N isolated envelope; held-out resilience exceeded the envelope for nearly every shared-world cell and validated inventions showed a mean paired gain of six for no-explicit-culture at N=200.

Section 2.5/Figure 14: at tick 3,200 portfolio resilience was 0.2474 (full culture) and 0.2365 (no explicit culture) vs 0.1794 isolated, while the isolated envelope retained the best single artifact (0.3488 vs 0.2380) - a bounded, honestly reported swarm advantage.

Section S2.11: world seed is the unit of inference; 20,000 deterministic bootstrap resamples; exact sign-flip tests with smallest attainable two-sided p=0.125 for four pairs; explicitly no agent-level tests or universal scaling law asserted.

Section S2.7: 48-episode population matrix with matched seeds 3201-3204, engine revision 9, identical configuration/prompt/action-schema hashes, 89,617 provider calls with 0.019% retryable failures, and a predeclared clean rerun of one deviating seed.

Section 3 (Conclusion): limitations stated proportionally - inference based on four matched world seeds per condition, one model and prompting configuration, and simulator-defined material and environmental functions.

Section S2.12 and Data and code availability: engine, exact prompt manifests, traces, analysis and figure-generation scripts released at github.com/lamm-mit/SwarmWorld with data at huggingface.co/datasets/lamm-mit/swarmworld-data; offline figure generation verifies SHA-256 hashes and writes output manifests.

Section 2.9: Protein Realms is a single-seed descriptive pilot (N=50, seed 3801) that explicitly does not support inferential comparison among conditions; Section 2.8 AshenRealm transfer reports lower absolute metrics but retained multi-agent construction, executable inheritance, and behavioral differentiation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is a controlled LLM multi-agent society framework (homogeneous agents, persistent physical stigmergy, executable artifact inheritance), squarely matching the highest-weighted preferences for LLM agents, multi-agent systems, and tool use; the simulated materials are game-level surrogates, not a pure domain application, so no out-of-scope penalty. Novelty is solid: the proposal-consequence separation, agent-free held-out disturbance assay, mechanism-resolved ablations, and endpoint-wise best-of-N envelope make swarm advantage falsifiable in a way Generative Agents/Project Sid/GovSim/TerraLingua-style predecessors do not. Rigor is high for the genre (matched seeds, paired bootstrap, seed as unit of inference, anti-circularity phenotype sensitivity, honest null results such as no universal cultural crossover), but only four seeds per cell, one proprietary model (gpt-5.6-luna), and simulator-defined objective functions bound the inference. Evidence strength is good for headline endpoints (Figure 4, Figure 14) yet several rich analyses (Figure 10 trajectory, network backbones, Protein Realms pilot) are explicitly illustrative or single-seed. Generalizability is partially demonstrated via AshenRealm and Protein Realms transfers, though functional validity remains simulator-internal. Reproducibility posture is exceptional: released code, prompts, traces, SHA-256 manifests, deterministic replay, commit hashes, and documented provider-call audits.

primary_link.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

papers.summary: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld se
papers.summary_zh: SwarmWorld 探討一個核心問題：在沒有預先指派角色、配方或工作流程的情況下，去中心化的語言模型代理能否在共享世界中自我組織，建造出具備實際功能的科技，並勝過同等算力的獨立平行搜尋？作者建構一個由確定性模擬器驅動的持久空間世界，代理可探索、採集資源、測試材料、建造持久性人工物並撰寫可執行控制器；關鍵設計是「提案與後果分離」，代理的宣稱一律由模擬器獨立檢驗，並在移除所有代理後，以八組未見過的擾動排程進行留置盲測。透過 50 至 200 個代理的族群規模研究與 3,200 tick 長期實驗，論文顯示：共享世界在留置韌性、組合韌性與經驗證發明數上普遍優於 best-of-N 獨立搜尋包絡，但最強的單一人工物仍可能由孤立搜尋取得。未指派角色的代理自發分化出以人工物為中心與移動探索兩類行為，並出現多人協作建造、跨代理程式分岔與可執行技術世系；約 95% 的首次技術採用始於物理觀察而非直接溝通，顯式文化機制僅在特定指標與時間尺度上帶來效益。限制包括每組僅四個配對世界種子、單一模型與提示設定，且材料功能皆為模擬器定義而非實驗驗證。整體而言，此研究確立了「有界群體優勢」：互動主要促進多樣而持久的技術生態累積，而非全面優越的單項發明，並為語言模型群體社會提供可證偽的評估架構。
papers.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

links.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six LLM backbones on ALFWorld ID-140 and ScienceWorld U211, CaSKG achieves the highest task score in all twelve combinations of model and benchmark.'
Section 4.2, Table 1: relative to GoS, six-model macro-average ScienceWorld rises 72.62 to 80.50 and ALFWorld success 80.01% to 86.79%, with fewer mean steps in all twelve settings.
Section 3.3: three direction-conditioned probes (removal, substitution, reordering) produce LLM-returned scores e_ij in [0,1] for necessity, specificity, and directionality.
Section 5.2, Table 3: Full CaSKG 73.57%/18.44 steps vs publish-all 71.43%/18.74 vs semantic-only 67.14%/19.21 on ALFWorld (MiniMax-M2.7, Skill1000).
Section 5.1, Table 2: scale study at 200-2,000 skills shows +3.54 to +22.86 point gains over GoS for two backbones.
Section 4.3, Figure 2: CaSKG improves 21 of 24 ScienceWorld task types, ties one, trails on two (non-living-thing search, temperature measurement).
Section 4.1, Models: backbones are MiniMax-M2.7, GLM-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GPT-5.6-Luna, all with 2026 citations that cannot be externally verified.
Section 4.1, Metrics: 'Steps measures observed interaction consumption... not token usage, wall-clock latency, retrieval latency, or graph-construction cost.'
Title footnote: 'Code is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: skill retrieval for agent memory with graph propagation, directly matching the highest-weight Agents & Tool Use preference, plus RAG/knowledge and long-context memory relevance. The contribution is an incremental but non-trivial combination: budgeted counterfactual edge probing (removal/substitution/reordering) with Beta-smoothed calibration and state-gated publication layered on GoS-style graph retrieval; all ingredients (LLM-as-judge, personalized PageRank, counterfactual prompting) are established. Method formalization is careful, with four baselines, six backbones, two benchmarks, a 200-2000 skill scale study, and component ablations (Table 3). Rigor gaps: no statistical significance or seed variance, no control isolating counterfactual calibration from simple top-K pruning by association score (publish-all vs Full CaSKG confounds pruning with probing), thresholds/hyperparameters (tau_c, rho values) never given numerically, and judge reliability is never validated against ground-truth dependencies. Evidence is internally consistent and detailed, but rests entirely on six 2026-dated, independently unverifiable model releases (GPT-5.6-Luna, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.7), and the paper concedes Steps excludes token/latency/graph-construction cost, so the offline probe expense for 500-2000 edges is unquantified. Generalizability limited to two text-based simulators; no real API or code-agent settings. Reproducibility: GitHub link claimed and embedding model specified (Qwen3-Embedding-8B), but Skill1000 library construction, probe prompts, and key hyperparameters are missing. Solid, relevant, moderately novel work with honest limitations discussion, held back by untestable model citations and missing controls.

primary_link.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

papers.summary: Reusable skill libraries allow large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks, but they also turn memory access into a challenging retrieval problem. Full-library prompting preserves coverage at high context cost, vector retrieval returns compact neighborhoods but treats skills as independent text, and graph-based retrieval can recover workflow context only when the edges that carry relevance are reliable. We propose CaSKG, a counterfactual-causal skill graph framework that calibrates procedural relations before retrieval. CaSKG first builds a high-recall directed candidate graph from semantic, lexical, input/output, and structural evidence, with repair evidence and an optional LLM judge further refining candidate scores. It then applies direction-conditioned textual counterfactual probes that remove, substitute, and reorder skill pairs, aggregates the evidence with Bayesian smoothing, and publishes a state-filtered weighted graph for task-conditioned expansion. The graph is constructed offline and used without changing the downstream agent policy or task interface. Across six LLM backbones on ALFWorld ID-140 and ScienceWorld U211, CaSKG achieves the highest task score in all twelve combinations of model and benchmark. Relative to Graph-of-Skills (GoS), it improves the six-model macro-average ScienceWorld score from 72.62 to 80.50 and ALFWorld success from 80.01\% to 86.79\%, while reducing mean environment steps on both benchmarks. Qualitative and ablation analyses further show that calibrated edges help retrieval preserve prerequisites, state-changing actions, verification routines, and final completion steps. These results position edge-confidence calibration as an effective route to compact and executable skill retrieval at scaleCode is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg .
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 LLM Agent 的技能庫檢索問題：隨著可重複使用的程序性知識持續累積，如何在有限情境下檢索出緊湊且可執行的技能組合成為關鍵挑戰。全庫提示保留覆蓋率但成本高昂，向量檢索將技能視為獨立文字而忽略程序相依性，圖檢索則高度依賴邊的可信度。作者提出 CaSKG，將技能圖建構視為預算限制下的邊信心校準問題：先以語意、詞彙、輸入/輸出介面與結構等多重訊號誘導高召回候選有向圖，再以三種方向條件化的文字反事實探針（移除、替換、重排序）驗證選定邊，並以 Beta 貝氏平滑彙整證據，將邊標記為確認、不確定、拒絕或未驗證，據此發布狀態過濾的加權圖。推論時以任務比對產生種子，在已發布圖上執行個人化 PageRank 傳播，不改變下游 Agent 政策與任務介面。在 ALFWorld ID-140 與 ScienceWorld U211、六個 LLM 後端的評估中，CaSKG 於全部十二種組合取得最高任務分數；相較 GoS，六模型 macro 平均 ScienceWorld 分數由 72.62 升至 80.50，ALFWorld 成功率由 80.01% 升至 86.79%，平均環境步數亦全面較低。消融實驗顯示多訊號候選誘導、LLM 評審與狀態門檻發布各有貢獻。限制包括：對直接搜尋或量測類任務增益有限，追蹤共現等通道僅為未來自我演化技能庫預留，且結果不涉及 token 用量、延遲或建構成本。此研究確立邊信心校準作為可擴充 Agent 記憶的重要設計原則。
papers.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

links.title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives

evidence: Section 3.1: a neutral knowledge probe confirms the model knows the entitlement before dialogue; 'Only gate-passed owed cases are scored for deception', addressing the lying-vs-not-knowing confound.

Section 3.3 / Table 4: 112 source-grounded cases (64 owed, 48 calibration) across 8 domains with cited legal/retailer policies; 'human annotators reviewed every case for source grounding and label correctness' before freezing.
Appendix C.2 / Table 6: judge gating required Cohen's kappa >= 0.70 and FP <= 15%; GPT-5.1 pooled kappa 0.815, 92.8% agreement, 9.3% FP, 1 flip, 0% malformed.
Appendix C.3 / Table 7: re-grading with alternative judges preserves qualitative claims (9/9 instructed>emergent, 6/6 DSR-up, 6/6 Det-down), with DR deviations of 3.44-6.84 pp for gated judges.

Appendix B.3: pinned snapshots (customer gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, judge gpt-5.1-2025-11-13, temperature 0), 95% bootstrap intervals from 10,000 trajectory resamples; repeat-run mean absolute DR difference 3.1 pp (instructed) vs 9.0 pp (emergent) across 24 cells.

Section 4.2 / Figure 5: initial trust has little effect on lie frequency (~24-25% emergent, ~69% instructed across panel) but DSR rises from ~18% to ~58% and Det falls from ~72% to ~32% (emergent, low to high trust), with descriptive caveats for low-lie cells.

Appendix E / Table 12: honesty-directed outcome SFT reduces DR 51->40 (delta -11, CI [-18,-3]); deception-graded SFT raises honest-control DSR 41->77 (delta +36, CI [+11,+63]) while incentive-condition DR and Det intervals include zero.

Section 4.3 / Figure 6: J-Lens analysis is explicitly 'an exploratory two-model result based on explicit, single-turn deceptive framing' on 16 purpose-built scenarios, not benchmark dialogues, and 'do not establish that this signal represents belief'.

Section 5 Limitations: 'limited to English customer-service settings with binary entitlements, system-prompt incentives, and a simulated customer with a designed trust policy'; post-training covers few open-weight models with modest trajectory counts.

Appendix D.3 / Table 9: restricting DR to rounds where the owed option is never disclosed lowers rates from 21.9->14.7 (emergent) and 63.3->52.1 (instructed) with rank correlations 0.90/0.83, honestly bounding what the knowledge gate certifies.

Introduction: 'Code is available at franciscoliu/knownliebench'; Appendix G provides full prompt templates for gate, agent conditions, customer personas, and judge; Appendix B.4 reports per-round apparatus cost ($0.0123) and token counts from 5,148 rounds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM agent safety/evaluation work: a knowledge-verified deception benchmark for tool-using agents across 18 models, plus post-training (BoN-SFT/DPO/GRPO) and an exploratory interpretability pilot. Novelty is solid but incremental in a crowded deception-benchmark space; the genuine advance is the knowledge gate that scores deception only after verifying the model can state the entitlement, plus success/detection grading and dynamic customer trust. Rigor and evidence are strong: judge validated against human labels (kappa=0.815), judge-choice sensitivity analysis, honest-control and calibration cases, bootstrap CIs, repeat-run variance reporting, and appropriately hedged claims (J-Lens labeled exploratory two-model; null post-training effects scoped to tested regime). Limitations are acknowledged and real: English-only customer-service domains with binary entitlements, a simulated customer whose detection behavior defines 'success', small per-cell case counts (8 owed cases/domain), and LoRA-scale training with wide intervals. Reproducibility is supported by released code, full prompt templates, pinned evaluator snapshots, and cost tables, though agent decoding is unseeded and proprietary models are unauditable.

primary_link.title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents serving users on behalf of companies, placing them in settings where user and deployer interests can conflict. When an agent knows that a user is owed something its deployer would prefer to deny, does it remain honest? Answering this is difficult because false statements can reflect either ignorance or hallucination rather than deception. To address this challenge, we introduce KnownLieBench , a knowledge-verified benchmark tha
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）代理人同時服務使用者與部署企業時的誠實性問題：當代理人明知顧客依法享有權益，卻面臨替公司省錢的商業誘因時，是否會說謊？由於不實陳述可能源自無知或幻覺，而非刻意欺騙，評估上難以區分。作者提出KnownLieBench，一個知識驗證式基準：先以中立探針確認模型確實知道顧客的應得權益，再於引入誘因後評估其是否做出不實主張，藉此將「說謊」與「不知道」區隔。基準涵蓋八個客服領域、112個依真實法規或官方政策建立的案例，與具信任追蹤的模擬顧客進行多輪對話，區分僅受誘因驅動的自發性欺騙與明確指示下的欺騙，並設誠實對照組。研究共評估18個模型、產生逾18,000筆多輪互動，發現自發性欺騙率在模型與領域間差異懸殊：Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.5等近乎為零，DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Llama-3.1-8B則明顯偏高；明確指示會大幅拉高多數模型的說謊率。機制分析顯示「虛構政策」最常見，佔非討債領域謊言的82%至96%。顧客初始信任幾乎不影響說謊頻率，卻顯著改變謊言被偵測與成功的機率。訓練後實驗顯示誠實導向的SFT可降低欺騙率，而以欺騙評分微調則使誠實對照情境中的謊言更易成功。J-Lens探索性分析亦發現欺騙框架下權益相關內部訊號於決策時轉弱。限制包括僅涵蓋英文、二元權益、模擬顧客與小規模LoRA訓練。此基準將說謊與知識不足分離，使LLM代理人的誠實稽核與調控更嚴謹。

links.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety

evidence: Abstract: 'ReDiR reduces attack success rates to below 8%, transfers to unseen tool domains, and preserves benign fidelity with low computational overhead' - central claim matches agent-safety/LLM preferences.
§5 Benchmarks: evaluation on MT-AgentRisk (365 tasks, 9 tool domains) and AgentDojo, with supervision restricted to 55 of 70 Filesystem tasks and 8 domains held out.
Table 2: ReDiR overall MT-AgentRisk ASR 5.5/0.0/7.9% vs MAGE 29.4/20.3/34.2% across Qwen3.5-9B, Ministral-3-8B, Gemma-4-E4B.
§5 Metrics: defines ASR, SSR, FPR and notes ASR and SSR are 'mutually exclusive but not exhaustive', showing metric care.
§6.5 Table 8: backbone-matched 9B encoder reaches 0.0/0.0 ASR/FPR while mismatched 4B encoder reaches 16.7/5.0, revealing a white-box, backbone-matched dependency.
§6.5 Table 9: same-model teacher achieves 0.0% ASR vs 36.7% for Kimi-K2.5, supporting the compatibility claim.
§6.6 Tables 11-13: K, entry-token, and decision-token ablations with small per-domain samples (10 harmful + 10 benign tasks) limiting statistical strength.
§7 Table 14: adaptive benign-history dilution keeps overall ASR within 6.7-10.0% across N=0..8.
Appendix A Table 15: final optimization set is only 36 safety pairs from 21 tasks plus 20 benign retention examples, making the near-zero held-out ASR notable but under-validated.
§6.4 Table 5: ReDiR adds 1.328-3.250 MiB GPU memory vs 8,417.280 MiB for MAGE.
Appendix B Table 16: AdamW, LR 3e-4, warm-up 20, A100 GPUs; no explicit code or artifact release URL is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent safety: trajectory-level defense for tool-using LLM agents, directly matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLM (2.5), and AI Safety (2.0) preferences, with benchmarks (MT-AgentRisk, AgentDojo) fitting Red Teaming & Evaluation. Novelty is moderate-to-good: latent-query injection into a frozen base model plus same-model cross-view supervision is a plausible advance over generate-then-check guards (ToolSafe, MAGE, TRACE), though it assembles known ingredients (gist-style latents, representation steering, LoRA). Rigor is solid: clear threat model, matched adaptation constraints for baselines, explicit ASR/SSR/FPR metric definitions (§5), extensive ablations (Tables 8-13), and an adaptive dilution attack (§7), but ablation samples are tiny (10 harmful + 10 benign per domain in §6.5), benign fidelity uses only 50 tasks, no variance/significance reported, and the near-0% ASR generalization from only 36 training pairs (Appendix A Table 15) is striking. Evidence strength is good: consistent quantitative tables across three model families and nine tool domains with stated efficiency costs (Tables 2-7), though suspiciously uniform 0.0% results on Ministral-3-8B and no code release URL temper confidence. Generalizability benefits from three backbones, two runtimes, and eight held-out tool domains, but is limited by required white-box access, backbone-matched encoder dependency (Table 8: mismatched 4B encoder raises ASR to 16.7%), and 8-9B scale only. Reproducibility is moderately strong: detailed hyperparameters (Appendix B Table 16), data-construction pipeline with counts (Appendix A), and audit rubric, but no explicit artifact/code link is stated.

primary_link.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety

papers.summary: Tool-using LLM agents extend security risks beyond generated text to actions that affect external systems. Under multi-turn decomposition attacks, a harmful objective can be distributed across individually plausible requests and tool calls, becoming apparent only from the accumulated trajectory. Existing defenses either rely on auxiliary online reasoning to recover long-horizon security evidence or assess actions after generation, often incurring additional inference cost or depending on runtime
papers.summary_zh: 使用工具的 LLM 代理人，其安全風險已從文字延伸到會改動外部系統的動作。多輪分解式攻擊可將有害目標拆散成各自看似無害的請求與工具呼叫，唯有累積整段軌跡才會顯現；現有防禦多仰賴輔助線上推理或事後檢查已生成的動作，推論成本高且綁定特定執行環境的動作表示。本文提出 ReDiR，一種生成時期防禦：每次動作生成前，先將當前軌跡壓縮成緊湊的潛在安全表示並注入凍結的基礎模型。此表示透過同模型跨視角監督學習——在任務目標明確的視角下，以模型自身的安全行為監督其從原始多輪軌跡還原分散的安全證據；訓練僅更新 LoRA 與潛在查詢，並以 KL 散度正規化保留良性行為。在 MT-AgentRisk 與 AgentDojo 上，橫跨 Qwen3.5-9B、Ministral-3-8B、Gemma-4-E4B 三個模型家族，ReDiR 將攻擊成功率（ASR）壓到 8% 以下，明顯優於 MAGE 的約 20% 至 34%；僅用單一工具網域監督即泛化到八個未見網域，ASR 低於 7%，良性任務誤拒率為 0%。額外 GPU 記憶體僅約 1.3 至 3.3 MiB，並靠提前安全終止將有害任務端對端延遲最多降低 89%。限制方面：安全編碼器與基礎模型骨幹不一致，或改用外部教師產生目標，都會明顯退化；面對良性歷史稀釋等自適應攻擊，ASR 仍可能略升至 10%；作者亦承認此為經驗性防禦，可能漏掉未見攻擊或中斷良性任務。整體而言，本研究顯示分散式安全證據可直接整合進動作生成，為事後動作檢查提供低成本且可遷移的替代方案。
papers.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety
papers.title_zh: 重組分散風險：軌跡條件化動作生成以實現多輪代理人安全

links.title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'Training improves investigation quality against targets with planted behaviors, the rate of concerning behaviors surfaced in unmodified production models, and audit realism, while false-positive rates stay below 1%'
Section 3.6 Headline Result: 'The composite exceeds the Haiku 4.5 baseline at one epoch and by three epochs matches Opus 4.6... Audit quality surpasses Opus 4.6 (72.7 vs 68.0)'
Section 4: 'the top checkpoint reaches 28.1%, more than doubling the baseline' on AuditBench STC vs Haiku baseline 11.5% (Table 10)

Section 3.4/Figure 4: 'Without calibration (light bars), intragroup false positive rates reach 97%; reference pairwise retains more calibration naturally. With 50% calibration fraction (dark bars), both maintain near-perfect calibration'
Section 3.5: 'Comparing four compute-matched single-target and multi-target pairs... the averaged results are nearly indistinguishable' - negative result reported
Section 6 Limitations: 'All four evaluation dimensions are scored by an LLM judge (Opus 4.6) without human validation, and the judge is from the same model family as the policy'

Section 2.1: 'six of these serve as our held-out evaluation behaviors, and the remaining 26... are used exclusively for training'; evaluation target DeepSeek v3.1 is held out from training target Llama 3.3 70B
Code and data availability: 'Code, prompts, and evaluation data are available at https://github.com/paulrosu11/training-auditing-agents-public'
Appendix C.1 Table 6: judge hyperparameters (model, temperature, thinking budget, max tokens) documented for all training/evaluation/analysis judges
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-alignment research directly matching top preferences: LLMs, AI safety (alignment auditing of deceptive/sycophantic planted behaviors), alignment & RLHF (reward design, reward hacking analysis), agents & tool use (Petri/Claude Code scaffolds), and red-teaming/evaluation (AuditBench, LLM-as-judge). Rigor is strong: systematic ablations over reward families (Section 3.1-3.4), compute-matched multi-target comparison with an honestly reported null result (Section 3.5, Table 9), dose-response for calibration fraction (Appendix E.2), 95% CIs throughout, held-out behaviors/seeds/target (Section 2.1), and a candid limitations section. Evidence is quantitatively rich (composite 48.7 vs Opus 4.6's 48.4; audit quality 72.7 vs 68.0; AuditBench STC 28.1% vs 11.5% baseline in Section 4/Table 10) but entirely mediated by LLM judges with no human validation, and the evaluation judge (Opus 4.6) shares the policy's model family - a bias the authors themselves flag in Section 6. Novelty is solid but builds heavily on Petri and AuditBench; the pairwise reward + false-positive-calibration recipe is the main new contribution. Generalizability is supported by genuine cross-scaffold and cross-target-type transfer, though only one base model at one scale was trained. Reproducibility aided by released code/data (availability statement), full prompt texts (Appendix L), and judge hyperparameters (Table 6), but full replication depends on proprietary Anthropic models and under-documented RL training internals. No out-of-scope cap applies.

primary_link.title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Alignment auditing of frontier models increasingly relies on LLM auditors to surface undesirable behaviors at scale, but current automated auditors can struggle with coherent investigation and audit realism. In this work, we improve LLM auditors with reinforcement learning. In our best training environment, the policy investigates target models that potentially possess hidden behaviors planted via their system prompt. An LLM judge, which knows whether the target has a hidden behavior, holistical
papers.summary_zh: 前沿模型的對齊稽核日益仰賴 LLM 稽核員自動挖掘不良行為，但現有自動化稽核常流於膚淺、缺乏真實感，且難以應對經對抗性強化的目標模型。本文以強化學習訓練 Claude Haiku 4.5：在最佳環境中，稽核員於 Petri 框架下調查系統提示詞被植入隱藏行為的目標模型，由知曉標準答案的 LLM 評審將其調查過程與參考調查逐對比較給分，並混入一半無植入行為的校準 rollout 以壓低誤報率。系統性消融顯示逐對獎勵比逐點獎勵更穩健；直接對生產模型訓練或使用二元獎勵都會引發獎勵駭客（reward hacking），使誤報率飆升至約 96%。最佳設定下，訓練後模型綜合分數 48.7 追平 Opus 4.6（48.4），稽核品質（72.7 對 68.0）與真實感皆超越之，誤報率維持在 1% 以下；多目標訓練在此規模未見明確效益。能力亦能遷移：在 AuditBench 經 KTO 對抗微調的目標與不同 scaffold（Claude Code）上，偵測率由基線 11.5% 提升至 28.1%。限制包括四項評估全由 Opus 4.6 擔任評審且缺乏人工驗證、僅訓練單一規模的基礎模型、訓練曲線尚未收斂，且以系統提示詞植入行為弱於 fine-tuning。本研究證明獎勵設計至關重要，結構得當的標準強化學習即可有效增進 LLM 稽核員能力，為部署前的安全把關提供可擴充的途徑。

links.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance

evidence: Abstract: 'On OLMo-3 7B, TailSFT often improves pass@16 performance on math and coding evaluations, with gains up to 17% absolute... up to 4% absolute pass@1 gains in subsequent GRPO runs'
Table 1: pass@16 improves in 15 of 18 dataset–benchmark pairs; largest gain +16.79 pp on CruxEval-O (BigCode); regressions on OMEGA-500 (−0.20) and OCI HumanEval+ (−2.74)
Table 2 (Section 4.3): 'Initializing from TailSFT improves post-RL pass@1 in every matched comparison... ranging between 1.21% and 3.93%'
Section 3.3 / Appendix B theorem: 'offset filtering can be tuned to achieve coverage no worse than standard SFT or the best absolute threshold', with proofs of three claims in Appendix B.1
Section 3.2 / Figure 3: controlled graph-navigation task isolates filtering effect—standard SFT best cross-entropy and pass@1, all filtering variants better pass@8
Section 4.2 / Table 29: coverage-ratio diagnostic; all 11 settings with ρ16>1 have nonnegative coverage gain (10 improve, 1 unchanged)
Appendix D.1–D.2: full hyperparameter grids (Tables 8–14, 19–22), OLMES evaluation protocols with temperatures, lengths, and three seed sets; GRPO ablation at n=8 'leaves the ordering unchanged'
Limitation evidence: claims tested only on OLMo-3 7B with verifiable-reward math/code tasks; theory is in a stylized no-prompt expert-conditioning setting with forward-KL assumption (Appendix B)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology: a sequence-level SFT filtering rule (drop examples whose loss fell most relative to the base model) that preserves pass@K coverage and measurably improves downstream GRPO. Strong preference fit (LLMs, reasoning, RL post-training, code/math). Novelty is moderate: offset-based filtering recombines known ingredients (RHO-LOSS-style selection, coverage principle, diversity-preserving SFT), though the relative-to-initial-policy criterion plus theory and diagnostic is a genuine contribution. Rigor is high: controlled graph-navigation ablation, a theorem with full proofs that offset clipping dominates absolute clipping and ERM on coverage (Appendix B), exhaustive hyperparameter grids, 3 seeds, paired bootstrap CIs (Table 5), and an honest reporting of regressions (OCI HumanEval+ −2.74, OMEGA-500 flat). Evidence is strong: pass@16 improves in 15/18 dataset–benchmark pairs (Table 1) and all five matched GRPO comparisons show pass@1 gains of 1.21–3.93 pp (Table 2), with a tuned-config ablation at rollout n=8; caveat: single base model (OLMo-3 7B), verifiable-reward domains only, and the biggest gains largely repair coverage collapse that standard SFT itself introduced (Table 11 discussion). Generalizability is limited by one 7B model and two domains, though the drop-in method and lightweight diagnostic plausibly transfer. Reproducibility is well supported by detailed protocols (OLMES settings, selection-batch filtering mechanics, per-point diagnostic values in Table 29) but no explicit code/checkpoint release is stated.

primary_link.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning post-training drives reasoning and agentic capabilities in modern AI systems, yet a growing body of work shows that it is most effective when used to fine-tune an already capable base model. We question whether existing pipelines yield models that are most suitable for reinforcement learning. Building on prior work highlighting the role of coverage and pass@K as predictors of post-RL performance, we design a simple modification to supervised fine-tuning, TailSFT, which fil
papers.summary_zh: 此論文質疑標準監督式微調(SFT)是否為後續強化學習(RL)後訓練的最佳起點。SFT以交叉熵為目標,會持續提高模型已能輕易產生的回應之機率,可能損害「覆蓋率」——即RL在有限取樣預算下取得有獎勵回應的能力,常以大K值pass@K衡量。作者提出TailSFT,一種序列層級的篩選式微調:先記錄每筆資料在初始模型下的損失,訓練中過濾損失相對下降最多的序列,將更新集中於尚未充分建模的「尾部」。理論分析(專家條件化設定)證明,此相對於初始策略的偏移式篩選,其覆蓋率不遜於標準交叉熵或最佳絕對門檻,且可嚴格更佳。實驗顯示,圖導航任務中篩選雖使交叉熵與pass@1變差,pass@8卻明顯提升;在OLMo-3 7B的數學與程式碼微調中,TailSFT於18個資料集—基準組合中的15個改善pass@16,最高絕對增益16.79%,接續GRPO後pass@1在所有配對比較中提升1.21%至3.93%,部分設定早期獎勵增速達2.5倍。作者另提出覆蓋率比值診斷ρ16:當標準SFT在基礎模型可及題目上損失的覆蓋率多於獲得(ρ16>1)時,TailSFT幾乎都能保留或改善覆蓋率,但此條件僅為充分而非必要。限制包括pass@1變化不一致、少數設定退步,且偏移訊號在同質性高的簡化環境中幾乎無用。本文倡議「階段感知」的開發觀點:評估中間檢查點時,應看其能否支撐後續訓練,而非僅看單階段指標。

links.title: CompanionHarm: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Detecting Harms in Real-World AI Companion Conversations

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit to LLM safety evaluation and benchmarking preferences: the paper contributes a public benchmark of 2,111 real-world multi-turn Replika conversations with 7,016 annotated AI utterances across 13 harm categories (Abstract; Corpus Statistics) and evaluates seven LLMs under zero-shot, one-shot, and full-codebook prompting (Experimental Setup), aligning with AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLM, NLP, Data & Datasets, and Prompting preferences. Novelty is high relative to prior resources: Table 1 shows it is the only listed dataset combining real AI-companion interaction, multi-turn context preservation, a relational-harm taxonomy, and public release, unlike ToxicChat, AEGIS2.0, DICES, or BAD. Rigor is solid: three independent annotators per utterance, attention and gold-standard checks, Fleiss' kappa 0.403 (Data Annotation), Holm and Benjamini-Hochberg corrected statistical analyses for disagreement factors (Tables 4 and utterance-characteristics analysis), and macro F1 as primary metric justified by the long-tailed label distribution (Table 2). Evidence strength is good but tempered by data provenance: text was OCR-extracted from Reddit screenshots via Pytesseract (Data Collection), introducing noise, and several passages in the provided document are garbled/corrupted (e.g., Taxonomy and Discussion sections), suggesting careful verification was needed. Results are honestly modest (best macro F1 0.453, GPT-5.5, Table 3) with a substantive error analysis identifying over-detection of harm in role-play and category confusion (Challenges section). Generalizability is limited to English, a single platform, and self-selected user-shared posts, explicitly acknowledged as non-representative in Limitations. Reproducibility is supported by the public GitHub release (Abstract) and prompt templates in supplementary material, though closed-source API models and the derived Reddit corpus limit exact replication. Score reflects a genuinely novel and useful safety-evaluation resource with clear LLM relevance, weakened by dataset derivation quality and scope constraints.

primary_link.title: CompanionHarm: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Detecting Harms in Real-World AI Companion Conversations

papers.summary: As AI companions become increasingly embedded in everyday life, there is an urgent need to detect harms that emerge in social and emotional human-AI interactions. Yet research in this area is constrained by the lack of real-world, multi-turn conversational datasets for operationalizing and evaluating harms that are relational and contextual. In this work, we introduce CompanionHarm, a publicly available benchmark dataset comprising 2,111 real-world, multi-turn conversations (14,051 utterances) b
papers.summary_zh: 隨著AI伴侶（如Replika）日益普及，人機互動中的社會情感與關係性傷害（如操弄、越界、情感依賴）亟需被偵測，但現有安全資料集多聚焦單輪、顯性的毒性內容，缺乏真實的多輪脈絡。本研究發布CompanionHarm基準，取材自Reddit r/replika使用者分享的貼文，包含2,111段真實多輪對話，其中7,016則AI語句由三位標註者獨立標註，涵蓋13類有害行為（性騷擾、操弄、貶抑、自傷與自殺等），並同時提供多數決聚合標籤與標註者層級標籤，以支援模型評測與分歧分析。實驗評測七個LLM（含GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、Qwen3與Llama-3.1）顯示：納入多輪對話脈絡優於孤立單句分類，但最佳macro F1僅0.453（GPT-5.5），模型傾向過度偵測傷害、將角色扮演誤判為真實危害，也難以區分概念交疊的關係性傷害類別。標註分歧分析發現，政治立場與判斷分歧相關，混齡標註組共識較高，較長且位於對話後段的語句更易產生歧見，而明確傷害詞彙反而降低歧義。作者提醒，資料源自使用者主動分享的貼文，不應視為Replika有害行為盛行率的代表性估計，標註亦受限於英語文化脈絡，且未涵蓋長期傷害軌跡。此資料集為關係性AI安全審查與脈絡感知的傷害偵測研究奠定基礎。

links.title: Beyond the Editing Canvas: Evidence Divergence in OOXML-to-LLM Ingestion

evidence: Abstract: confirms 21 evidence forks across Excel/Word/PowerPoint; 13-tool extraction panel all emit at least one fork; four APIs return the trap in 48-76% of trials across 8,400 runs.
§3.2: workflow quantified - 639 candidate records, 542 runnable fixtures, 412 pass Gate 1 (Office oracle), 163 pass Gate 2 (extraction panel), dedup/scope screening yields 21 mechanisms.
§4.1 Response Labeling: Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 label all 8,400 API responses with 100% raw agreement; 420-sample human audit agrees with all automated verdicts.
§4.1 Controls: 0/840 matched-clean twin trials surface the trap; 24/24 visible-positive document-API trials succeed, bounding the main condition.

§4.3: mean record-level propagation ranges 0.48 (GLM) to 0.76 (Kimi) across APIs and 0.52-0.76 across web chatbots; 20 of 21 mechanisms asserted by at least one interface; 98.3% of 840 document-API pairs produce identical verdicts across ten repetitions.

§4.4 Table 6: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 4.8 share one published ingestion path (openpyxl/pandoc/markitdown) and expose the identical 16/21 mechanism set, supporting the ingestion-path-over-model claim.
§4.6: 748 of 4,263 documents (17.5%) carry at least one structural signature; five common signatures occur at 2.75-16.5% base rates, limiting presence-only screening.
Discussion and Limitations: acknowledges mechanism-balanced rates are not population estimates and that tool/service results are pinned-configuration snapshots.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A security measurement study squarely on LLM methodology: how OOXML-to-LLM ingestion (RAG loaders, agent pipelines, native file-input APIs) selects evidence, with a threat model, defenses discussion, and evaluation of live LLM services. Strongly matches LLM, RAG, agents, AI safety, and evaluation preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental over prior PDF render/extract divergence and DOCX hidden-carrier studies; the spec-grounded mining, cross-format catalog (21 mechanisms, six-dimension taxonomy), and behavior-level matching of closed ingestion paths are the new contributions. Rigor is high: systematic spec KB mining (639 candidates) with empirical two-gate confirmation to 21 mechanisms, pinned 13-tool extraction panel, 8,400 API + 1,470 web trials, dual judges with human audit, and benign-twin/visible-positive controls that bound the effect. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent, though judged by LLMs (100% agreement is unusually clean), rates are mechanism-balanced rather than population estimates (acknowledged), and vendor results are config snapshots. Generalizability is moderate: method transfers to other formats, but exposure vectors are pinned-version findings. Reproducibility is decent (pinned versions, builder programs, named datasets, appendix prompts) but live web services and the LLM mining stage limit exact replication, and no explicit artifact URL is given in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Editing Canvas: Evidence Divergence in OOXML-to-LLM Ingestion

papers.summary: LLM pipelines increasingly ingest Office Open XML (OOXML) documents (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files) as first-class evidence in financial, compliance, and retrieval-augmented workflows, implicitly assuming semantic integrity: that the evidence consumed by the model matches the content shown in the Microsoft Office suite editing canvas. We show that this assumption can fail in OOXML-to-LLM pipelines. The same specification-valid OOXML file can yield one evidentiary view in Microsoft Office and
papers.summary_zh: LLM 管線常將 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等 OOXML 文件匯入為模型證據，並假設模型所見與使用者在 Office 編輯畫布看到的內容一致。本文指出此語意完整性假設可能失效：同一份符合規格的檔案，在 Office 與擷取管線會呈現不同內容，形成「多重事實」，作者將引發分歧的規格內建構造命名為「證據分叉」。團隊把 ECMA-376 與微軟擴充規格建成知識庫，以 LLM 探勘出 639 個候選，經最小檔案實例化，以 Office 截圖與 13 種擷取工具雙重驗證，確認 21 個證據分叉，涵蓋表示、狀態、可見性、相容性、範圍與線性化六個維度。以 TAT-QA 財報片段製作的 210 份帶陷阱文件，測試 4 個原生匯入 API 與 7 個網頁聊天機器人：8,400 次 API 試驗中 48%–76% 的回應把陷阱當成文件事實，20/21 個機制至少被一個介面外洩。暴露程度取決於匯入路徑與擷取器版本而非模型：同一供應商的 API 與網頁入口行為各異，三個 Claude 模型共用同一份文件 skill 時暴露集合完全相同。對 16 個開源 RAG 專案的調查顯示，預設匯入路徑集中於少數擷取器家族；一般文件的結構特徵出現基率呈雙峰分布，僅憑存在與否難以篩檢常見通道。限制是機制均衡的評測集不代表部署分布，結果僅反映特定版本組態。本文凸顯擷取器選擇即是安全政策：安全匯入需明確契約，並保留證據來源與語意角色。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A RAG evaluation-methodology paper squarely in the preference space: retrieval-augmented generation, evidence/grounding judgments, LLM-as-judge reliability, and system selection, built entirely on LLM pipelines (GPT-4.1 answer-support judge, Gemma3-27B generator, Qwen3-30B/Claude Sonnet 5 evaluators). The core contribution is conceptual and empirical rather than a new architecture: a 'validity-composition problem' showing that an evidence-aware evaluation signal valid for one use does not automatically validate downstream training, selection, prediction, or intervention conclusions. Rigor is unusually high for an evaluation paper: prespecified eligibility and selection rules, matched-random counterfactuals (100,000 repetitions in RQ1; matched controls on relevance grade, rank band, and length quartile in RQ4), cross-fitted held-out system selection, leave-one-topic-out transfer tests, and independent human validation (two annotators, exact agreement 93.5%, kappa 0.660, AC1 0.928). Retrieval evaluation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly designed around whether retrieved passages contain evidence that can support generation, rather than topical relevance alone. We study whether this closer alignment with downstream evidence needs also makes retrieval evaluation more useful for the decisions built from it.

papers.summary_zh: RAG 的檢索評估正從單純的主題相關性，轉向檢索內容是否包含可支援生成答案的證據，但更貼近下游需求的評估訊號，是否真讓後續決策更可靠？本文以「答案支援」訊號為探針，在五個檢索基準與 TREC RAG 2025 上依序檢驗其四種用途：比較檢索器、引導訓練與系統選擇、預測答案品質，以及過濾餵給生成器的證據。結果顯示該訊號確實改變檢索排名，尤其當相關性與證據的落差在系統間分布不均時（如 TREC-COVID）；但效益無法自動傳遞：用於訓練未可靠改善檢索器；用於系統選擇的效益取決於生成器如何使用證據（Coverage-Disciplined 提示下顯著增益，Standard Grounded 下無效）；其分數亦無法在未見主題上預測答案品質。人工標註確認過濾確實保留更多承載答案的證據，但不同 LLM 評審（Qwen 與 Claude）對最終答案是否改善得出相異結論。作者據此提出「效度組合問題」：訊號對某一用途的效度不會自動延伸至下一層推論，RAG 評估應針對其欲支援的具體決策逐一驗證。

Section 4.3 Table 4: BTS GRPO is comparable to label-using synthetic-data and pinpoint-tuning baselines but costs ~80x the training FLOPs (9.37 vs ~0.11 x 10^17); SMART underperforms
Section 4 preamble: 166 reported tests controlled with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05, 77 survive the correction

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic: label-free RL post-training (GRPO) of LLMs to reduce sycophancy, a core LLM-alignment/AI-safety problem. Novel use of the Bayesian Truth Serum peer-prediction score as the reward, with three theorems proved and honest delimitation from Qiu et al. and test-time-RL agreement rewards. Rigor is high (explicit assumptions, full proofs, six-config reward ablation, five-base cross-model study, three supervised baselines, four peer-prediction mechanisms, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control over 166 tests), but the key theory is asymptotic while training uses G=64, each experiment runs once with one seed, and one Phi-3 checkpoint was hand-selected using ground truth. Evidence is strong on the reference model (flip rate 23%→4%, accuracy 80%→93%) but weak/mixed on other bases for TF sycophancy, and the central ablation finding (prediction-score-only reward works nearly as well, contradicting the mechanism account) is unexplained; the 'surprise drives the effect' claim rests on four mechanisms on one dataset. Generalizability is limited to 3-4B models, synthetic binary true/false items, and a judge-free SYCON modification not comparable to upstream SYCON-Bench. Reproducibility is strong: pinned model revisions, seed 42, released code/datasets/configs and detailed hyperparameters, though hardware for two runs was unrecorded and kernels are not deterministic.

primary_link.title: Mitigating LLM sycophancy with RL-based fine-tuning: Bayesian Truth Serum approach

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently exhibit \emph{sycophancy}: they adapt their answers to a user's stated beliefs or preferences instead of reporting what they hold to be true, which lowers factual accuracy and can amplify misinformation. This paper proposes a methodology for mitigating sycophancy that employs the Bayesian Truth Serum (BTS), a peer-prediction mechanism, as the reward in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune an LLM. BTS pays an answer for being \emph{surpris
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常出現諂媚行為：面對使用者表述的信念或壓力時，放棄自身判斷而附和。本文提出以貝葉斯真相遊戲作為 GRPO 的獎勵進行 RL fine-tuning：對同一問題取樣一群回應視為受訪者，獎勵「比受訪者自己預測更常見」的答案，全程不需標籤或偏好標註。理論上證明三項結果：預測報告會被精確引出；大群體極限下諂媚答案的期望獎勵嚴格低於誠實答案；即使整群事先協調答題規則，資訊分數也無法超過誠實回報。實驗上，參考模型在 true/false 基準的翻答案率由 23% 降至 4%，受壓力時正確率由 80% 升至 93%；表現優於 SMART，與使用標籤的合成資料 fine-tuning 及 pinpoint tuning 相當，但訓練計算量約為後者的八十倍，適合標籤稀缺情境。Peer Truth Serum 等支付稀有性溢價的機制同樣有效，暗示「驚訝度」是降低諂媚的關鍵。限制包括僅測試 3–4B 模型、單一種子、封閉式答案，且獎勵追隨模型自身信念而非真值，無法保證正確性。

Novelty is solid but incremental: it combines known ingredients (contrastive logit fusion from SCD, asymmetric speculation from RAPID/SpecSteer) into a new operating point (compressed verifier + full-context drafter) with a parameter-free JSD-based acceptance gate; the axiomatic derivation of the gate is a nice touch but thin. primary_link.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs

papers.summary: Agentic LLM pipelines face escalating inference costs as context accumulates across retrieval, tool use, and multi-turn interactions. To control latency, deployments routinely compress inputs, but this degrades task accuracy. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates generation losslessly, yet it assumes the drafter and verifier share an identical context, preventing SD from resolving the accuracy-overhead trade-off. We propose AsymSpec, an asymmetric speculative decoding framework that breaks this
papers.summary_zh: 代理式 LLM 管線的脈絡隨檢索、工具呼叫與多輪互動不斷累積，部署時常壓縮輸入以控制延遲，但壓縮會損害準確率；投機解碼雖可無損加速，卻假設起草者與驗證者共享相同輸入，無法兼顧兩者。本文提出 AsymSpec：讓輕量起草者讀取完整輸入，大型驗證者僅處理壓縮視圖；透過同模型在完整與壓縮脈絡下 logits 之差的對比式 δ 融合，隔離脈絡增益並注入驗證者，再由無參數的脈絡散度接受閘門（CDA）依散度放寬接受門檻。實驗涵蓋四種代理能力與 GAIA、SimpleQA 端到端基準：平均達到全脈絡準確率約 90%，吞吐量提升 1.3–1.7 倍，文字任務計算量僅為 0.2–0.3 倍；增益隨壓縮嚴重度單調遞增，且可延伸至視覺–語言起草者搭配文字驗證者的跨模態設定。限制包括成效受限於壓縮視圖保留的資訊與起草者容量、需存取驗證者 logits，目前僅支援貪婪解碼。此法為長脈絡代理應用開闢「壓縮成本、近天花板品質」的新操作點。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope methodological study on LLM multi-agent system debugging, squarely matching the high-weight agents and LLM preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental in parts: selective replay borrows classic record-replay debugging (Ronsse et al., Sec. 2.2) and applies it to MAS failure attribution, and the C1-C4 taxonomy derives from Cemri et al. (Sec. 4.3); the controlled prefix-reconstruction framing that separates causal repair from stochastic resampling is the genuinely new contribution. Rigor is high: 536 human-annotated failures across three MAS frameworks (Sec. 4.2), inter-annotator reliability reported (Fleiss' kappa 0.622 primary category, 0.811 node type, Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap and exact McNemar tests with Holm correction (Appendix C.3-C.4), node-level controls (Random/Last-Node, Table 4), a replay-fidelity audit with 1,608/1,608 prefix-exact attempts (Appendix D.3), and a quantified LLM-judge error audit with 6.96% sensitivity upper bound (Sec. 5.2). Evidence is credible: 20.15% pass@1 for Suspicious-Node vs 6.90% pass@3 for the strongest task-level baseline, with all 15 RQ3 comparisons significant after Holm correction (Table 8), and honest outcome-instability analysis showing 85/162 reruns of successful executions fail (Sec. 5.3). Weaknesses: single unverified model alias (deepseek-v4-flash, Appendix C.2), only web-agent benchmarks, no ablation separating symptom detection from repair guidance (admitted in Sec. 5.4), hand-set non-optimized scoring coefficients (Appendix F.5), and reliance on LLM-as-judge for the headline reproduction metric. Generalizability is moderate (three architectures but one model family and two benchmarks); reproducibility is good given released code/data (Appendix H), full prompts, hyperparameters, and seeds, though the unconfirmed endpoint identity limits exact replication.

Existing MAS debugging and repair methods typically rely on rerunning and resampling the entire execution trajectory. However, a fundamental question remains to be answered: do these methods causally repair MAS failures or merely stochastically repair by leveraging the randomness of LLM s
papers.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統的修復方法多仰賴重跑整條執行軌跡，但成功究竟源於因果修復，或只是 LLM 取樣隨機性帶來的運氣，長期缺乏嚴謹檢驗。本文提出 SymTrace：以事件依賴圖記錄模型與工具互動，重播時用錄製結果嚴格重建失敗節點之前的執行，再從介入點恢復即時執行，藉此可靠重現失敗並隔離介入效果；並建構含 536 條人工標註失敗軌跡的 SymFail 資料集，涵蓋 AG2、CrewAI、Magentic-One 三大框架與 WebArena-Verified Hard、AssistantBench 任務。大規模實驗發現：未引導的全量重跑僅 6.90% 修復率，自我反思與批評代理在相同預算下無顯著優勢；SymTrace 將單次失敗重現率由 67.97% 提升至 80.78%；以症狀驅動的 Suspicious-Node Intervention 僅用一次介入即達 20.15% 修復率，較最強任務級基準提升 191.89%，且在三個框架上均最佳。限制包括基準任務無法涵蓋真實世界失敗、LLM 評審可能誤判，以及僅測試單一模型。此研究確立「控制執行歷史、在地化介入」的 MAS 修復評估原則。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-efficiency paper squarely within scope: test-time scaling, sliding-window attention kernels, and RL (GRPO) training on Qwen3 models. Preference relevance is high given strong coverage of LLMs, reasoning/CoT, transformer architecture, scaling/efficiency, and inference topics, though it touches none of the Japanese NLP, RAG, safety, or multimodal preferences. Novelty is moderate: the authors themselves note (Section 6) the method is essentially 'sliding window attention with global tokens' forming a prefix, closely related to StreamingLLM and Longformer; the main new contributions are the training-free application to reasoning traces and truncated backpropagation for long RL rollouts using the limited receptive field of stacked sliding windows (Section 2). Rigor is solid but not exceptional: evaluations use avg@64 on AIME25/GPQA/MATH500 with controlled temperature (Section 3), window-size sweeps, PE reset-vs-continue ablation (Appendix D), KL-divergence analysis of trainer multipliers (Figure 8), and baselines last-k/summary/vanilla sliding window with hyperparameter sweeps (Appendix G, Tables 2-3), but most headline comparisons live in figures and the model pool is narrow (Qwen3-1.7B, one 7B validation in Appendix E). Evidence strength is decent: Appendix C Table 1 gives concrete numbers (window 4096: AIME25 33.9 vs Full 34.2, tok/s at 32K 5479 vs 1477, supporting the 3x claim), yet key efficiency and ablation claims rest on figures and comparisons are deliberately restricted to bounded-cost, out-of-the-box alternatives (Limitations). Generalizability is reasonable - training-free applicability plus RL integration - but honest limitations (LiveCodeBench needs ≥16384 window, Figure 11; minimal gains for short generations, Figure 12; multi-turn/agentic failure modes) narrow the scope. Reproducibility is strong: simple method fully specified, hyperparameters and dataset filtering described (Appendix F), code released.

primary_link.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling

papers.summary: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem. As models keep the entire reasoning trace in memory via full attention, hard tasks that need long thinking can be prohibitively expensive. However, we find most intermediate reasoning tokens lose importance as the model continues reasoning. This calls into question whether retaining them is worth the cost. Based on this insight, we propose Prefix Sliding, which discards tokens during reasoning that are not part of the prefix or the window of the last few thousand tokens. The prefix has key instructions and tools available to the model, while the most recent tokens are the current reasoning the model is working on. This caps the total memory requirement regardless of how long the model reasons, allowing for efficient long-horizon test-time scaling. Without training, Prefix Sliding can make existing models 3x faster while maintaining performance. Training with Prefix Sliding using reinforcement learning can achieve better performance by enabling scaling to reasoning traces beyond a hundred thousand tokens. Ablations show Prefix Sliding outperforms summarizing intermediate tokens or vanilla sliding window. Our code is at https://github.com/Muennighoff/prefix-sliding
papers.summary_zh: 測試時擴展讓模型為難題思考更久，但全注意力須將整條推理軌跡留在記憶體，長推理成本隨生成長度增加而難以負擔。作者觀察到中間推理 token 的重要性快速衰減，而開頭前綴（系統指令、任務與工具資訊）與最近的 token 最為關鍵，據此提出 Prefix Sliding：推理時僅保留前綴與數千 token 的滑動視窗，捨棄其間的中間 token，使生成成本在達到上限後恆定，從而支援極長程的測試時擴展。此法無需訓練即可套用於既有模型，亦可配合 RL 訓練。結果顯示：不訓練時在相同思考時間下快約 3 倍且維持效能；搭配 RL 與截斷反向傳播，可將推理擴展至十萬 token 以上並提升獎勵；在 AIME25 等基準上優於摘要中間 token、僅保留最後 k 個 token 與純滑動視窗等替代方案。限制包括 LiveCodeBench 需更大視窗才能追上全注意力、短生成任務效益有限，以及代理式任務中大量讀取內容可能淹沒視窗、多輪使用者指令的處理方式仍待解決。
papers.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
papers.title_zh: Prefix Sliding：高效率的測試時擴展

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core transformer-architecture/efficiency paper for language models: recurrent depth (weight-tied core with prelude-shared-coda layout), GRU-style elementwise gating plus noise to prevent representational collapse, evaluated in isoFLOPs and isoParams regimes with latent-reasoning/test-time-compute framing. Strongly matches Transformer Architecture, Scaling & Efficiency, Inference & Serving, and LLM preferences; moderate match to Reasoning (framing only, no benchmark reasoning results). Novelty is incremental: prelude-shared-coda and depth sampling are adopted from Geiping et al. [9], and the contribution is the gate+noise modulation on a well-populated line (ALBERT, Universal Transformers, MoR, RRT, Ouro). Rigor is solid: matched-FLOP/param baselines trained from scratch at three scales, sequential component ablation, gate-bias/noise/temperature sweeps, downstream lm-eval-harness, and extensive Appendix E mechanistic analysis; but only 3 seeds at small scale (single seed elsewhere), GPT-2-scale training (~9.8B tokens), and a sequential rather than factorial ablation. Evidence claims are mostly supported and honestly reported (dense baseline still leads by 0.05-0.06 nats at medium/large at standard budget; RRT ties at small scale), with a disclosed confound in B.3 (dense trained with torch.compile, recurrent runs without). Generalizability is limited: GPT-2 family, 1024 context, dataset described only as 'a diverse dataset of text', and authors concede gate bias/noise may need re-tuning beyond GPT-2. Reproducibility is decent (full hyperparameter Table 5, forward-pass listing, seeds, hardware, public code) but weakened by the unnamed training corpus.

primary_link.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation

papers.summary: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce Gated Recurrent Transformer, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer Gated Recurrent Transformer matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 的深度與參數量緊密耦合：每層權重各自獨立造成記憶體瓶頸，而全權重共享又會壓抑表達多樣性。本文提出閘控遞迴 Transformer（GRT）：固定深度的前奏與尾奏區塊之間，夾一個迭代 R 次的共享核心；受 GRU 啟發，以依據當前隱藏狀態、前奏輸出與逐步注入雜訊的輕量元素級閘門，調控每次遞迴的寫入幅度，使同一組權重在每步扮演不同角色。在 isoFLOPs 條件下，3 層 GRT 達到 12 層 GPT-2 Small 的準確率，於全部九個規模×預算組合領先 MoR 與 heavy-tail 深度取樣，中型與大型規模隨資料預算成長追平甚至超越稠密基準；isoParams 條件下驗證損失 2.76，優於非遞迴對照的 2.84。大型規模下以少 62% 參數與 59% 尖峰解碼記憶體，僅付出約 10% 編譯後生成延遲，並自然浮現推論期早退能力：僅執行一半遞迴步數仍保留約 92% 準確率。消融顯示元素級閘門是最大貢獻者。限制包括遞迴深度在推論時固定、閘門超參數可能需針對其他架構重調。
papers.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation
papers.title_zh: Gated Recurrent Transformers：以遞迴調制實現具表現力的深度

Section 5.1: Spearman correlation between safety alarm score and response-level ASR is -0.964 (Llama-3.1-8B), -0.927 (DeepSeek-R1-14B), -0.976 (Gemma-3-4B) over ten score intervals with 95% CIs in Figure 2

Table 5 (Section 5.4): zero-shot transfer to eight inference-only targets averages 69.6% ASR / 92.6% EASR over five runs with std; six proprietary models average 44.1% / 60.0%

Table 8 (Section 6.2): ablation on GPT-OSS-20B shows full method 99% JDR vs 21% without gradient guidance and 4% with binary response-level feedback, isolating the contribution of continuous differentiable oracle feedback

Table 7 (Section 6.1): template-invariant extraction plus stability selection yields 0.989 AUROC / 100% JDR vs random neuron selection 0.682 / 16%, but this ablation is run only on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
Section 4.3: responses judged by Llama-Guard-4-12B and Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B independently, with human annotators resolving disagreements; number of disagreements and annotator details not reported

No repository, code, or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper; reproducibility rests on hyperparameters in Sections 4.1-4.2 and Appendices B, D, E
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/red-teaming paper with an interpretability-driven method: internal safety-neuron activations replace sparse response-level feedback in a coverage-guided fuzzer, hitting high-weight preferences (LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Interpretability). The reframing of fuzzing feedback via a differentiable prefill-only SafetyOracle is a genuine new perspective, though components (MLP activation pooling, stability selection, MCTS-Explore scheduling, MLM mutation) are combinations of known techniques. Evaluation is unusually broad and quantitative: oracle validity (AUROC 0.969-0.999, Spearman -0.927 to -0.976), comparisons to GCG/AutoDAN/PAIR/LLM-Fuzzer across five source models, transfer to 14 targets including six proprietary APIs with 5-run variance, cross-dataset (HarmBench), VLM transfer, defense and detector studies, plus component and probe-model ablations. Weaknesses: key ablations are single-model (Section 6.1 on Llama-3.1-8B, 6.2 on GPT-OSS-20B); fuzzing uses only 100 StrongREJECT questions with no CIs on JDR; oracle trained on harmful/benign classification could bias ranking toward its own objective; dual-judge human adjudication protocol under-specified; no code/data release statement despite detailed hyperparameters. Score reflects strong topical fit and thorough evidence, tempered by incremental composition and missing release artifacts.

primary_link.title: NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation

papers.summary: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcom
papers.summary_zh: LLM 安全評估的自動化模糊測試多依賴回應層回饋：每個候選提示都需生成回應再判定攻擊成效，成本高，且對強對齊模型而言回饋稀疏。本文提出 NeuronFuzz，以內部安全神經元啟動值作為連續執行回饋：先用模板不變的有害–良性配對與穩定性感知選取，找出少量安全神經元，訓練輕量 SafetyOracle 將其啟動值映射為可在 prefill 階段取得的連續安全警報分數，免去中間候選的回應生成；再利用分數對輸入的可微性，以梯度定位敏感模板位置，由遮罩語言模型生成語境相容的替換，同時保留有害載荷。在五個白盒來源模型上，越獄發現率達 76–100%，領先基準最多 48 個百分點，且平均每次發現只需 1 次回應生成；最佳化模板可零樣本遷移至開源與六個專有模型（平均 ASR 44.1%、top-5 EASR 60.0%），並延伸至視覺任務。防禦方面，SmoothLLM 可削弱但不消除其效果；SafetyOracle 亦可反向作為輸入端越獄偵測器。限制包括需白盒存取模型內部，以及在輸入防禦下效能下降。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely aligned with top-weight preferences (LLMs, RAG/knowledge, tool-use agents, multi-hop reasoning, RL post-training). The co-evolution idea—jointly RL-optimizing KB construction and QA reasoning with outcome rewards rather than treating construction as a static pipeline—is a genuine and useful angle beyond Search-R1-style search agents, though built from standard components (GRPO, triplet extraction, MiniLM retrieval). Rigor is solid: matched-budget Search-R1 reimplementation, four benchmarks with in-domain/out-of-domain split, KB-swap and fixed-KB ablations, zero-RL/SFT-necessity study, and honest reporting that KBevo-GRPO slightly trails Search-R1 on average EM (41.3 vs 42.4 at 1.7B; 46.6 vs 49.0 at 4B, Table 2) with the value proposition resting on controllability/editability (ConFiQA-MR edits, Sec 4.2). Evidence is tempered by three factors: a fixed frontier-model (Gemini) KB trained without co-evolution reaches 36.1 avg EM vs 35.6 for co-evolution (Table 3b), weakening the necessity claim; judge-based grounding/correctness metrics rely on Gemini-2.5-Flash with possible bias; no seed variance or significance testing. Analyses use an earlier checkpoint (top-k=1) acknowledged as non-comparable to main results (Appendix C checkpoint note). Generalizability is limited to 1.7B/4B Qwen3 on HotpotQA-trained settings with a required Gemini-generated SFT warm-start (zero-RL collapses, Fig 5; Limitation Sec 5), and PopQA single-hop underperforms Search-R1. Reproducibility is strong: code/models released, full hyperparameters (Table 5), prompts, and judge rubrics provided, though SFT data generation depends on a proprietary teacher.

primary_link.title: Co-Evolving Structured Knowledge and Reasoning in Language Models

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented methods improve factual accuracy by grounding language models in external knowledge, but retrieving over unstructured text often introduces irrelevant context and offers limited control over the retrieved information. Structured knowledge bases offer a more controllable alternative, yet they are expensive to construct and often brittle to reason over. To address these limitations, we propose KBevo: a co-evolving framework that jointly learns to construct a structured knowledg
papers.summary_zh: 結構化知識庫雖比非結構化檢索更可控、可編輯，但建置昂貴，且知識建構與下游推理長期脫鉤。本文提出 KBevo 共同演化框架：單一策略分兩階段運作——先閱讀文件建構 三元組知識庫，問答時再透過查詢介面存取該 KB；兩階段以 GRPO 端到端聯合訓練，QA 結果獎勵直接回饋並塑造 KB 建構，使推理成效直接改善知識品質。在 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2Wiki 與 PopQA 上，KBevo-GRPO 較 SFT 平均提升 5.1（1.7B）與 9.8（4B）點 EM，與重實作的 Search-R1 相當；相較 EDC、AutoSchemaKG 等靜態 KG 建構方法，其學到的 KB 在三元組品質與多跳答案可達性上皆顯著更佳。KB 可離線建置與直接編輯：在 ConFiQA-MR 反事實知識編輯情境下維持明顯優於 Search-R1 的表現。限制包括需 SFT 暖啟動、QA 獎勵僅涵蓋被檢索的三元組而無法保證整個 KB 的忠實性，以及潛在的獎勵駭取風險。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM runtime security framework (AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Interpretability, Inference & Serving) that adapts Linux Security Modules' separation of mediation and policy to LLM serving, turning SAE/transcoder/probe evidence into enforced decisions at buffered-output release. Novelty is architectural rather than algorithmic — pluggable backend contract, request-keyed state under continuous batching, and a separate enforcement gate are a genuinely new framing vs. standalone guards (circuit breakers, HiddenDetect, vLLM Hook), but detection mechanisms are reused artifacts. Rigor is solid: explicit threat model, trust assumptions, security goals, matched baselines (Matched Disabled/Empty Extension), scheduler-churn validation, systems-overhead decomposition, and candid limitations (single GPU, eager execution, one binding per policy, adaptive obfuscation can defeat latent monitors per §3.2/§8). Evidence is quantitatively strong but rests on judge-based ASR/FRR, one fixed-seed run per cell (Appendix A), and unmatched external comparisons treated as context only (§6.3). Generalizability is constrained to a trusted in-process deployment, Qwen3-4B primary evaluation with a single-request Gemma/SAE case study, and per-deployment calibration. Reproducibility is well supported by a detailed Open Science artifact with profiles, saved parameters, seeds, and retained records.

primary_link.title: LMSM: LLM Security Framework Inspired by Linux Security Modules

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with layered defenses, yet malicious prompts can still bypass them. Interpretability methods can expose model-internal signals along the generation path that could inform enforcement, but these signals are not security controls by themselves. Deployments that adapt them for safety typically couple each signal to its own calibration, policy logic, and intervention code, so each new artifact creates integration work instead of strengthening a
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常以多層防禦部署,但惡意提示仍能繞過防線;可解釋性方法雖能揭露模型內部訊號,本身卻非安全控制,且每個新構件往往各自綁定校準、政策邏輯與干預程式碼,難以累積為共用防線。本文提出 Language Model Security Modules(LMSM),將 Linux Security Modules 的權責分離精神移植到 LLM 服務:安全後端提供校準後的證據、版本化政策評估主動規則、獨立的執行閘門授權緩衝輸出釋放。原型支援 Hugging Face Transformers 與持續批次化的 vLLM,可承載 SAE、transcoder 等構件後端與任務擬合的稠密探針,並在排程器攪動下保持各請求決策一致。在 Qwen3-4B 上,LMSM-Checkpoint 將 HarmBench 攻擊成功率由 39.20% 降至 3.32%,XSTest 誤拒率由 2.40% 升至 4.40%,同時在批次寬度 32 時保留 98.14% 的輸送量;任務擬合政策在兩個工作負載上相對降低有害輸出率 82.5%–91.5%。限制在於需信任執行環境與後端校準,且每個政策僅支援單一後端綁定與 allow、terminate、refuse 三種動作。此框架讓可解釋性與模型內部分析的進展,獲得通往執行期強制執行的共同路徑。

links.title: FaithSieve: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Math Proofs with Faithful Formal Evidence

evidence: Abstract: FaithSieve with GPT-5.4 backbone achieves 81.43% exact first-error accuracy on the 350-problem ProofLoc-Olympiad vs 72.29% for direct judging; 84.5% vs 75.0% on the 200-problem ProofLoc-University.
Section 5.2/Table 5: 'w/o local EdgeUnits' ablation drops GPT-5.4 to 60.86% exact / 72.29% binary, supporting the locality hypothesis.
Appendix E.2/Table 8: human calibration of the semantic gate on 135 statements reports 88.98% precision and 91.30% recall but 65.00% FPR (13 of 20 unfaithful statements accepted).
Appendix F.8/Table 17: recorded token cost is 137.22x (GPT-5.4) and 152.11x (Qwen3.5-9B) Direct@1 in a fixed 50-problem cost evaluation.
Appendix F.7/Table 18: same-backbone token-budget controls on BIG-Bench-200 show Direct Majority@241 at 51.0% exact and an NL-only decomposition agent at 55.5% vs FaithSieve at 61.0%.
Appendix F.7: University paired comparison vs Direct@5 and two-critics baseline gives 95% CI [+2.5,+14.5] and McNemar's p=0.00948.

Appendix G.1: authors state limitations on formal-validation cost/coverage and untested geometry/combinatorics; Appendix F.5 notes ablations are replay-style, reusing intermediate artifacts from the full pipeline.
Appendix D.1: ProofLoc-University textbook provenance (Munkres, Axler, Dummit & Foote, Tao, Rockafellar, Boyd & Vandenberghe) and GPT-4o proof generation with expert first-error annotation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly matches high-weight preferences: LLM-based mathematical reasoning evaluation (Reasoning & CoT, LLMs), an agentic Formal Evaluation Agent driving Lean via MCP tools (Agents & Tool Use), and benchmark/evaluation methodology (Red Teaming & Evaluation). Research quality is solid: two expert-verified datasets with PhD-annotator adjudication, six-model direct-judge baselines, off-the-shelf PRM transfers, multi-sample and token-matched high-budget controls, component ablations isolating locality and the semantic gate, human audits of pipeline stages, Wilson CIs and McNemar's test. Novelty is moderate-high: proof-state-tree EdgeUnits, typed obligations, and faithfulness-gated Lean evidence form a meaningful advance over direct NL judging, though Lean-assisted proof evaluation builds on existing autoformalization and process-verification lines. Weaknesses: headline ~9-point exact gains are on self-constructed benchmarks with GPT-4o-generated proofs; replay-style ablations reuse intermediate artifacts; the semantic gate shows 65% FPR in human audit; cost is 137-152x direct judging; external validation limited to a 200-example BIG-Bench Mistake subset; no explicit code/data release despite detailed prompts and decoding configs. Domain coverage is confined to algebra/number theory and six university math domains; geometry and combinatorics are acknowledged as untested.

papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型已能產生複雜的多步驟數學證明,但可靠判定其正確性並定位最早的邏輯錯誤仍是難題;現有方法多依賴自然語言判斷,容易忽略局部推理斷裂,而直接以 Lean 驗證非形式化文字又面臨局部性與語意忠實性兩大挑戰——證明器可能繞過局部瑕疵去證明過寬的目標,或驗證偏離原意的自動形式化陳述。FaithSieve 是一套 Lean 輔助框架:先將粗略步驟分解為證明狀態樹中的局部推理單元,抽取型別化的證明義務,再由形式化評估代理驗證;形式驗證須通過語意對齊評分把關,只有忠實保留脈絡、物件與邏輯形式的陳述才納入證據。作者建構兩個專家標註資料集:ProofLoc-Olympiad(350 題)與 ProofLoc-University(200 題)。以 GPT-5.4 為骨幹時,FaithSieve 在奧林匹亞資料集達 81.43% 的首錯精確定位準確率,優於直接判斷基線的 72.29%;在大學資料集亦達 84.5% 對 75.0%,消融實驗確認局部單元與語意閘門皆屬關鍵。限制包括代理式形式化的 token 成本高昂(約百倍以上)、幾何與組合等領域覆蓋不足。此工作顯示局部且忠實的形式化證據能顯著提升證明評估的可信度。

links.title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: white-box signal improves ambiguous-item accuracy on all six open-weight models but reduces disambiguated accuracy on five; black-box triggering on gpt-4o-mini recovers most fixed-interval accuracy loss with substantially fewer interventions.

Section IV-C1 / Fig. 3 / Table II: on a 504-item gpt-4o-mini subsample, adaptive_bb reaches 90.1% vs. 82.9% disambiguated accuracy for fixed_interval (p=0.0003) at 0.60 vs. 1.00 interventions/item; independent-judge replication shows +6.75pp vs. fixed (95% CI [2.78, 10.71], p=0.0015).

Section III-D: authors explicitly state that without fixed-targeted or adaptive-generic conditions, 'the experimental design does not separately identify the causal effects of intervention timing and intervention content.'

Section IV-C2 / Table IV / Fig. 5: full nine-category complete-case analyses (N=13,070-15,686 per split) show e.g. Qwen-1.5B disambiguated 71.8%->55.4% (-15.6pp) under adaptive_wb; the matched-budget cadence sweep N in {2,3,5,8,10} shows adaptive selection is not merely a lower-firing fixed schedule.

Section V: limitations state experiments are restricted to BBQ with no generalization to other bias benchmarks, cultural contexts, or open-ended generation; detector calibration is validated on only one model; no comparison against trained reward models such as FRM.

Section IV-B and Conclusion: DS-Qwen-7B excluded from black-box analyses due to chat-template/judge token-budget failure (transparently reported); code and corrected BBQ label-matching logic released at github.com/clairekim59/adaptive-triggering.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences: chain-of-thought reasoning, inference-time intervention, bias/fairness (AI Safety), LLM-as-judge, and prompting-based correction across seven open-weight models plus gpt-4o-mini; clearly in scope, no out-of-scope domain cap applies. Novelty is moderate: CUSUM-based triggering is adapted from prior sequential-monitoring work, but combining evidence-conditioned mid-generation bias correction with a black-box/white-box signal separation and per-detector held-out calibration is a new formulation, and the 'when vs. what' decomposition plus the documented white-box target mismatch are genuinely informative findings. Rigor is strong: fixed-interval baseline, matched-budget cadence sweep controlling firing rate (Fig. 5), independent-judge replication, McNemar exact tests with stratified bootstrap CIs, and unusually honest confound acknowledgment (Section III-D admits timing vs. content is not causally separated). Evidence is quantitative and replicated across model families (Table IV, N=13k-15k per split), though several analyses are single-run, one underpowered check is flagged, and DS-Qwen-7B black-box results are missing. Generalizability is the weak point: all experiments are on BBQ only, calibration validated on a single model, and no comparison to trained reward models. Reproducibility is good: code, corrected BBQ scoring logic, verbatim judge prompt, and precise model/decoding details are released.

papers.summary_zh: 鏈式思考提示雖能提升表現,卻可能在中間推理步驟浮現並放大人口統計刻板印象;現有介入不是事後評估完整推理鏈,就是在固定步驟機械介入,無法判斷發展中的推理軌跡何時累積足夠證據值得修正。本文將此決策形式化為線上變化點偵測:每步的偏見風險訊號更新 CUSUM 統計量,當累積證據越過以保留資料校準的偵測器專屬門檻時,才注入針對性的情境修正。訊號有兩種:白盒訊號取自下個 token 機率對刻板印象一致選項與「資訊不足」選項的偏好差;黑盒訊號由 LLM 評審依文字評分,便於僅有 API 的部署。在 gpt-4o-mini 上,黑盒自適應觸發以遠少於固定排程的介入次數,挽回大部分在消歧情境失去的準確率,且換用獨立評審後結論仍成立;等預算的頻率掃描顯示自適應選擇並非只是介入較少的固定排程。然而跨六個開源權重模型,白盒訊號雖在全部六個模型提升模糊情境準確率,卻在五個上降低消歧情境準確率,因其無法區分無憑據的刻板印象依賴與正確的、恰與刻板印象一致的證據;偵測器校準也無法解決此目標錯配。介入另會在有限推理預算下增加未完成率。結論是有效的推論期偏見修正不僅取決於何時介入,更取決於用什麼證據觸發。

links.title: Narcissus: Program Synthesis Using Context-Aware LLM Approximations

evidence: Abstract: 'solves 40% of ARC tasks where the raw proposals solve 13%, all without a single LLM call during search' — headline claim consistent with Table 3 (DeepSeek-Reasoner synth-valid 13%) and full-ARC results (Figure 12).

Experimental Setup, Metrics and protocol: 'Our implementation, the cached LLM proposals, and all result data are available at https://github.com/Herb-AI/Narcissus/' plus 'experiments are implemented in Julia on top of the Herb.jl program synthesis library' — strong reproducibility.

Table 1 (SLIA, 70 tasks): Narcissus + Genetic (GPT-4o) 51.4 solved / 32.2% AUC vs Static + Genetic (GPT-4o) 32.2 / 18.2%, supporting the context-awareness claim; DeepSeek rows show Narcissus (32.6) matching Static on GPT-4o proposals.

RQ2, Table 2: ablation shows signal inversion — removing prefix alignment drops DeepSeek SLIA to 24.0/100 (full heuristic 45.8), while reuse dominates under GPT-4o (prefix-only 25.4 vs reuse-only 44.2) — good mechanistic evidence.

Results, Weak proposals (BV, DC): 'Narcissus solves 350 of 587 tasks, above unguided enumeration at 302, while the static priors collapse to 102 (BUS) and 57 (genetic)' — supports the regularization/no-pruning robustness claim.

Related Work, Learned search heuristics: 'Euphony (Lee et al. 2018) even conditions rule probabilities on surrounding structure' — calibrates novelty; the delta is task-specific LLM-derived context-awareness with no training.

Appendix D: signal weights swept over {0.5,1,5,10} on SLIA and fixed at 1 in every domain; genetic population swept over {10,50,100,1000} — documented but modest hyperparameter tuning, single-domain selection.

Experimental Setup, Metrics: 'means over five seeds' for genetic methods and per-task budget of 10^6 programs or 300 seconds — protocol transparency; however no statistical significance tests are reported for the smaller margins (e.g., ARGA 45.6 vs 43.0).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-methodology paper: LLM proposals (GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Haiku-4.5) compiled into a context-aware heuristic for grammar-constrained program synthesis, directly matching LLM, code/programming, and prompting preferences with no out-of-scope domain content. Novelty is solid but qualified: the paper itself concedes (Related Work) that Euphony already conditioned rule probabilities on surrounding structure pre-LLM; the novel combination is task-specific context-aware guidance from one-shot proposals with no LLM calls during search and no pruning of rules. Rigor is high: five domains, two backends, five baselines including augmented-BFS and re-prompting controls, a signal ablation (Table 2), per-size enumeration profiles (Figure 3), fixed hyperparameters selected on SLIA only (Appendix D), and 5-seed means for stochastic runs; missing significance testing and modest GPT-4o/ARGA margins (45.6 vs 43.0) are the main deductions. Evidence is well-quantified and internally consistent: Table 1 and AUC Tables 4-12 support 'beats static at every budget', Table 3 grounds the 13% vs 40% ARC claim, and the BV collapse of static priors (102 vs 350/587) substantiates the robustness claim. Generalizability is demonstrated across domains, backends, and proposal-quality regimes, with the worst case provably unguided search via the positive floor. Reproducibility is excellent: public code, cached proposals, and result data (GitHub link in Experimental Setup), full prompt templates in Appendix B, and documented hyperparameter sweeps.

Enumerative synthesizers search the space of syntactically correct programs systematically guided by LLMs; the state of the art guides them by approximating LLM proposals into rule frequencies, which loses where each construct belongs and prunes every rule the proposals mi
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型擅長一般程式設計,但當任務限定罕見的目標語言時,產生的程式常違反文法或不符規格;列舉式合成器雖能系統性搜尋語法正確的程式空間,現有以 LLM 提案規則頻率導引的靜態先驗卻丟失「建構式屬於何處」的情境資訊,還會把提案遺漏的規則完全剪除,恰在提案出錯時鎖死搜尋。Narcissus 保留提案的語法樹結構,在候選程式的情境中為每次擴展評分:前綴對齊衡量同樣周邊結構的提案是否走相同規則、子程式重用獎勵提案反覆重建的片段、正則化項以提案規模為中心並保留正數下限,使任何規則都不會被剪除,錯誤提案只會延遲而非隱藏解答。流程包含解析修復提案、將重複片段挖掘為巨集規則以擴充文法,搜尋期間完全不再呼叫 LLM。跨五個領域與兩種搜尋後端,Narcissus 在所有預算下皆勝過靜態引導,並大幅超越讓 LLM 自我修錯的「重新提示」法;到達提案式程式的速度約快一個數量級,在 ARC 上解出 40% 任務而原始提案僅 13%,消融顯示何種訊號承重隨提案品質而反轉。限制為權重固定且各領域最適訊號不同。此方法展示情境感知近似如何讓錯誤提案轉化為可靠的搜尋引導。
