links.title: Localize-Then-Decide Guarantees for LLM Judgments

evidence: Abstract: proposes Localize-Then-Decide framework combining conformal shortlist localization with a calibrated confidence rule that abstains, restoring confidence-risk monotonicity for m>2 candidates.

Theorem 1.1 / Corollary 3.3: with probability ≥1-δ, P(LLM agrees with human | satisfied confidence) ≥ (1-ε)(1-α), where Corollary 3.3 explicitly requires an additional cross-stage monotonicity assumption beyond exchangeability.

Section 4.1: evaluation on TL;DR, Chatbot Arena, HH-RLHF, AlpacaEval with m∈{5,10,20}, ~3,000 instances per (dataset,m), nine judge models from Mistral-7B to GPT-OSS-120B, Simulated Annotators with K=5/N=5, and 1,000 random 50/50 calibration/test splits.

Section 4.3 (Table 2): two-stage variants reach GSR 90-97% vs 48-79% for matched single-stage counterparts at m=10 with target agreement 0.81; two-stage (KL margin) coverage 64-72% vs 50-58% for GPT-OSS-120B.
Appendix H.1 (Table 8): empirical validation that P(y∉S(x)|Δ≥λ) decreases monotonically with λ and stays below α=0.10 at λ=0 for six configurations.

Appendix H.3 (Table 10): component-wise KL-margin ablation showing renormalization removal drops GSR from 96.8% to 83.5%; Appendix H.2 (Table 9) shows variance-normalized single-stage baseline still trails two-stage (74.2% vs 96.8% GSR).

Limitations: guarantees require exchangeability (may loosen under distribution shift), confidence estimation needs N forward passes per instance, and scope restricted to preference-judgment rather than Likert or factuality settings.
Appendix D: multi-candidate instances constructed from pairwise preference data with pool augmentation by non-judge LLMs; no code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on certified LLM-as-a-judge agreement guarantees, strongly matching LLM (w2.5), evaluation/benchmark (w1.8), and partially alignment preferences; no Japanese NLP, agents, or code content. Novelty is moderate: the Stage II machinery (binomial UCB + fixed-sequence testing) and cascades are inherited from Jung et al. (2024), and Theorem 3.1 is standard rank-based conformal coverage; the contribution is identifying probability-dilution-induced monotonicity breakdown at m>2 and a two-stage conformal-localize-then-select fix, with an explicitly flagged cross-stage monotonicity assumption validated only empirically (Appendix H.1). Rigor is solid: matched single/two-stage targets (ε'=0.19 vs ε=α=0.10, Section 4.3), component ablations (Table 10), strengthened baseline (Table 9), honest limitations. Evidence is broad (4 datasets, 9 judges 7B-120B, m∈{5,10,20}, 1,000 splits; Table 2 GSR 90-97% vs 48-79%) though patterns are uniformly smooth and no code release is claimed, limiting reproducibility despite detailed pseudocode (Appendix F) and data-construction protocol (Appendix D).

papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被用作評審,但要對其與人類判斷的一致性提供可靠保證並不容易。既有信心門檻方法能在成對比較下提供保證,前提是信心越高、與人類不一致的風險越低;然而候選回應數量增加時,機率質量被稀釋,此單調關係會崩壞。本文提出 Localize-Then-Decide 兩階段框架:第一階段以 conformal prediction 定位一個高機率涵蓋人類偏好回應的小型候選清單;第二階段以校準後的信心規則從清單中選出單一回應或棄權,提供 (1−ε)(1−α) 的高機率一致保證,恢復信心與不一致風險間的單調關係。實驗涵蓋 TL;DR、Chatbot Arena、HH-RLHF、AlpacaEval,m∈{5,10,20} 種候選數,以及 Llama、Qwen、GPT-OSS、DeepSeek 等評審模型;相較單階段基線,兩階段框架在保證成功率與覆蓋率皆大幅領先,並自然支援串接多個評審模型,讓弱模型處理簡單案例、困難案例升級至強模型,三層串接覆蓋率達 77–81% 且保證成功率超過 90%,最強模型僅需處理不到三成實例。限制包括需可交換性假設、模擬標註者的多次前向推播成本,以及僅適用於偏好判斷情境。此工作把可證明的評審保證從成對情境推廣到實務的多候選場景。

links.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities

evidence: Section 3.1/Eq.(1): instance factorized as x=(L(h,t,c),V(h,v)); 272 intents × 6 framings × 5 visual semantics × 2 carriers = 16,320 instances (Abstract and Section 3.1).
Section 4.1/Table 1: 16 MLLMs evaluated, 261,120 responses; average ASR spans 2.17% (gpt-5) to 78.38% (glm-4.6v).
Table 2: authorization documents yield +12.96% ASR over the no-image condition (34.77%); blank/noise/nature controls change ASR by <2.2%, supporting semantic-context attribution.
Table 3/Section 3.5: OCR carrier ASR 40.59% vs TEXT 50.70%; CASR after removing 4.14% mismatch is 42.34% vs 50.89%.
Appendix C.4/Table 11: lightweight config mean ASR difference −0.06%, 95% CI [−0.45%, 0.30%], Spearman ρ 0.997, Lin's CCC 0.999.
Table 12: GPT-5 vs human experts QWK 0.97 and 96.3% accuracy; lightweight judge (qwen3-8b-based, Appendix B.4) vs GPT-5 QWK 0.95.
Section 6.1: authority-minus-danger representation direction fit on discovery samples displaces held-out pairs, sharpest rise at layer 42 of gemma3-12b.
Appendix A.3/A.4: visual semantics generated via qwen2.5-vl-7b descriptions, zimage-Turbo, and 4-bit FLUX.2 [dev], with relevance/quality/readability filtering; scoring rubric 1–5 given in Table 7.
Appendix D.1: benchmark 'released for research purposes' with documentation, but no concrete code/data URL is verifiable in the document; judge prompt deferred to 'Code and Data Supplement'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM jailbreak benchmark squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLM safety, red teaming/evaluation, LLM-as-judge, prompting) — not out-of-scope since the methodology is language-centric (prompt framing, judge models) rather than pure vision. The factorized design (intent × framing × visual semantics × carrier, 16,320 instances) is a genuine methodological improvement over entangled prior benchmarks like FigStep/MM-SafetyBench, though benchmark contributions are inherently incremental. Rigor is strong: controlled no-image/blank/noise baselines (Table 2), CASR mismatch correction (Table 3), human-expert judge validation (QWK 0.97, Table 12), and full-vs-lightweight consistency (Spearman 0.997, Table 11). Evidence is largely supported by quantitative tables across 16 models and 261,120 responses, with held-out probing of the authority-direction (Section 6.1), though some causal framing of correlational ASR deltas and GPT-5-as-judge self-evaluation risk remain unmitigated beyond the human spot-check. Reproducibility claims (released benchmark, code/data supplement) are stated but no verifiable release URL appears in the document.

primary_link.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities

Existing benchmarks often couple harmful intent, prompt framing, visual semantics, and instruction carrier within individual jailbreak instances, obscuring the specific sources of observed vulnerabilities. To address this limitation, we introduce MMJailBench, a factorized benchmark that systematically varies and
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型已廣泛部署,但不同因素如何形塑其越獄脆弱性仍不清楚;現有基準常把有害意圖、提示框架、視覺語意與指令載體糾纏在單一實例中,難以歸因。MMJailBench 將越獄實例因子化為四個組成:有害意圖(272 項、九大危害領域)、六種提示框架、五種任務相關視覺語意與兩種指令載體(直接文字與影像內嵌文字),透過笛卡兒組合形成 16,320 個受控實例,並對 16 個開源與專有 MLLM 進行大規模評估。結果顯示各模型脆弱性高度異質,平均攻擊成功率從 GPT-5 的 2.17% 到 GLM-4.6V 的 78.38%;提示框架是變異的最大來源,故事、結構與學術框架普遍較易成功;任務相關視覺語意系統性削弱拒絕行為,授權文件等權威式線索增加最多(相對無圖提升 12.96 個百分點),顯示模型過度依賴視覺脈絡的表面正當性;而視覺化呈現的指令相較直接文字指令並未一致提升越獄成功率,載體效應取決於個別模型。對代表性開源模型的診斷分析亦在內部表徵與跨模態注意力中找到與權威線索相關的模式。此因子化設計使多模態安全對齊的弱點得以逐因子歸因,支援可重現、可擴充的越獄稽核。
papers.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities
papers.title_zh: MMJailBench:拆解多模態越獄脆弱性的因子化基準

links.title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness

evidence: Abstract: 'We introduce the Forget-Retain Alignment Gap (FRAG), a training-free predictor that scores an update's forget-retain alignment without running a relearning attack'
Table 3: 'FRAG reaches ρ=-0.78 pooled against -0.36 for global ℓ2' with n=30 checkpoints; 'w/o' FRP ablation yields -0.74 vs -0.10
Appendix C.4 Table 14: 'FRP recovers 1.9–4.9× less' at matched utility bands compared to RMU
Appendix A.2: Direction-blind noise perturbation shows L2 ranks noise as robust while FRAG correctly demotes both noise settings
Section 4 Experiments: 'All experiments use OpenUnlearning' with TOFU, WMDP-cyber, and MUSE-News benchmarks across LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Zephyr-7B-β, and LLaMA-2-7B
Limitations: 'FRAG also has limited resolution within dense unlearning methods' and 'broader benchmarks, multilingual data, and larger architectures would give a more complete picture'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM unlearning robustness paper. It introduces FRAG, a training-free weight-selectivity predictor that outperforms global ℓ2 distance (Spearman -0.78 vs -0.36), and FRP, a pruning method that achieves lower post-attack ES across matched controls. The topic sits at the intersection of LLMs, AI safety, and interpretability but does not touch the highest-weighted preference areas (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM). Experimental rigor is strong with four matched-control experiments, three benchmarks, four model families, and a direction-blind noise ablation. The method is conceptually simple (Wanda-style activation ratios + cosine similarity), which limits novelty, and the correlation analysis uses modest sample sizes (n=30). Code is available and implementation details are thorough.

primary_link.title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness

papers.summary: Machine unlearning aims to make a model forget specific data, yet unlearned LLMs often fail to stay unlearned: brief fine-tuning can revive removed knowledge. Existing robustness predictors rely on global weight-space displacement, but distance alone can be misleading when random or destructive updates collapse performance. We argue that relearning robustness depends on update structure: robust unlearning should affect forget-critical weights while sparing retain-critical ones. We introduce the
papers.summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在讓模型忘掉特定資料,但已遺忘的 LLM 常不持久:對良性資料短暫 fine-tuning 即可復原被移除的知識,形成再學習攻擊。既有穩健性預測器多依賴全域權重空間位移,然而距離本身可能誤導——隨機或破壞性更新同樣能產生大位移卻崩壞效能。本文主張再學習穩健性取決於更新結構:穩健的遺忘應集中於遺忘關鍵權重、同時避開保留關鍵權重。作者提出 Forget-Retain Alignment Gap(FRAG),一個免訓練的純量代理指標,以權重幅度與遺忘、保留資料上輸入通道的 activation 強度估計各權重重要性,再用餘弦相似度衡量更新與兩類關鍵權重的對齊差;並據同一原則提出 Forget-Retain Pruning(FRP),直接剪除遺忘重要、保留不重要且幅度夠大的權重。在 TOFU、WMDP-cyber、MUSE-News 與多個模型上,FRAG 與實際再學習穩健性的相關性(合併 Spearman ρ=-0.78)遠優於全域 ℓ2 距離(-0.36),排除以 FRAG 建構的檢查點後結論仍成立;FRP 在相同效用水準下,受攻擊後的遺忘恢復量僅為對照方法的幾分之一。限制包括對稠密型遺忘方法內部解析度有限,且目前僅為非結構化剪枝。此結果顯示「哪些權重移動」比「移動多遠」更能解釋穩健性。
papers.title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness
papers.title_zh: 距離並不足夠:遺忘—保留對齊差距可預測 LLM 再學習穩健性

links.title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract: all-classes skill reduces malware-generation severity from 3.37 to 0.58 and reaches 43.6% execution ASR, comparable to Llama Guard 3's 42.7% without a separate 8B classifier; per-class reaches 14.5%.
Section 6.1: six LLMs from six providers (Seed 1.6 Flash, DeepSeek V3.2, Ministral-3-8B, Nemotron-Nano-9B, Qwen3-Coder-Next, GPT-oss-120B) and three agent harnesses (mini-SWE-agent, OpenCode, Pi).
Section 6.3 / Table 6: budget-matched concatenation of per-class skills reaches 26.5% mean execution ASR vs 36.2% for the synthesized bundle skill, isolating synthesis loss from prompt capacity.

Appendix H: 54 of 60 execution comparisons reach p<0.01 after Bonferroni correction with large rank-biserial effects; bootstrap CI [27.7, 37.6] for Reactive per-class vs LG; Q2 concatenation result honestly reported as non-significant (p=0.094).

Section 6.4 / Table 10: jailbreak robustness is partial — execution advantage over LG is lost for broad scopes under AgentHarm (Reactive all-classes 47.8% vs LG 43.2%), while per-class retains a 12-point advantage; attacks are non-adaptive per threat model A5.
Section 6.5 / Figure 5: mean safety-grounded refusal of 0.14% across 731 SWE-Bench Pro tasks; Reactive per-bundle on Qwen3 B4 reaches 16.3% FPR, an acknowledged over-refusal case.
Appendix B: deterministic seeds via (md5(dataset_id)+run_idx) mod 2^31, L=10,000-character budget, temperature 0.0, 10-step limit, and official RedCode scoring rubric documented.
Open Science section: artifacts 'will be released publicly upon publication'; malware payloads and jailbreak templates withheld, limiting direct verification of the most sensitive components.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to top-weight preferences: LLM coding agents, agent/tool-use security, AI safety, red-teaming evaluation, and code generation. The contribution is a well-scoped empirical study of prompt-space security skills with a genuinely interesting provisioning-granularity analysis (all-classes vs per-bundle vs per-class under a fixed budget), but the core mechanism (safety instructions in the system prompt) is incremental over existing prompt-space defenses. Rigor is above average: deterministic train/test splits, six models across three harnesses, five baselines, preamble/budget/concatenation/LOFO ablations, Wilcoxon tests with Bonferroni correction and bootstrap CIs, and honest reporting of null or unfavorable results (Nem, Seed, non-significant concatenation p=0.094). Evidence supports the narrow claims, though jailbreak evaluation is non-adaptive only, malware severity relies on a single LLM judge, and attack evaluation rests on one benchmark (RedCode). Limitations are candidly stated (no end-to-end benign success, no artifact-injection isolation, no white-box adaptive attacks). Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters, seeds, reproduced synthesis prompts, and skill excerpts, but code is only promised 'upon publication'.

primary_link.title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents

papers.summary: A coding agent edits files and executes shell commands with its developer's privileges, allowing malicious requests to translate directly into harmful actions or functional malware. Existing defenses have complementary limitations: weight-level alignment is unavailable to API-only deployers, whereas input filters and execution-boundary monitors require auxiliary classification or checking components along the agent's trajectory. We therefore introduce SkillShield, a system-prompt defense that sy
papers.summary_zh: 程式碼代理以開發者權限編輯檔案並執行 shell 指令,惡意請求可直接轉為有害動作或可運作的惡意軟體;權重層級對齊對僅透過 API 部署者不可行,輸入過濾與執行邊界監控又需額外的分類或檢查元件。SkillShield 提出系統提示層級的防禦:離線從已知攻擊(主動挖掘)或代理失敗軌跡(反應式學習)合成「安全技能」,於工作階段開始時整份注入系統提示並在工具使用迴圈中持續生效,無需請求時分類或路由。由於提示空間有限,作者比較三種固定預算的配置範圍:涵蓋全部威脅類別的 all-classes、針對相關子集的 per-bundle,以及單一類別的 per-class。在 RedCode 上跨六個 LLM,預設 all-classes 技能將惡意軟體產生嚴重度由 3.37 降至 0.58,執行攻擊成功率 43.6%,媲美需額外 8B 分類器的 Llama Guard 3 的 42.7%;per-bundle 與 per-class 分別降至 36.2% 與 14.5%。在兩類非自適應越獄下,惡意軟體產生防護仍最強,但執行防護於 persona 框架下退化;以相同預算直接串接各類別技能文字可挽回大半範圍擴大造成的損失。跨 731 個良性 SWE-Bench Pro 任務,平均安全拒絕率僅 0.14%。此工作確立系統提示可作為僅 API 部署者的實用第一線安全控制面。
papers.title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents
papers.title_zh: SkillShield:為 LLM 程式碼代理打造的提示空間安全技能

links.title: How Do LLM Agents Actually Get the Flag? Trace-Level Provenance for Agentic Offensive Security Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: 'We apply ctf-abacus to 1,435 CTF attempts by six frontier and open-source models on 240 challenges, yielding 2,870 solve profiles under two judge lenses.'

Methodology, 'Flag provenance and validation': 'security researchers re-judged a 10% sample (N=92) with pi verdict and all pivot events hidden, agreeing with the pipeline on 93.5% of genuine solves and 86.7% of undemonstrated exploits.'
Evaluation Results: 'Re-scoring runs in Figure 6 lowers every model by 17.4-22.6% and reduces the pooled rank correlation to 0.60.'
Discussion and Insights, 'Benchmark Inflation': 'attributes 72.9% to executed attacks, 10.9% to human-verified derivations without observable execution, and 16.2% to unsupported pathways.'
Discussion and Insights, 'No Cheap Proxy': keyword detector 'achieves an F1 of 0.28 and flags 28.2% of execution-backed recoveries and 29.0% of unsupported recoveries, offering almost no separation.'
Evaluation Results: 'We evaluate six models, Claude Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GLM 5.2, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen 3.7 Max' (note later 'GPT 5.6 Sol' as judge, a naming inconsistency).
Limitations and Future Work: 'an exploit can read as a shortcut, an ambiguity that even a human reviewer cannot always resolve'; no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: LLM agents and tool use (six frontier models run under the D-CIPHER multi-agent harness), AI safety/offensive security capability measurement, and benchmark/red-teaming evaluation methodology. The core contribution - trace-level provenance distinguishing demonstrated exploitation from shortcuts (lookup, recall, guessing, unsupported claims) - is a genuinely novel per-attempt audit angle not covered by prior contamination or aggregate behavioral studies, with a defensible 'challenge signature' aggregation. Rigor is solid: dual cross-family LLM judges (Claude/GPT lenses), blind fidelity audit (98.3/100), human re-judgment of a 10% sample (N=92; 93.5%/86.7% agreement), and effect-size reporting (Cramer's V, eta-squared, p=0.012). Evidence is quantitative and mostly internally consistent, though minor discrepancies exist (abstract's 1,435 attempts vs 'over 1400' in Evaluation Results; abstract's 62-87% verified range vs 72.9% headline; judge version naming 'GPT 5.5' vs 'GPT 5.6 Sol'), and the inferred exploitation act rests on a single reasoning-aware pass per lens without an explicit inter-lens agreement statistic. Generalizability is bounded: four CTF benchmarks and six models support cross-benchmark claims, but the framework is offensive-security-specific; transfer to broader agentic evaluation is asserted, not shown. Reproducibility is limited by no stated code/data release, LLM-judge dependence, and required human adjudication. Well above scope thresholds since it is agentic LLM methodology, not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: How Do LLM Agents Actually Get the Flag? Trace-Level Provenance for Agentic Offensive Security Evaluation

papers.summary: Capture-the-Flag (CTF) benchmarks are widely used to assess the offensive security capabilities of autonomous language-model agents. Evaluations rely on shallow binary judgments or aggregate scores, overlooking the agent's trajectory to the flag. Consequently actual exploitation is conflated with direct flag exposure, memorized recall, external lookup, guessing, and unsupported claims, potentially overstating the agent's cybersecurity capability. We introduce CTF-ABACUS, a trace-based agent audi
papers.summary_zh: CTF 評測普遍以是否取得正確 flag 作為 LLM 代理攻擊性安全能力的判準,但同一 flag 可能來自真正的漏洞利用、記憶背誦、外部查詢、猜測或毫無根據的宣稱,使傳統計分高估能力。本文提出 ctf-abacus,一個以執行軌跡為本的稽核框架:它將代理行為拆解為 PTES 滲透測試階段與標準化技術,定位漏洞利用行為與 flag 首次出現處,並以雙評審(Claude 與 GPT 觀點)加上專家人工複核,判定每個 flag 的來源屬 genuine-solve、未展示的利用、外部查詢或僅存於推理等類別,再彙整為挑戰簽章以檢驗基準效度。研究涵蓋六個前沿模型在四個基準、240 道題目上的 1,435 次嘗試,產出逾 2,870 份解題輪廓。結果顯示僅 62–87% 的 flag 由可驗證的利用行為支持;要求執行證據會使模型分數下降 17.4–22.6%,且 40.3% 的題目在不同模型間呈現混合路徑;多數無憑據取回源於 flag 直接暴露而非資料污染。簡單的關鍵字或摘要特徵無法區分兩類行為(最佳 AUC 僅 0.617)。限制在於模糊題目的判定仍需人工判斷。此研究將 CTF 評測從「數 flag」轉向「驗證利用過程」,有助設計更能隔離攻擊能力的基準。
papers.title: How Do LLM Agents Actually Get the Flag? Trace-Level Provenance for Agentic Offensive Security Evaluation
papers.title_zh: LLM 代理如何真正取得 Flag?以軌跡層級溯源評估攻擊性安全能力

links.title: LowRankArena: A Standardized Evaluation Platform for SVD-Based LLM Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'unifies task versions, uniform-precision compression budgets, comparison regimes, and inference measurements, and provides a reproducible pipeline with over 3 TiB released compressed checkpoints'; code URL at github.com/Zishan-Shao/lowrankarena.git.

Section 2.2: standardized keep-ratio formula isolating 'pure subspace selection rather than bit-width reduction'; methods ASVD, SVD-LLM, DoBi-SVD, Basis Sharing, MoDeGPT evaluated at r in {0.8, 0.6, 0.4} on LLaMA-1/2-7B, Llama-3.1, Qwen3 with LM-Eval-Harness v0.4.11 and vLLM 0.18.1.

Section 3 / Table 1: on Llama-3.1-8B at 60% keep, SVD-LLM and Basis Sharing reach C4 perplexities of 1187.78 and 461.21 while MoDeGPT stays at 51.82; ASVD drops from #2 to #5 moving from Llama-1 to Llama-3.1 at 80% keep (Fig. 4).

Section 4 / Figure 5: SVD competitive with pruning on MCQ but LLM-Pruner achieves 34.85 C4 PPL at 60% keep vs MoDeGPT's 51.82; caveat that 'unmatched method default recovery protocols... prevent claiming that the ranking persists after post-compression recovery.'

Section 5 / Figure 6: TTFT speedups up to 4.20x in prefill-heavy workloads but decode-heavy throughput marginal or sub-1x with SVD-LLM at 0.80x; Table 3 shows prefill-heavy TTFT 3.37x but E2E only 1.06x, decode-heavy E2E 0.68x.

Section 6 / Table 2: calibration-sensitivity audit on Llama-3.1-8B 80% keep with three WikiText-2 resamples; MoDeGPT leads in every condition; DoBi-SVD 'omitted because its repeated compression runs did not complete within the available compute budget.'

Appendix B.3 / Table 11: 70B one-H200 feasibility failures are implementation-level (ASVD legacy lm_eval import, SVD-LLM/DoBi-SVD OOM, Basis Sharing CUDA eigensolver, MoDeGPT Accelerate offload), explicitly 'not as method-quality claims.'

Appendix B.6 / Table 16: BoolQ anomaly 0.4116 reproduced across reruns; checkpoint predicts 'yes' for only 3.58% of examples vs 62.2% label base rate; BoolQ calibration-draw range 0.2064 even at 512 sequences.
Appendix D: limitations acknowledge uniform-precision-only scope (no INT4/INT8 hybrids or sparsity) and hardware/software dependence of serving measurements.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark/audit platform paper squarely in LLM territory: standardized evaluation of SVD-based compression for Llama/Qwen backbones with matched budgets, end-to-end vLLM serving measurements, and released checkpoints. Strong match to LLM (2.5), evaluation/benchmark (1.8), inference & serving (1.5), and efficiency (1.3) preferences, though it does not engage the highest-weighted topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLMs). Novelty is moderate: the platform and negative findings (protocol-sensitive rankings, MCQ-masking of PPL collapse, prefill-only speedups) are empirically valuable but conceptually incremental over existing evaluation concerns; the paper itself cites LLMCBench as prior compression-benchmark work. Rigor is high: controlled keep-ratio grids, uniform-precision budget definition, calibration-sensitivity audit with resampled error bars (Table 2), cross-device reruns (Tables 8-10), a careful BoolQ label-bias forensic audit (Appendix B.6), and honest caveats (DoBi-SVD omitted from one audit for compute budget; pruning recovery protocols unmatched). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent across many tables, though some motivating material (n=76 OpenReview audit) lacks methodological detail. Generalizability is good across backbones, ratios, and devices but confined to uniform-precision post-training SVD; hybrids and quantization are explicitly excluded. Reproducibility is excellent: code repo, 3+ TiB hosted checkpoints, pinned versions (LM-Eval-Harness v0.4.11, vLLM 0.18.1), YAML configs, Croissant metadata.

primary_link.title: LowRankArena: A Standardized Evaluation Platform for SVD-Based LLM Compression

papers.summary: SVD-based low-rank compression has become a fast-growing direction for reducing the memory and computational cost of large language models (LLMs). However, meaningful comparison across existing studies remains difficult as prior evaluations use varied benchmarks, inconsistent ratios, and diverse setups, often failing to isolate low-rank effects from auxiliary techniques. As a result, it remains unclear whether reported gains reflect method-level improvements or differences in evaluation protocol
papers.summary_zh: SVD 式低秩壓縮是降低 LLM 記憶體與運算成本的熱門方向,但各研究的任務版本、壓縮比定義、模型骨幹與推論後端不一,且常把混合精度等技巧混入低秩預算,使文獻難以公平比較。本文提出 LowRankArena,一個標準化評測平台:統一任務版本、等精度壓縮預算與以 vLLM 為基礎的端對端推論量測,並釋出超過 3 TiB 的可重現壓縮權重。平台在 LLaMA-1/2、Llama-3.1 與 Qwen3-8B 上,於多個保留率重新評測 ASVD、SVD-LLM、DoBi-SVD、Basis Sharing 與 MoDeGPT 五種方法,並與結構化剪枝比較。結果顯示:方法排名高度依賴骨幹與保留率,並無架構不變的贏家;選擇題準確率可能掩蓋困惑度嚴重崩壞;理論上的低秩節省在解碼密集工作負載下常只剩邊際甚至低於 1 倍的加速,效益集中於 prefill 等運算受限階段;剪枝在激進壓縮下退化較平緩。附錄另揭露校正資料敏感度,且 70B 縮放受阻於工程問題而非演算法極限。限制為僅涵蓋等精度的訓練後 SVD,結果亦綁定特定硬體與後端。此平台為社群提供可重現的共同基準,提醒「最佳方法」是有條件的結論。
papers.title: LowRankArena: A Standardized Evaluation Platform for SVD-Based LLM Compression
papers.title_zh: LowRankArena:SVD 式 LLM 壓縮的標準化評測平台

links.title: XREPOTEST: Benchmarking Multilingual Repository-Level Unit Test Generation for Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: benchmark of 3,642 focal functions across Rust, Go, Julia, PHP, Ruby with containerized, language-native execution and multiple context augmentation strategies (file-level, LSP, retrieval).
Section 4 + Algorithm 1: proposes Invocation Rate (IR), an AST-based direct-call metric distinguishing intentional focal-method validation from accidental/indirect execution.

Table 2 / Section 5.1: 14 LLMs evaluated under standard focal context; best standard-setting TPR ~26.9% (Claude 4.5 Sonnet, PHP), supporting the benchmark's difficulty claim; CSR 57.4% mean and MS 3.2% mean reported.

Appendix H: bootstrap resampling (10,000 iterations) with 95% CIs and McNemar's chi-squared tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction; 56/90 top-model pairwise comparisons significant; context augmentation gains confirmed statistically.

Appendix F / Table 5: agentic (headless Claude Code) evaluation on a stratified subset raises TPR 1.2-2.6x but exposes Cov/IR drops (e.g., PHP TPR +11.5% with Cov -33.3%, IR -71.3%); IR-vs-TPR disagreement at 9.7% overall with manual inspection.
Appendix C: perplexity-based contamination analysis (PPL 3.52-32.74 across two open models) as a proxy for memorization risk; acknowledges no strict leakage guarantee.
Section 7 (Limitations): fixed prompt/decoding, untuned retrieval, and scope restricted to five languages and curated repositories; framework released as extensible.

Abstract: 'The dataset and code are publicly available at: XRepoTest' with an empty link placeholder in the supplied text, leaving the availability claim unverifiable; Appendix E.1 also states CSR 'omitted from this table and available upon request' despite Table A.4 reporting CSR values.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly preference-relevant: an LLM-centric repository-level unit-test generation benchmark (Code & Programming, Agents & Tool Use, RAG, Evaluation all high-weight). Novelty is solid but incremental in parts: multilingual (Rust/Go/Julia/PHP/Ruby) repo-level test-gen coverage is a genuine gap, and the Invocation Rate metric is a useful, if simple, AST-based contribution; TestGenEval already established repo-level test-gen evaluation. Rigor is good: 3,642 focal functions, 14 models, containerized native test runners, all-or-nothing TPR, mutation scoring where tooling permits, bootstrap CIs and Holm-Bonferroni-corrected McNemar tests (Appendix H), failure-mode taxonomy, and a perplexity contamination check (Appendix C). Evidence strength is tempered by: Figure 1's standalone-vs-repo gap compares against McEval numbers under a different protocol; agentic results (Table 5) use a small stratified subset keyed to one model's difficulty; SWE-bench correlation uses only 12 models (authors flag this); and the public availability link in the abstract is a blank placeholder, so the release claim is not verifiable from the text. The paper is candid about limitations (fixed prompts, untuned retrieval, Ruby/Julia/PHP mutation tooling gaps, IR's syntactic nature and the Julia dispatch-mismatch blind spot it admits in Appendix F). Generalizability is moderate: five curated languages/domains, language-dependent context effects, explicit caveat that results may not transfer. Reproducibility is above average (model IDs, prompt templates in Appendix K, retrieval ablation in Appendix G, filtering rules) but the unverifiable availability link and an internal inconsistency (Appendix E.1 claims CSR omitted while Table A.4 reports CSR) hold it back.

primary_link.title: XREPOTEST: Benchmarking Multilingual Repository-Level Unit Test Generation for Large Language Models

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated unit test generation, but existing evaluations largely rely on standalone settings and a narrow set of programming languages, overestimating real-world readiness. We introduce XREPOTEST, a multilingual repository-level benchmark for unit test generation spanning five underexplored languages: Rust, Go, Julia, PHP, and Ruby. XREPOTEST evaluates tests under realistic repository constraints using a containerized execution framework and mu
papers.summary_zh: 單元測試生成評測多以獨立函式層級設定為主,且偏重 Java 與 Python,高估模型在真實專案中的就緒度。本文提出 XRepoTest,涵蓋 Rust、Go、Julia、PHP、Ruby 五種語言、來自真實儲存庫的 3,642 個焦點函式,所有生成測試都在容器化環境中依各語言原生框架執行,並支援檔案層級、LSP 與檢索式(BM25、UniXCoder)等情境增補。除通過率、涵蓋率、編譯成功率與突變分數外,作者提出新指標 Invocation Rate(IR),檢查測試是否直接呼叫目標函式,以區分意外執行與刻意驗證。實驗評測 14 個先進 LLM,發現獨立設定與儲存庫層級表現差距顯著,即使 Claude 4.5 Sonnet 與 GPT-5.2 等旗艦模型,標準設定下最佳通過率也僅約 27%;API 幻覺是主要失敗模式,在 Rust 尤其嚴重。檔案層級情境最一致有效,但在 Ruby 會大幅降低 IR;代理式 Claude Code 可將通過率提升 1.2–2.6 倍,卻可能犧牲涵蓋率與 IR,且 9.7% 的測試套件雖通過卻未真正呼叫目標函式。限制包括固定提示與未調校的檢索設定。此基準揭示多語言真實環境下的能力缺口,並示範 IR 能捕捉通過率掩蓋的失效。

evidence: Abstract: claims psRL outperforms existing systems by up to 5.2x in throughput; source code 'will be publicly available soon'.
Sec 2.4 / Fig 2(b): update phase grows >5x and contributes 40-58% of total RL time under structured sampling vs 19-32% for trajectory-wise.
Table 1: prefix match rates reach 94.51% (ALFWorld, Step), 90.22% (WebShop, Step), 88.92% (DTN Agent, Step), 62.24% (DTN Tree-Step).

Sec 3 / Fig 3: correctness via attention masking (autoregressive dependency preserved) and advantage masking (per-sequence loss), though no convergence-parity experiment with psRL vs veRL is reported.
Sec 7.1.3: baselines are veRL plus veRL variants with vLLM-style (16-token blocks) and SGLang-style (1-token blocks) prefix sharing adapted into Megatron-LM.
Sec 7.2: DTN Agent Step mode 239.1k tokens/s vs SGLang-PS 62.7k (~3.8x); peak memory 56.2GB to 33GB (41% reduction); E2E speedup up to 2.1x; update latency 462.1s to 88.7s.

Sec 7.3: ablations show psRL worker times 245.13-261.23s vs wider ranges for Sharing-Agnostic/Prefix-Match-First/Balance-First in Tree-Step; DBC cuts peak KV memory >54%; ABA outperforms fixed block sizes whose optimal block varies by workload (32 in Search, 128 in DTN).
Sec 7.4: near-linear scaling to 12,288 GPUs at 1.14M tokens/s (4.7x over veRL); baselines OOM at 8x sequence length on DTN while psRL sustains 42.1k tokens/s.

Sec 7.1.2: proprietary industrial DTN Agent on Qwen3-235B MoE across 1536 GPUs is a key workload but not publicly reproducible; standard agents (Search, WebShop, ALFWorld) use public models Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B with stated parallelism configs.

Sec 8: acknowledges concurrent Tree Training and AReaL-DTA works that reuse computation via prefix trees, differentiating psRL by decoupling sharing from tree execution and joint scheduling/memory optimization.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on RL training infrastructure for LLM agents, squarely matching high-weight preferences (agents/agentic AI, LLMs, RLHF/RL, inference serving, efficiency). The motivating bottleneck-shift analysis (update phase 40-58% of RL time; prefix match rates >90% under step-wise sampling) is quantified across four workloads. Contributions — inter-batch/self-sequence prefix sharing, adaptive block allocation, JIT dynamic KV caching — are sensible adaptations of inference primitives to training, with concurrent related work (Tree Training, AReaL-DTA) limiting novelty. Evaluation is broad (baselines veRL/vLLM-PS/SGLang-PS, ablations, scaling to 12,288 GPUs, 1.2-5.2x speedups), but training-quality preservation (convergence/reward parity vs baselines) is never demonstrated, several headline numbers live only in unverifiable figures, the flagship DTN agent is proprietary, and code is only promised ('will be publicly available soon'), capping evidence strength and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: psRL: Efficient Training for Agentic AI via Training-Time Prefix Sharing

papers.summary: In modern agentic AI training, the system bottleneck is shifting from rollout to update. Emerging sampling strategies such as tree-structured and step-wise RL greatly increase training sample volume while incurring relatively low marginal rollout cost, causing the update phase to dominate the end-to-end execution time. papers.summary_zh: 隨著樹狀與步階式 RL 取樣在 agentic 訓練普及,訓練樣本量暴增,系統瓶頸已從 rollout 移轉到更新階段(可占端對端時間五成以上),而生產軌跡顯示樣本間前綴重複率常逾 90%。本文提出 psRL,一個利用訓練階段「全域可見性」與「資料不可變性」的前綴共享訓練系統,建構於 veRL 與 Megatron-LM 之上。其工作排程結合跨批次共享、單序列自共享、語意群組負載平衡與 token 級微批次切分;記憶體管理則以自適應區塊配置消除內部碎片,並以 Just-in-Time 政策的動態區塊快取,依參考計數主動保留或回收 KV 區塊。系統同時加速參考模型前向與舊策略對數機率計算。在 Search、WebShop、ALFWorld 與工業級 DTN Agent(基於 Qwen3-235B、1536 張 GPU)上,psRL 相較 veRL 取得最高 5.2 倍輸送量提升,峰值記憶體在極端工作負載下降 41%,端對端加速可達 2.1 倍;擴展至 12,288 張 GPU 仍近線性,且在序列放大 8 倍時是唯一不 OOM 的系統。限制在於依賴 rollout 前綴樹結構與特定工作負載形態。此研究指出 agentic RL 的真正系統瓶頸,並提供可複用的訓練期前綴共享方案。

links.title: Skill Issue: Are Skills Language-Invariant in LLMs?

evidence: Sec. 3 'Evaluation protocol': every language pair evaluated in both role assignments with n=400 self-play games per direction, yielding 28,800 games per model–game pair and 518,400 games overall.

Sec. 5.3 and Table 3: holding a weak German interface fixed, switching reasoning language to English moves μ from −0.22 to +0.20 in TicTacToe (89.4% recovery) and from −0.21 to +0.05 in SimpleTak (60.5% recovery).
Sec. 5.4: mean language margin correlates with Global-MMLU (r=0.73–0.92) and Belebele (r=0.71–0.79), with the text noting 'there being only a sample size of 8 languages'.
Limitations 'Model scale': evaluation limited to 3B–4B open-weight models and results 'should not be interpreted as establishing scale-invariant language effects'.

Sec. 1 footnote 1 and Sec. 2: code/data 'publicly available at https://github.com/TextArena/TextArena'; resource comprises 65 games in 193 languages across verification tiers (Table 1), with 8 native-verified Tier-A languages used in experiments.
Appendix B: inference-only setup served with vLLM and orchestrated with Ray on two NVIDIA H200 GPUs, ~6 H200 GPU-hours per primary run; Appendix A gives both prompt variants.

Sec. 5.2 and Appendix G.3 (Table G.4): Nim optimal-strategy mentions and optimal first-move execution vary sharply by language (e.g., Qwen3-4B executes optimal first move 80.8% in English vs. 24.6% in French), with low-resource-language strategy mentions largely arising from spontaneous Latin-script switches.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research squarely matching high-weight preferences: LLM evaluation, multilingual skill/reasoning assessment, and agentic gameplay via multilingual TextArena self-play (no Japanese-specific work, the only major weighted preference missed). The controlled design—same model playing itself through different language interfaces with role-pooled margins to cancel first-move advantages—is a genuinely novel way to isolate language-conditioned skill access beyond prior knowledge-consistency work, and the interface-language vs. reasoning-language decomposition is a useful intervention. Rigor is solid at scale (518,400 games, both role assignments, formal margin metrics) but statistical treatment is thin: no confidence intervals or significance tests on margins, and the benchmark/data-availability correlations rest on only n=8 languages per model, which the authors acknowledge. Evidence for the central claim (skills are not language-invariant) is strong and multi-pronged—win margins, spatial failure modes, card-conditioned betting, Nim strategy-mention vs. execution gaps—and the reasoning-language recovery result is compelling, though some claims lean on proxies (strategy mentions, FineWeb-2 counts for closed training data). Generalizability is hedged by design: only 3B–4B open-weight models and 8 Tier-A languages, with the authors explicitly disclaiming scale-invariance. Reproducibility is good: open-weight models, released code/data under MIT, documented prompts, sampling parameters, serving stack, and translation pipelines in appendices. Overall a well-executed evaluation/resource contribution of clear relevance, held back mainly by small-language-count correlation analyses and narrow model scale.

primary_link.title: Skill Issue: Are Skills Language-Invariant in LLMs?

papers.summary: Large language models access knowledge inconsistently across languages, but to what extent do they differ in their skill sets when interacting with different languages? This work quantifies cross-lingual skill inconsistency orthogonally from knowledge and general benchmark performance. We do this via multilingual self-play: two instances of the same model compete in a text-based game, each interacting through a different language interface. Since the model, opponent, rules, state space, and available actions remain fixed, this setting isolates the effect of language on the model's realized behavior. We build a multilingual extension to TextArena and evaluate three open-weight models across eight languages and six games covering spatial reasoning, imperfect information, resource allocation, and repeated interaction. We find that the same model can exhibit markedly different playing strength across languages, with systematic variation in win--loss margins, invalid actions, and strategic tendencies. Detailed analyses reveal language-specific failures in spatial reasoning, card-conditioned decisions, and optimal move selection. In some settings, changing only the intermediate reasoning language recovers much of the lost performance, suggesting that language can affect different stages of the decision process. These results show that skill discrepancies are a measurable major roadblock in the development of truly multilingual models. Better understanding these discrepancies can help us design models that perform more equitably across languages.
papers.summary_zh: 跨語言不一致研究多聚焦知識取用,較少探討同一模型是否在不同語言下展現不同的「技能」。本文將 TextArena 擴充為多語言版本(65 款遊戲、193 種語言,含人工校驗的核心集),設計自我對弈實驗:同一模型透過不同語言介面與自己對戰,規則、狀態與動作空間完全相同,藉此隔離語言效應。實驗以三個 4B 級開源模型(Gemma 4、Ministral 3、Qwen 3)在六種涵蓋空間推理、不完全資訊與重複賽局的遊戲、八種語言上進行,總計逾 51.8 萬場對局。結果顯示同一模型在不同語言下的勝負差距顯著:英文整體最強,希伯來文最弱;空間遊戲中阿拉伯文與希伯來文介面偏向直欄與對角線失誤;Kuhn Poker 的詐賭率隨語言變動逾兩倍;Nim 最優策略在弱勢語言下幾乎無法取用。讓模型以較強語言推理可回復部分落差,TicTacToe 中最高達 89%。靜態基準(Global-MMLU、Belebele)與網路資料可得性可解釋部分差異,書寫系統相近亦有利遷移。限制為僅測 3B–4B 模型且訓練資料不透明。此研究主張多語言評測應檢視行為一致性,而非僅比準確率。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Evaluation-methodology paper centered on LLMs: profiles six AI systems (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, o4-mini, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5-nano, Gemini 2.5 Flash) on eight demand-annotated cognitive dimensions and maps profiles onto expert-elicited workplace task requirements. Strong match to LLM evaluation, reasoning/planning capability assessment, and deployment-scoping preferences. Rigor is high: inter-rater reliability screening of annotations (Table A2), synthetic parameter-recovery motivating τ=1 and shared intercept (Tables 4-5), split-half noise-ceiling sample validation (Table B4), policy-parameter sensitivity sweeps (Tables C7-C8), and reported MCMC diagnostics. Main weaknesses: the core claim that suitability scores identify good deployment candidates is never validated against real task performance (acknowledged in §5.1), annotations rely on LLM judges with partially mitigated circularity, the battery underrepresents multimodal/agentic capabilities, and profiles cover base models rather than scaffolded agents. Builds incrementally on ADeLe and Measurement Layouts rather than introducing fundamentally new techniques. Code, rubrics, and annotations are publicly released.

papers.summary_zh: 組織部署 AI 時需判斷哪些任務可自動化,但彙總式基準分數難以預測實際成敗,專家直覺又迅速過時。本文提出一套以共同認知能力空間對齊代理與任務的流程:其一為認知能力輪廓,先以 GPT-4o 與 Gemini 3 Flash 依專家制定量規,為約 1.95 萬道基準題目標註 18 項認知需求層級,經信度篩選與階層群聚合併為八個維度,再以貝氏題目反應模型(Measurement Layouts、soft-min 集結、共享截距)從表現推論能力後驗,並以合成代理驗證復原(層級相關 r=0.98);其二為任務需求加權,對六個職域、410 名員工調查 18 種工作活動的重要性並分配能力點數;最後以加權幾何平均計算適配分數。剖析六個 AI 系統發現:輪廓形狀高度相似,語意記憶、語言與社會認知最強,規劃與物件恆存最弱;Gemini 3.1 Pro 憑資訊整合與控制、行動規劃與模擬的優勢,在幾乎所有活動居首。職場活動則收斂於共同認知核心。限制包括只量測重要性而非需求門檻、測驗電池偏文字任務且未涵蓋鷹架化代理。此框架提供可持續更新的任務適配評估工具,為人機任務分配鋪路。

links.title: Spectral Allocation: Why Muon Outperforms Adam, and How to Improve Muon

evidence: Abstract: SAMuon requires 13.3%-24.0% fewer training tokens to reach the same validation loss as Muon; SAMuon-lite retains most of this gain with near-zero wall-clock overhead.
Section 4.1: out-of-sample spectral probing measures loss-optimal step per singular direction of the momentum buffer on a disjoint held-out batch using a one-forward-pass LQA estimate.

Appendix A: LQA validated against golden-section line search over 773 probes; median relative deviation near 5% in the operationally relevant range; 0.52% of probes filtered for failed descent/curvature checks.
Section 6.1: 'Each optimiser configuration is evaluated with a single seed'; models 124M/300M/1B on FineWeb with 10B/20B-token budgets, trapezoidal schedule.
Section 6.2 / Table 1: both variants beat tuned AdamW and Muon (Scion) in every trained cell; SAMuon improvements 13.3%-24.0%, SAMuon-lite 13.3%-22.1%.
Appendix H: token-efficiency measured by fully annealed schedule-length matching (Algorithm 2) with false-position interpolation and confirmation runs.

Section 5.2 / Appendix F: convergence guarantee covers only idealized exact-whitening versions, preserving Muon's O(T^-1/4) stochastic and O(T^-1/2) deterministic rates with gamma-dependent constants.
Section 7: authors state SAMuon variants are under-tuned relative to the Muon baseline (shared schedule, hyperparameters transferred without re-tuning), possibly understating performance.
Appendix G.7 / Table 6: on the 1B model, SAMuon-lite adds 0.5% per-iteration wall-clock; SAMuon's svd_lowrank adds 7.4%, attributed to unoptimized kernels.
Appendix C: probing repeated at width 768 confirms the profile structure, but only two widths are probed and the square-root k-rule is presented as a calibrated heuristic, not a scaling law.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-training optimization paper: an out-of-sample spectral probing analysis of Transformer loss landscapes yields a 'spectral allocation' account of SGD<Adam<Muon and motivates SAMuon/SAMuon-lite, which hold the head at the Muon scale while amplifying the bulk. Preference relevance is high (LLM pretraining, optimizers, token efficiency, Transformer-specific). Novelty is solid but not maximal: the probing protocol (out-of-sample, per-rank LQA) is a genuine methodological contribution, yet the bulk-amplification idea overlaps with concurrent/adjacent work (Wang et al. 2026 curvature account, COSMOS, NorMuon) that the paper itself situates closely (Section 2). Rigor is good: LQA validated against golden-section line search at ~5% median deviation (Appendix A), probing replicated on AdamW trajectories and a second width (Appendices B-C), a convergence proof for the idealized exact-whitening variant (Appendix F), and tuned baselines under the Pethick et al. protocol. Caveats: single seed per configuration (Section 6.1), proof covers only the idealized exact-whitening form, and the width rule for k is a heuristic calibrated at two widths. Evidence strength is moderate-to-good: consistent wins across the 124M/300M/1B x 1024-4096 grid with full sweeps (Tables 1, 5) and careful token-efficiency matching with confirmation runs (Appendix H), but all results are on one architecture family (modded-nanogpt) with FineWeb, up to 1B/20B tokens, and the claimed headroom is explicitly an optimistic idealization (Section 4.2). Generalizability is limited by single-benchmark validation, untested larger scales, γ transferred without retuning, and acknowledged under-tuning of the proposed variants (Section 7). Reproducibility is aided by detailed hyperparameters, sweep tables, wall-clock breakdown (Table 6), and pseudocode, though no explicit code release is stated beyond building on the open Scion codebase.

We investigate this through an out-of-sample spectral probing analysis of Transformer loss landscapes. At checkpoints along real training trajectories, we decompose each momentum buffer into its singular directions and estimate the loss-optimal step size along each direction on held-out data. The resulting spectral profile is anisot
papers.summary_zh: Muon 等正交最佳化器能加速 Transformer 預訓練,但其機制仍未完全釐清。本文提出「樣本外頻譜探測」:在真實訓練軌跡的檢查點上,將動量緩衝區分解為奇異方向,於保留批次上以局部二次逼近量測各方向的損失最佳步長。測得的頻譜輪廓高度異向且跨批次、訓練階段與模型規模穩定:單一「易變頭部」位於 Edge-of-Stability、容許步長極小,其餘「寬容主體」則可放大數倍,近頭部衰減近似 log-rank 線性。此「頻譜配置」觀點統一解釋為何 Muon 優於 Adam、Adam 優於 SGD,同時暴露 Muon 的等比例縮放仍低估主體潛能。據此提出 SAMuon:保持頭部於 Muon 尺度並放大主體,完整版以秩-k 隨機 SVD 遵循實測輪廓,精簡版 SAMuon-lite 以秩一冪迭代取兩層近似,兩者皆不增加持久狀態、僅多一個超參數 γ,並附收斂保證。在 124M 至 1B 的 modded-nanogpt 上,兩種變體在所有模型規模與批次大小皆勝過調校後的 AdamW 與 Muon(Scion),SAMuon 省 13.3–24.0% 訓練 token,lite 以近零開銷保留多數增益。限制為排程未針對性調校、僅考慮區塊內頻譜與單一種子。此研究示範以量測驅動的最佳化器設計路徑。

Section 5.3.4: gradient decomposition 'cognitive complexity rises 54.4% at Level 1 and 39.8% at Level 2 (both p<0.001) and is indistinguishable from zero at Levels 3–4', with small strata (23 and 40 repositories).
Section 3.2.5: tool-specific bias chi-squared = 111.3, Cramer's V = 0.483, acknowledging measurement asymmetry across tool ecosystems.

Data Availability: 'A replication package is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21406147', with Study 2 outcomes from the publicly released dataset of Agarwal et al. and corporate data restricted by research agreements.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical study of LLM coding-agent adoption, squarely on-preference for Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM topics. Novel contribution is RAMP, an artifact-grounded (version-control-based) maturity instrument, plus a stratified reanalysis showing quality degradation concentrates in unconfigured repositories. Rigor is strong: Guttman scale validation (CR=0.997, CS=0.983), permutation tests, human annotation with honestly reported moderate inter-annotator agreement, staggered DiD with event studies and multiple robustness checks, and an unusually candid threats-to-validity section. Evidence is quantitative but explicitly observational and hypothesis-generating: maturity is measured at an end-of-panel snapshot (only 3.8% of agent-first L2+ repos committed artifacts pre-adoption), pre-trends are elevated for warnings, and model-capability/dose confounds are unresolvable. Generalizability is limited by 27 volunteering corporate orgs, tool-convention measurement asymmetry, and small L3/L4 strata. Reproducibility is aided by a Zenodo replication package, verbatim category templates, a specified embedding model, and a public Study 2 dataset, though corporate data cannot be released.
topics: empirical study of LLM tool adoption

primary_link.title: A Few Pages of Markdown: Committed AI Configuration and Lower Quality Cost after Coding-Agent Adoption

papers.summary: Coding agents increase development velocity but also technical debt. Prior work reports only average effects across adopters, hiding wide differences between teams. We introduce RAMP (Repository AI Maturity Profile), a four-level cumulative maturity model grounded in version-controlled artifacts that teams commit to configure AI tools. RAMP runs from behavioral rules and coding standards through named agent definitions to multi-agent orchestration, with observed practice concentrated in the firs
papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理提升開發速度也帶來技術債,但既有研究只報告採用者的平均效應,掩蓋團隊間差異。本文提出 RAMP(儲存庫 AI 成熟度輪廓),一個奠基於版本控制提交物的四級累積成熟度模型:L1 無設定、L2 提供行為規則與編碼標準等情境、L3 具名代理與可重用命令、L4 多代理協調。分類管線結合 12 種工具的檔名模式與路徑、內容語意嵌入,於 441 個企業儲存庫驗證:Guttman 量表的再現係數達 0.997,獨立人工標註在保留樣本上重現 97% 的儲存庫層級標籤。研究一顯示採用是累積、單向且一次到位:73.8% 的設定檔提交後從未修改。研究二將 Agarwal 等人的交錯雙重差分按成熟度分層重估,發現代理在各層級都加速開發(多 28–38% 提交),但在代理優先的層級中,無已提交 AI 設定的 L1 儲存庫認知複雜度增幅約為 L2+ 的兩倍(+53% 對 +27%),靜態分析警告為 1.7 倍。作者坦承成熟度屬觀察性,工程紀律或模型能力可能解釋部分差距,故定位為產生假說。此研究指出幾頁已提交的規則與標準即可對應約一半的品質劣化,RAMP 可作為未來研究與組織盤點的可重用工具。
