links.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models

evidence: Abstract/Contributions: DCGC combines task-specific SFT with Dynamic Dual-CFG, achieving 24.8% average accuracy over autoregressive and diffusion baselines on solver-failure hard sets.
Table 1: DCGC (LLaDA_SFT) scores 44.9 GSM8K, 22.3 MATH, 10.7 MBPP, 13.1 HumanEval, 35.7 MMLU-STEM, 22.5 MMLU-Pro vs. 18.9 avg for LLaDA_SFT standard sampling and 16.3 for best Self-Refine baseline.

Section 5 Implementation Details: alpha=0.5, beta=1.0 fixed from GSM8K validation across all benchmarks, while constant-scaling baselines are swept 0.5-2.0 and reported at max, a conservative comparison protocol.
Section 6.2 Table 3: draft relevance perturbation shows genuine draft use; MATH accuracy drops 22.3 (original) to 10.3 (shuffled) and 11.0 (domain-shifted).
Table 4: gold-agnostic full-set gains over Maj@5 are modest (GSM8K +0.16, MATH +2.01, MMLU-STEM +0.51), with correction-subset gains of +1.7/+3.1/+7.4.
Protocol inconsistency: Section 5 states hard sets are built from test-set failures of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, while Appendix B.2 states zero-shot inference on the training set of each benchmark.
Appendix E Table 8: transfer to DREAM backbone; DCGC reaches 42.6 GSM8K vs 17.4 for SFT standard sampling, supporting backbone generality.
Appendix G: token-level Spearman rho=0.167 (CI [0.150,0.182]) and example-level rho=0.195 (CI [0.070,0.314]) linking confidence gap to draft reuse, with shuffled-control verification.

Appendix B: detailed reproducibility info (55,440 train/2,913 validation samples, LoRA r=32 alpha=64, 3 epochs, 2xA100, 128 diffusion steps, block size 32) and full prompt templates in Appendix H; however, no code or artifact release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-focused methods paper squarely within preference scope: it proposes DCGC, using masked diffusion LMs (LLaDA-8B-Instruct) as draft-conditioned global correctors for LLM reasoning, with a novel Dynamic Dual-CFG inference mechanism (ReLU-gated relative confidence scaling between problem-only and problem-draft branches). Core preference match: Large Language Models, Reasoning & CoT, Code & Programming (MBPP/HumanEval), Training & Optimization (mixed-format SFT with LoRA). Novelty is solid: MDMs are repurposed from de novo generation to post-hoc correction, and the dual-branch confidence-gated CFG is a new inference-time mechanism for discrete diffusion, though built from established parts (CFG, InstructPix2Pix-style conditioning, self-refinement framing). Rigor is generally strong (matched SFT ablations, five guidance variants, scaling-function ablations, draft perturbation, gold-agnostic Maj@5 comparison, two source models, DREAM backbone transfer, hyperparameters fixed on GSM8K validation while baseline guidance weights are swept to their max), but is dented by a protocol inconsistency (Section 5 states hard sets come from the test set; Appendix B.2 states the training set), low absolute accuracies (24.8 avg), and modest full-set gains in the realistic gold-agnostic setting (+0.16 GSM8K, +0.51 MMLU-STEM, +2.01 MATH over Maj@5). Evidence strength is decent: consistent trends across six benchmarks plus mechanistic correlation analyses (Appendix G), but no error bars on main tables and a missing table reference ('Together with Table , ...'). Generalizability is supported by cross-source (Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-32B) and cross-backbone (DREAM) experiments, though limited by a 1,028-token length filter. Reproducibility is good on hyperparameters, dataset sizes, and full prompt templates, but no code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models

papers.summary: Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的自回歸生成一旦在推理初期出錯，錯誤便會沿前綴持續傳播，事後修正極為困難。本文提出DCGC，將遮罩擴散模型（MDM）轉化為草稿條件化的全域修正模組：以上游求解器產生的不完美草稿作為輔助情境，透過全域迭代去噪重新生成解答。方法包含混合格式監督微調（SFT），同時訓練僅依問題求解與依草稿修正兩種能力，並提出Dynamic Dual-CFG推論機制：將僅問題分支與問題加草稿的聯合分支分開，以兩者的相對信心差距（ReLU閘控）動態調控草稿殘差影響力，避免被誤導的草稿污染生成。在GSM8K、MATH、MBPP、HumanEval、MMLU-STEM與MMLU-Pro的求解失敗難例集上，DCGC平均達24.8%準確率，優於Self-Refine與各種CFG變體；擾動實驗顯示模型確實選擇性重用相關草稿；在無標準答案、僅以自我一致性挑選低共識樣本的設定下仍能提升整體準確率，並可遷移至DREAM等不同擴散骨幹。限制在於微調時以1,028 token過濾樣本，極長情境可能受限，觸發修正的不確定性訊號也較簡單。此工作確立「自回歸模型初解、擴散模型全域修正」的互補典範，為免驗證器的自我修正系統指出新方向。
papers.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: DCGC：以遮罩擴散模型進行草稿條件化的全域修正以處理複雜推理

links.title: TOPAS: Workflow-Aware Prefix-State Scheduling for Multi-Agent LLM Serving

evidence: Abstract: TOPAS reduces mean/p99 JCT by up to 39.8%/49.4% on synthetic workloads and by 22.0%/26.6% mean/p99 on MetaGPT-TL versus the best baseline per workload and metric.
Section II, Table I: grouped vs alternating ordering shows mean batch 9.3/4.7 at n=100 and 1.8-1.9x longer makespan under alternating, motivating the prefix-batching conflict.

Section V-A: implementation as a scheduling module in SGLang v0.5.3 on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB; all workloads use Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct; scheduler overhead averages 1.9 ms per decision and 0.31% of experiment wall time (MetaGPT-SOP at 0.15 task/s).

Section V-A: five baselines compared (FCFS, LPM, Parrot-FCFS, Autellix-LAS, SPF), all on the same SGLang backend with a shared fixed Poisson arrival trace; MetaGPT prompts sampled from the public MetaGPT SoftwareDev dataset.
Section V-C: ablation on MetaGPT-TL at 0.0175 task/s shows the full policy lowers mean/p99 JCT by 60.5%/53.6% relative to Topas-base, with both reuse and aging components contributing.

Section IV-E, Algorithm 1: hierarchical state search enumerates prefix sets for pools of size <= M and otherwise uses bounded greedy search with pair/repair steps, bounding large-pool search at O(|A_t|^2) prefix-set evaluations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: a systems paper on multi-agent LLM serving that jointly schedules agent-prefix KV residency and request admission, directly hitting Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), and Inference & Serving (1.5); clearly in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental in a crowded area: the claim of being first to jointly optimize prefix residency and admission under a shared KV budget is plausible and the formulation (Section III-IV, post-decision states with move/redo/revoke costs, aging, one-hop reuse lookahead) is distinct from KVFlow, Parrot, and Autellix, though the 'first' claim is self-asserted. Rigor is good: motivating microbenchmark diagnostics (Section II, Table I), formal capacity constraint, five baselines including Parrot-FCFS and Autellix-LAS, three synthetic DAGs plus two MetaGPT workloads with shared fixed arrival traces, and component ablations (Section V-C). Weaknesses: single GPU (A100 80GB) and single model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct), ablations only on MetaGPT-TL at one operating point, no variance/significance reporting, and per-metric 'best baseline' comparison can flatter results. Evidence strength is moderate-to-good with concrete numbers (e.g., 39.8%/49.4% mean/p99 JCT reduction on DAG-4; 9.8% mean JCT on MetaGPT-SOP, a more modest gain) and overhead accounting (1.9 ms/decision, 0.31% wall time), but figures cannot be verified from text alone. Generalizability is limited by the single hardware/model setup despite a model-agnostic design. Reproducibility is partial: SGLang v0.5.3 and public MetaGPT data are named, but key hyperparameters (beta, rho, H_age, M, K) are deferred to supplementary material and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: TOPAS: Workflow-Aware Prefix-State Scheduling for Multi-Agent LLM Serving

papers.summary: Prefix caching introduces a fundamental tradeoff in multi-agent large language model (LLM) serving: retaining a long system-prompt key-value (KV) cache for an agent accelerates future calls, yet it reduces the GPU memory available for batching concurrent requests. In multi-stage workflows, existing schedulers tend to prioritize either immediate prefix locality or overall workflow progress. However, under a shared KV cache budget, optimizing either objective in isolation can prolong tasklevel job
papers.summary_zh: 在多代理大型語言模型服務中，保留各代理長系統提示詞的KV快取可加速後續呼叫，卻佔用GPU記憶體而壓縮可並行批次；既有排程器往往只重視即時前綴局部性或整體工作流程進度，單獨最佳化任一目標都可能拉長任務完成時間。本文將此問題形式化為線上前綴狀態排程，提出TOPAS：在共享KV預算下同時決定保留哪些代理前綴與准許哪些請求執行。系統以階層式搜尋建構候選的決策後GPU狀態，並以JCT導向效用函數權衡三項因素：預期縮短各任務最長剩餘服務路徑的進展、近期可重複使用前綴的價值，以及前綴搬移與搶佔成本，另以任務層級老化機制防止飢餓。實作於SGLang框架，在三個合成DAG與兩個MetaGPT軟體開發流程上評估：相較各工作負載的最佳基準，TOPAS於合成工作負載將平均/p99 JCT最多降低39.8%/49.4%，於MetaGPT-SOP降低平均JCT 9.8%，於MetaGPT-TL降低22.0%/26.6%；消融實驗確認前綴重用估計與老化機制皆有必要。研究侷限於單一A100 GPU與特定負載型態。此研究首度將前綴駐留與請求准入納入工作流程層級的聯合排程，對多代理LLM服務的系統設計極具參考價值。
papers.title: TOPAS: Workflow-Aware Prefix-State Scheduling for Multi-Agent LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: TOPAS：為多代理LLM服務設計的工作流程感知前綴狀態排程

links.title: Assessing mentalization in humans and large language models

evidence: Abstract: 'We tested individual LLM agents across four model families, DeepSeek, GPT-4.1, GPT-5 and Gemini 2.0 Flash (N = 2,099), against opponents of varying sophistication' and benchmarked 'against human participants (N = 251)'.

Results, 'Assessing mentalization using the inspection game': 2x3 factorial ANOVA found significant main effects of model (partial eta^2 = 0.68, 95% CI [0.62, 0.72]) and prompt (partial eta^2 = 0.90, 95% CI [0.88, 0.91]); 'Whilst every model earned significantly higher payoffs under SCoT (Fig. 2a), the magnitude of this benefit varied'.

Results, inspection-game model comparison: LOOIC showed SCoT shifted winning models toward opponent-tracking (DeepSeek from RL, LOOIC 708, to fictitious play, LOOIC 5387; GPT-4.1 to influence play, LOOIC 8829), and 'GPT-5 was best fit by the influence play model (LOOIC = 16782, dELPD = +1152.6, SE = 39.8), demonstrating an ability for sophisticated reasoning without being explicitly cued'.

Results, 'Assessing adaptive mentalization using rock-paper-scissors': 'GPT-5 was the only group to show improved performance with increasing bot sophistication (beta = 0.057, SE = 0.007, t(2224) = 8.11, p = 8.4e-16)'; however adaptation-performance correlations 'none of the correlations survived correction' (Spearman rho 0.120-0.180, p_adj 0.2032-0.3271).

Methods, 'Parameter-behaviour correspondence' context (Results): 'these results remain interpretable only for human participants, and reflect challenges concerning the homogeneity of parameter estimates among LLM agents.'
Methods, Data and code availability: 'Data and code for modeling and analysis are available on request.'
Discussion, limitations: 'we specifically focus on a specific group of model providers and do not include any open-source models' and 'the outcome history was only provided to LLMs and not humans.'

Methods, Parameters and Power calculations: model versions pinned (gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, gpt-5-2025-08-07), temperature 0 for Gemini/DeepSeek/GPT-4.1 and temperature 1 with 'medium' reasoning_effort for GPT-5; GPower 3.1 analyses reported per test family, with required sample sizes met or exceeded.

Methods, Rock-paper-scissors LLM procedure: RPS choices recoded to letters 'J','Q','Z' to control semantic/positional choice bias, citing Vidler & Walsh (2025), with structured JSON outputs enforced via Pydantic schemas.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A machine-psychology study that directly hits top-weighted preferences: LLMs (four closed-model families, N=2,099 agents), reasoning/CoT (Social Chain-of-Thought elicitation, recursive-depth reasoning), and prompting (SCoT vs. standard prompt factorial comparison), with LLM agents playing strategic games. Novelty is moderate rather than high because the SCoT prompt, influence-play, CHASE, and ToMk models are adopted from prior human/LLM work (Akata et al. 2025; Buergi et al. 2026); the novel contribution is the human-vs-LLM comparative framing plus predictive/generative model validation applied to LLMs. Rigor is strong: a-priori power analyses (Methods, Power calculations), hierarchical Bayesian fitting with R-hat/ESS criteria, LOOIC model comparison, ROPE-based posterior-predictive checks, RFX-BMS, parameter recovery, Holm/Bonferroni/Greenhouse-Geisser corrections, J/Q/Z choice recoding to control text bias, and permutation validation of combining LLM instances. Evidence is substantial but not unblemished: the adaptation-performance correlations in the RPS task failed Holm correction (rho 0.12-0.18, p_adj 0.20-0.33, honestly reported), and generative fit was mixed (GPT-5 influence play missed switch rate; normal-prompt RL fits failed generative checks). The parameter-behaviour mapping is admitted to be interpretable only for humans due to near-zero LLM between-agent variance. Generalizability is limited to specific model versions/dates, two games, and no open-source models (Discussion limitations); a design asymmetry exists (choice history given to LLMs but not humans). Reproducibility is middling: model versions, temperature/reasoning_effort, and prompt design are documented, but data and code are only 'available on request' (Methods, Data and code availability) and closed APIs hinder exact replication.

primary_link.title: Assessing mentalization in humans and large language models

papers.summary: Mentalization - the ability to infer others' beliefs and intentions to guide one's own choices - is a key cognitive function underlying human social interactions. Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate behaviour consistent with humans on theory-of-mind tasks, yet whether these models can guide adaptive behaviour through mentalization is unknown. Here we use two economic games with cognitive computational modeling to uncover the latent strategies underlying mentalization in LLMs. We tested indi
papers.summary_zh: 心理化指推論他人信念與意圖以調整自身行為的認知能力。既有研究多以故事式心智理論測驗評估LLM，但僅能觀察表面選擇，難以確認背後的認知機制。本研究改用兩種經濟賽局——檢查賽局與剪刀石頭布——搭配認知計算模型，測試DeepSeek、GPT-4.1、GPT-5與Gemini 2.0 Flash共2,099個代理，與251名人類受試者比較，並檢驗社會思維鏈提示是否能提升表現。結果顯示LLM在兩種賽局均呈現明確的心理化行為與計算特徵，但隨模型提供者與規模差異甚大：SCoT提示普遍提升報酬，並使獲勝模型由強化學習轉為更高階的對手追蹤策略；GPT-5無需提示即以影響賽局模型描述，且在剪刀石頭布中是唯一隨對手推理層級提高而表現改善的群體，能正確調整遞迴深度，整體成績超越人類；DeepSeek則難以應對高階對手，SCoT亦無法有效矯正。人類資料同樣再現影響賽局與CHASE模型的良好擬合。限制包括所測模型皆為封閉原始碼、缺乏機制層級檢驗，提示與參數設定可能影響結果，且未涵蓋開源模型。此研究示範以計算建模作為跨人機比較智慧的正式方法，對評估LLM的社會認知具重要方法學意義。
papers.title: Assessing mentalization in humans and large language models
papers.title_zh: 評估人類與大型語言模型的心理化能力

links.title: Anchoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Systems: Prior Scores Compromise Evaluation Independence

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 192,000 attempted evaluations (185,271 successful) seven out of the eight evaluated models have 95% task-stratified bootstrap intervals below zero for the total anchored-metadata effect on 20 fixed texts.'

Section 3.2: C2 adds prior score 'a ~ U[0,3.99)', strictly below the 4.0 acceptance threshold; primary estimand Δ(C2−C0), with explicit note that Δ(C2−C1) 'does not isolate the numerical score because C2 also adds an attempt field.'

Section 3.5: 'This treats tasks, rather than repeated decodings, as the units for measuring sensitivity to the composition of the fixed benchmark' — 10,000 stratified task bootstraps; Table 1 discloses per-model incomplete-triplet rates (e.g., Llama-3.2-3B 27.4%).
Table 2 / Section 4.1: per-model effects (GPT-4.1 −0.411, Claude-4.5-Sonnet −0.706; Llama-3.1-8B −0.009 with CI [−0.054, 0.038] crossing zero); Section 4.3: code review weakest category (−0.047).

Section 5.1 and Table 4: GPT-4.1 token-probability redistribution from digit '5' to '4' (0.926→1.000 for '4') with near-zero within-C2 slope, described as threshold-like but explicitly 'observational evidence'; Section 5.2: partial replication only in Llama-3.2-3B.

Section 6 and Table 7: on one GPT-4.1 summarization pair, CoT worsens Δtotal from −0.429 to −0.633 (47.7% worsening) and warning to −0.457; authors state findings 'do not support a general numerical-mitigation recommendation.'

Section 7.2 and Table 9/10: on 441 human-labeled industry samples, Group A correction falls 21.62%→11.26% under C2; Group B paired accuracy falls 7.76 pp with 17/167 (10.18%) C0-correct cases flipped to the assigned wrong label; warning improves paired accuracy effect vs baseline.

Section 8 limitations: 'The main benchmark contains one generated and screened answer for each of 20 tasks, five per category'; 'Transfer to unseen tasks or models remains to be established'; anchors restricted to [0,3.99); industry validation is a single 441-sample domain.

Section 3.4 footnote 2: 'Code, prompts, rubrics, and statistical formulas: https://github.com/infobip/llm-judge-bias'; Section 7.1: proprietary messages disclosed only as aggregate group compositions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope: an empirical study of LLM-as-a-Judge bias (anchoring from prior-score metadata), matching high-weight preferences on LLMs, AI safety/bias, and LLM-judge evaluation; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: anchoring in LLMs and judge biases (position, self-preference) are established, but the below-threshold anchor regime, rubric-scoring setting, threshold-like token-probability pattern, and human-labeled industry validation are a genuine incremental contribution. Rigor is strong: task-stratified bootstrap over 20 tasks rather than treating decodings as independent, C0/C1/C2 decomposition with explicit refusal to over-decompose the C2 template confound, ceiling-robustness checks, paired designs, and clearly stated limitations. Evidence is substantial (185,271 valid responses, 8 models, 4 temperatures; 10.18% error induction with CI in categorical data), though inference covers only 20 fixed texts with one answer each and token-level probes are limited to selected model-task pairs. Generalizability is honestly capped by the authors themselves (fixed text set, one domain, [0,3.99) anchors only). Reproducibility is aided by a public code/prompt/rubric repository, but the proprietary industry dataset is unavailable. Mitigation findings (CoT worsens effect on one pair; warning helps only on categorical data) are appropriately scoped as non-general.

primary_link.title: Anchoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Systems: Prior Scores Compromise Evaluation Independence

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assess generated content, giving rise to the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm. These systems now score outputs, filter content, and gate iterative refinement in production pipelines, where each judgment is often assumed to be independent of earlier evaluations. We test this assumption using three prompt conditions: no metadata, revision framing, and anchored metadata containing revision, attempt, and prior-score fields. We show that prior scores, even when includ
papers.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge已成為自動評估生成內容的主流方式，其隱含假設是每次判斷彼此獨立；但在生產管線中，前次評分常以修訂中繼資料等形式殘留於情境視窗。本文檢驗此獨立性假設：設計三種提示條件——無中繼資料、僅修訂框架、含修訂次數與先前分數的定錨中繼資料，分數隨機取自低於4.0接受門檻的[0,3.99)，對八個模型與20篇固定文本進行192,000次嘗試評估（185,271次有效），並以任務分層bootstrap推論。結果顯示八個模型中有七個的定錨中繼資料總效應顯著為負，Cohen's d最高達0.71，接受率最多下降逾22個百分點；token機率探針顯示GPT-4.1呈現類門檻式的機率重分配。產業驗證（含人類標註的訊息活動合規分類）更顯示定錨中繼資料阻擋48%的錯誤修正，並使10.18%原本正確的判斷被翻轉為指定錯誤標籤。緩解方面，思維鏈反而加劇偏誤；明確警告雖在分類實驗改善配對準確率，卻無法消除數值任務的總效應。限制包括僅20篇文本、錨點範圍受限於門檻以下、token探針僅涵蓋特定模型與任務。結論強調可靠的LLM評估需謹慎的情境工程，排除實驗上無關的中繼資料仍是最直接的防護。
papers.title: Anchoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Systems: Prior Scores Compromise Evaluation Independence
papers.title_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge系統中的定錨偏誤：先前分數損害評估獨立性

links.title: When Is Noise Response Universal? Tokenization as the Hidden Variable in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims word-level noise yields near-identical degradation curves across architectures while character-level noise separates models, and 'improving accuracy under noise by up to 19% while preserving clean performance'
Universality of Embedding Models section: word-noise decay rates 1.41-1.57 all containing k~1.5 vs character rates 5.68-8.70 with no common overlap; CV 2.2% vs 14.2%; ICC 0.14±0.01 vs 0.60±0.02

The Objective Installs Universality section: eight encoders across six pretraining paradigms shift from exponent CV 71% (inter-model CV 14.3%) to k in [1.41,1.57] (CV 3.2%, inter-model CV 2.8%) after an identical InfoNCE recipe (tau=0.05, 50K SNLI pairs, 5K steps)

Universality of Decoder-Only LLMs section: 18 LLMs across 9 families show word CV 2.0% (95% CI [1.4,2.3]) vs character CV 4.8% ([3.3,5.8]), non-overlapping; ICC 0.007±0.002 vs 0.046±0.012; amplitude A_m varies 0.53-0.75

Tokenization Causes the Split section: character edit induces 4-10x token-edit distance of word dropout (Table 11: 6.2x-9.8x across five tokenizers); CANINE retains 70% vs 49-55% for subword models at eps=0.1

Reshaping the Noise Response by Training / Table 7: noise-augmented SFT cuts character JS 0.30->0.17 but raises cross-model CV from 4.9% to ~12%; AG-News +13 and SST-2 +19 points at eps=0.3 with clean accuracy preserved

Limitations section: character/word scales only, token-edit distance a mediator not sufficient statistic (3x residual asymmetry at matched distance), JS readout restricts to open-weight English models
Appendix F: exact software versions (PyTorch 2.6.0, Transformers 4.44.2) and single-GPU feasibility; all models/datasets public via Hugging Face Hub; no explicit code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/NLP methodology paper (in scope): measures noise-response universality across 9 embedding models and 18 decoder-only LLMs (GPT-2, Qwen2.5/3, Llama, Phi, Mistral, DeepSeek, Yi), attributing the word/character noise split to tokenizer-driven re-segmentation and to shared contrastive objectives. Strong match to LLM, NLP, and training/robustness preferences; no overlap with reasoning, agents, or Japanese preferences. Novelty is solid: framing degradation curves via statistical-physics universality classes and identifying tokenization as the mediating 'hidden variable' is a fresh angle on a well-studied robustness literature. Rigor is above average: three triangulated measures (bootstrap-CI decay exponents, cross-model CV, carefully constructed per-input ICC in Appendix B), a before/after causal objective experiment (k 2.1-9.7 collapsing to [1.41,1.57]), a predictive test confirmed by a character-level CANINE backbone, a continuous token-perturbation knob (Fig. 7), and honest limitations (token-edit distance not sufficient, English-only, open-weight only). Evidence is extensive but with modest absolute effect sizes on the LLM side (ICC 0.007 vs 0.046; CV 2.0% vs 4.8%), a single contrastive recipe tested for the causal claim, downstream gains shown on only two tasks/models, and a mild internal tension where Appendix H's stretched-exponential cooperativity (word beta=1.181) complicates the single-exponent universality narrative. Generalizability is constrained (no semantic perturbations, English only). Reproducibility is good (public models/datasets, exact library versions and hyperparameters in Appendix F) but no explicit code release.

primary_link.title: When Is Noise Response Universal? Tokenization as the Hidden Variable in Language Models

papers.summary: The performance of textual neural models often degrades when their inputs are corrupted by noise such as typos, OCR errors, or dropped words. We study the degradation rate across neural models, both sentence embeddings and decoder-only LLMs, and find that how consistent it is depends on the scale of the noise: under word-level noise, models with very different architectures decline along nearly the same curve, while under character-level noise they separate. We further identify the determining f
papers.summary_zh: 部署中的NLP系統常遭遇打字錯誤、OCR誤讀或語音轉文字等雜訊，但實務缺乏在未逐一進行雜訊評估下預測模型穩健性的工具。本文研究九個對比式句向量模型與18個decoder-only LLM在詞級與字元級雜訊下的退化曲線，發現明確的尺度分裂：詞級雜訊下，架構迥異的模型幾乎沿同一條正規化退化曲線下滑（跨模型變異係數約2%）；字元級雜訊則明顯分歧（句向量模型14.2%、LLM 4.8%）。跨架構實驗證明主因是訓練目標而非架構：八個涵蓋六種預訓練範式的編碼器原本分散，經相同的對比式訓練後收斂至共同曲線。機制上，單一字元編輯迫使分詞器重新切分周圍詞彙，造成的token編輯距離是整詞刪除的4至10倍，且因分詞器而異，故共用分詞器的模型在字元雜訊下分歧較小；字元級骨幹CANINE亦如預期保持穩健。實務上，在普遍性區間內，模型乾淨準確率即可預測其退化曲線（留一誤差3.5%）；雜訊增強訓練可提升穩健性最多19%，但無法創造普遍性，因後者源自訓練時的共享約束。限制包括僅涵蓋字元與詞級擾動、僅英語與開源模型。此發現揭示分詞是模型穩健性背後的隱藏變數，對部署與訓練決策深具實用指引。
papers.title: When Is Noise Response Universal? Tokenization as the Hidden Variable in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 雜訊反應何時具普遍性？分詞是語言模型的隱藏變數

links.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks

evidence: Abstract: '13 frontier large language models (LLMs) achieve scores ranging from 0.00 for Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite to 0.48 for GPT 5.6 Sol' across 20 tasks and 138 artifacts

Section 4.4: artifact grading via row/column F1, Lin's CCC, macro F1, and overlap F1, with 0.80 binary pass threshold 'chosen based on domain-expert review' (Appendix A.3 reports Spearman rho=0.76, p=1.3e-5 between expert ratings and artifact scores)
Section 2.2: 'for tasks with more than 100 GB of raw input data, models scored only 0.10 on average, compared with 0.34 for tasks with 50-100 GB and 0.37 for tasks with less than 50 GB'
Section 2.3: 'each BixBench3 task attempt used 102 million tokens, 6.8 hours, and 695 model turns' with a 367-fold average cost spread from $0.35 to $129.14 per task
Section 2.4 / 4.5: failure-mode tags assigned by a single LLM judge (GPT 5.5); total tag count negatively correlated with mean task score (Spearman rho=-0.92, p=9.9e-6)

Section 3.2 Limitations: 'BixBench3 does not test the ability of agents to decide which analyses or questions are worth pursuing' and the benchmark 'inherits any limitations that may be present in its source papers'

Data and Code Availability: 'Code to run BixBench3 is available on GitHub, and the dataset itself is available on Hugging Face'; Sections 4.2-4.3 document the VM, Docker, Inspect AI ReAct harness, tools, and per-model thinking-effort settings; Appendix A.5 gives the complete example task prompt
llm_evaluation.rationale: A long-horizon agent benchmark evaluating 13 frontier LLMs executing full computational-biology studies from raw data, squarely matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences (ReAct harness, tool use, benchmark/LLM-judge evaluation). It is not a pure domain application: the methodology is entirely language-model agent evaluation, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Novelty is moderate: it is the third iteration of the authors' own BixBench line, and the related-work section shows close neighbors (GeneBench-Pro, SpatialBench-Long, scBench-Long, SWE-Marathon), with the main advance being study-scale horizon (24h, ~102M tokens/task) and programmatic artifact grading. Rigor is strong: expert-calibrated 0.80 pass threshold (Spearman rho=0.76, Appendix A.3), defined grading metrics (F1, Lin's CCC, macro F1, overlap F1, Section 4.4), controlled identical Inspect AI harness and VM environment (Section 4.2-4.3), Mann-Whitney U/Fisher tests with BH correction, and a cache-adjusted cost sensitivity analysis; weaknesses include a single unvalidated LLM judge for failure tags (Section 4.5) and only 20 tasks with transcriptomics dominance (16/20). Evidence is quantitative and specific (0.48 top score; 0.10 vs 0.37 score gap on >100GB vs <100GB tasks; rho=-0.92 failure-tag correlation; 367-fold cost spread). Generalizability is limited by the biology-specific, transcriptomics-heavy task distribution, though cost/depth/data-scale findings speak to agent capability broadly. Reproducibility is strong: GitHub code, Hugging Face dataset, full example prompt, environment and per-model effort settings documented.

primary_link.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks

papers.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) promises to accelerate biological research by automating computational analyses. Yet the ability of AI agents to carry out computational biology at the scale of complete research studies has not been systematically evaluated. Here we introduce BixBench3, a benchmark that measures the capacity of AI agents to process raw biological data through to scientific results. We designed BixBench3 tasks to mirror the delegation of work from a scientist to an agent: the scienti
papers.summary_zh: AI代理雖能執行零散的生物資訊分析，但能否完成整個研究等級的計算生物學研究仍未被系統評估。本文提出BixBench3：從已發表論文建構20個任務與138個待產出的資料工件，代理須接收研究目標、方法指引與原始資料，逐步執行分析並產出如peak呼叫矩陣、差異表現表等工件，再以程式化方式與原論文工件比對評分（行列F1、Lin's CCC、類別macro F1與基因組區間重疊），以0.80為通過門檻。評測13個前沿模型，成績介於0.00（Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite）與0.48（GPT 5.6 Sol）之間，Kimi K3、GLM 5.2與Claude Opus 4.8相近。代理在原始資料超過100GB的任務平均僅得0.10，遠低於較小資料集的0.36；需要三步以上連續分析的工件（0.24）也明顯難於一至兩步（0.36）。平均每任務耗時6.8小時、1.02億token與43美元，最長嘗試達24小時與525美元；值得注意的是高分模型反而使用較少token且更便宜。以LLM裁判標註的失敗模式顯示過早終止與重複重試迴圈與低分關聯最強。限制在於任務已指定分析方法，故僅測試執行指定管線的能力而非自行選題，且繼承原論文可能的錯誤。此為目前時程最長的生物學代理基準，指出資料規模與長分析鏈是關鍵瓶頸。
papers.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
papers.title_zh: BixBench3：以研究規模的計算生物學任務評測AI代理

links.title: Provenance Before Prose: Claim-Locked Reporting

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'claim-locked reporting,' fixes 'the evidence source, numbers, direction, and allowed language strength of each reportable claim before the LLM writes connective wording'; improves reproducibility over hybrid template by 37.4 and 20.5 points; code at github.com/XiuFan719/Claim-Locked-Reporting.
§5.1 (Table 1): hybrid template 61.1% reproducibility vs claim-locked 98.5%; paired bootstrap 20,000 resamples 95% CI [+15.1, +59.7] — wide interval given n=20 cells per method.

§5.1: 'A ledger-rendered system is expected to reach a high absolute value, so the informative quantity is the 37.4-point gap over the hybrid template' — acknowledges the headline metric is partly by construction.

§5.4 (Table 5, Appendix E): RCT direction audit shows claim-locked 0.0% inversion rate vs 5.6–14.3% for baselines; second-reviewer agreement 98.0%, Cohen's κ=0.970 on a 50-report stratified subset; audits involve authors/team members only (Ethics Statement).
Appendix F (Table A5): manual calibration of numerical flags — claim-locked 0 harmful fabrications vs hybrid 20 (2.5%) and free-form 47 (5.9%), reversing raw-Num ordering interpretation.
§5.5 (Table 6): claim-locked ranks lowest under FActScore (0.552) but highest under SelfCheckGPT (0.974); documented false-pass (score 1.00 on an inverted direction) and false-reject cases.

Limitations: 'The protocol is transferable at the control level but domain-specific in instantiation: a minimal deployment still needs a claim schema, entity inventory, risk tags, and audit patterns'; institutional FC cohort cannot be redistributed; public HCP S1200 and Evidence Inference 2.0 settings included with prompts, reports, and audit scripts released.

§4: two writer providers (Moonshot kimi-k2.6, DeepSeek deepseek-v4-pro), 7 methods, multiple seeds/providers; Appendix B.1: 'Exact executable prompt templates, including dynamically injected fields and JSON schemas, are released with the code.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM reliability paper: it targets faithfulness/grounding of LLM-generated statistical reports (Abstract: 'Large language models (LLMs) can fluently verbalize statistical evidence... We frame these failures as a control problem'), with structured output and post-hoc verification baselines and a diagnostic analysis of FActScore/SelfCheckGPT (§5.5), matching LLM, RAG/knowledge-grounding, and evaluation preferences; it is not a pure medical-imaging paper since the methodology is generation control, though both testbeds are medical-flavored (fMRI, RCT), which caps domain breadth. Novelty is moderate: the core mechanism (deterministic rendering of pre-selected content plus LLM connective prose) is close to classical content-planning/surface-realization NLG (§2 cites Reiter and Dale 2000), with the 'claim-level control' framing, risk auditor/policy controller, and cross-run reproducibility stress test as the fresher elements. Rigor is solid but not flawless: well-controlled hybrid-template contrast (§5.1), paired bootstrap CIs (fMRI CI [+15.1, +59.7] is very wide at n=20 cells), component ablation (Table A2), blinded human audits with κ=0.970 (Appendix E), and honest limitations admitting reproducibility is 'necessary but not sufficient' and that a ledger-rendered system 'is expected to reach a high absolute value,' so headline 98.5% vs 61.1% is partly by construction. Evidence is quantitatively supported: Table 5 shows 0.0% direction inversion vs 5.6–14.3% for baselines; Appendix F calibration finds 0 harmful fabrications vs 2.5% (hybrid) and 5.9% (free-form); Table 6 documents concrete FActScore false-pass/false-reject cases. Generalizability is limited by per-domain instantiation needs (Limitations: 'a minimal deployment still needs a claim schema, entity inventory, risk tags, and audit patterns'). Reproducibility is good: public code link (Abstract), released prompts/reports/audit scripts (Limitations, Appendix B.1), public HCP S1200 and Evidence Inference 2.0 settings, though the institutional fMRI cohort cannot be redistributed.

primary_link.title: Provenance Before Prose: Claim-Locked Reporting

We frame these failures as a control problem: the evidence-bearing content of a scientific report should be fixed by structured statistical results rather than sampled during prose generation. We therefore use cross-run reproducibility to stress-test whether report-visible numbers and
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型能流暢撰寫統計報告，卻可能漂移數值、反轉效應方向，或將閾值化比較誇述為類別效應。本文將此類統計主張失真視為控制問題：報告中承載證據的內容應由結構化統計結果事先固定，而非在行文時被取樣。既有控制分為文本層（提示、檢索、結構化輸出、事後驗證）與槽位層（混合模板），但LLM仍決定陳述哪些發現及其強度。作者提出主張鎖定報告此第三層控制：主張建構器將證據記錄轉為主張帳冊，風險稽核器與政策控制器決定哪些主張可陳述及其允許語氣強度，決定性渲染器直接輸出數字與方向標籤，LLM僅撰寫連接性文字。在肥胖相關fMRI功能連結報告與Evidence Inference 2.0隨機對照試驗報告上，主張鎖定的跨種子再現率達98.5%與100.0%，分別較混合模板提升37.4與20.5點；盲測人類稽核顯示其方向反轉率為0%，遠低於基準的5.6%至14.3%，同時降低無保留的過度斷言，token用量與生成延遲亦最低。消融顯示決定性渲染主導穩定性，稽核與政策控制降低過度主張。限制包括上游統計有誤時無法補救、風險分類屬特定領域，且再現率高不保證正確。此協議為可靠統計文本生成劃出清晰的責任邊界。

links.title: Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results

evidence: Abstract: tight-window Verified comparison (169 tasks, 20,480-token window, 480s endpoint) raises mean per-task F2PF from 28% to 49% and complete solutions from 43 to 72
Section 3.5: exact two-sided McNemar for resolution, exact sign test for F2PF direction, repository-level sensitivity with 20,000 bootstrap resamples (seed 20260815)
Section 3.1: untreated Yuj validated against mini-SWE-agent v2.2.8, 87.6% outcome agreement, Cohen's kappa 0.66

Table 9 (A.3): treatment used ~2x model work under pressure (Verified turns 3,280/6,517, prompt tokens 37.8M/80.7M, wall time 1.3/4.6 h); Section 6.4 states this is a package effect, not compute-matched efficiency
Section 4.2/Tables 6-8: at 262,144 tokens Verified F2PF difference -0.3 pp [-4.5,+3.9] and Pro 0.99 ratio, showing treatment advantage largely disappears without pressure
Section 3.2/A.2: Pro cohort screened by reading-demand threshold; cross-window campaigns collected successively so window size is not isolated from run-era change
Table 1 & A.10: no component ablation of detector vs. view rule (deferred to Section 7.1); exploratory 15-task probes show no alternative setting beat frozen caps
A.11: public repo contains harness, configs/paper/ layers, provenance JSON, and task_outcomes.tsv, but benchmark task lists, evaluators, and raw runs are explicitly excluded
Section 6.4: all four models served locally at 4-bit Q4_K_XL; hosted frontier models, higher-precision weights, and human patch-quality judgment out of scope
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope agentic-LLM/coding work: paired harness-vs-harness study on SWE-bench Verified/Pro and FeatureBench with four open-weight LLMs directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents, LLMs, Code, Long Context). Methodologically strong: exact McNemar/sign tests, Holm correction, repository-cluster bootstrap sensitivity, a control-vs-mini-SWE-agent sanity check (kappa 0.66), and unusually honest confound disclosure. Key caveats that cap the score: gains are a package effect with no component ablation; under pressure treatment performed roughly twice the model work (Table 9), so the headline F2PF jumps (28->49 Verified) are not compute-matched, and the wide-window nulls on Verified/Pro show the benefit is mostly surviving the context limit; one greedy trajectory per arm, 4-bit local models only, cross-window rows confounded by run era, and Pro cohort screened on reading demand. Novelty is moderate since individual mechanisms (context truncation, repetition detection) are acknowledged as standard and harness effects are folk knowledge; the contribution is the controlled paired demonstration. Reproducibility is partial: public harness, configs, provenance, and task outcomes, but no raw runs, evaluators, or task lists.

primary_link.title: Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results

papers.summary: A coding agent combines a model with a harness, which decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how the work continues. We ask whether changing the harness changes the result when the model and task stay fixed. We compare two configurations of the same harness on three coding benchmarks. The control supplies the full conversation in time order, while the treatment keeps the same record but mechanically shortens older tool results as the context fills and responds to repeated or st
papers.summary_zh: 程式撰寫代理由模型與harness組成：harness決定模型看到什麼、可使用哪些工具，以及工作如何延續。本文追問：固定模型與任務，僅改變harness是否會改變結果？作者以自研的Yuj框架進行配對實驗：控制組按時間順序提供完整對話記錄；實驗組以固定規則機械式縮短較舊的工具輸出（半衰期策略）、偵測重複失敗或停滯並介入，並防範常見指令問題。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上於SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro與FeatureBench比較：在20,480 token的緊縮情境下，Verified的每任務平均F2PF由28%升至49%，完整解題數由43增至72，三個壓力情境的配對檢定均達p<0.0001；Pro的完整解題亦由31增至72。同一凍結處理套件未經調整即套用於Devstral、Nemotron與Qwen3.8，皆同時提升兩項指標，其中Devstral提升逾兩倍。當情境放寬至262,144 token時，Verified與Pro的差異趨近於零，但FeatureBench仍保留顯著的F2PF增益；處理也將閱讀邊界推高逾兩倍。限制包括僅測試本地四位元權重、每任務單一貪婪軌跡，且未與模型摘要或檢索式視野比較。核心啟示是：被測試的求解者是模型加harness的整體，評測報告應完整揭露harness與情境政策。

links.title: MACGen: Toward Functionally Correct and Secure Code Generation via Multi-Agent Collaboration

Section 5.3 / Table 3: MACGen uses 220,916 total tokens ($0.91) vs INDICT 1,411,754 tokens ($4.68) on 25 Python CWEval tasks.
Table 4 (ablation, CWEval/GPT-4o): full config 70.59 F&S@1 vs no-agent baseline 50.42; Security Advisor alone gives 66.39 but with Func@1 drop to 73.95.
Tables 11-12 / Appendix I: MACGen vs MACGen-Shared (GPT-4o-mini CWEval: 66.39 vs 46.22 F&S@1), supporting the artifact-only coordination claim.
Table 6: HumanEval/HumanEval+ roughly matches Direct (e.g., GPT-4o 92.1 vs 89.0) with early exit triggered on 164/164 tasks, addressing general-capability regression.

Footnote 2: 'All source code, evaluation logs, and prompts are available at https://github.com/Mishuni/macgen-secure-code.git'; Appendix K provides agent prompts; Appendix C documents KB sources (OWASP ASVS 5.0.0, SEI CERT), FAISS indexing, and temperature 0.0.
Limitations: multi-agent architecture 'incurs additional inference cost compared to single-pass methods'; evaluation granularity of security scope vs over-engineering acknowledged as open.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-relevant: an inference-time multi-agent LLM framework (Planner/Security Advisor/Generator/Reviewer) for secure code generation, touching LLMs (w2.5), agents (w2.5), code generation (w2.0), RAG/knowledge injection (w1.8), and security (w2.0). Main novelty is moderate: artifact-only interfaces to prevent role interference and task-specific guideline synthesis from standards-grounded KBs build incrementally on INDICT, CodeSIM, SecGuide, CodeGuarder, and RESCUE. Rigor is generally strong: two main benchmarks (CWEval 119 tasks/5 languages; BaxBench 392 tasks/6 languages), six LLMs, five baselines with original-paper hyperparameters, component ablations (Table 4-5, 8, 9), artifact-vs-shared-context comparison (Tables 11-12), HumanEval(+) safety check (Table 6), token/cost analysis (Table 3), CWE error analysis and early-exit audit (Fig 7, Table 10), and LLMSecEval supplementary eval (Table 14). However, Table 2 contains 'xx.xx' placeholder cells for several baselines under GPT-5.1 and Claude Sonnet 5, which weakens evidence for those comparisons and signals incomplete reporting; main results also rely on single runs at temperature 0.0, partially mitigated by a k=3 sampling study (Table 7). Evidence strength is good overall (arithmetic of reported averages checks out: 19.61pp/10.57pp), but docked for placeholder cells. Generalizability is supported by model/language breadth but constrained by benchmark-oracle-defined security scope (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is decent: GitHub code/logs/prompts (footnote 2), full agent prompts in Appendix K, frozen KB snapshot, open-source KB pipeline; minor concern that KB refinement uses GPT-5.1, a stronger model than some evaluated targets.

primary_link.title: MACGen: Toward Functionally Correct and Secure Code Generation via Multi-Agent Collaboration

papers.summary: Despite their strong ability to generate code, large language models often fail to produce secure code, as their outputs frequently contain security vulnerabilities. Secure code generation is inherently challenging because it requires solving a multi-objective problem: functional correctness and security. Existing approaches address this challenge by injecting external security knowledge or by using agentic feedback and iterative refinement. However, guideline retrieval often leaves the generato
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型雖能生成程式碼，但輸出常含安全漏洞，而強化安全又常犧牲功能正確性。本文提出 MACGen，一個多代理人協作框架，將安全程式碼生成拆解為規劃、安全分析、程式碼合成與審查四個階段，分別由 Planner、Security Advisor、Code Generator 與 Reviewer 負責。有別於共用對話記錄的設計易產生角色干擾與上下文膨脹，MACGen 採用「僅傳遞結構化產物」的介面，每位代理人只接收上游的計畫書與安全指引等成品，以架構本身強化角色分工。Security Advisor 依據 CERT、OWASP 等標準建構知識庫，結合檢索與草稿程式碼分析，合成任務專屬的安全指引。在 CWEval 與 BaxBench 上，MACGen 的 F&S@1 分別較直接提示平均提升 19.61 與 10.57 個百分點，跨多種 LLM 與八種程式語言維持穩定，且僅以 INDICT 約 16% 的 token 成本達成更高分數；消融實驗顯示各代理人與指引合成步驟皆有貢獻。限制方面，多代理人架構仍比單次推理耗費更多運算，且安全措施與過度工程的界線難以在現有評測中精確刻畫。此研究示範了以介面設計強制角色分離，可同時兼顧功能與安全，為 SSDLC 式安全開發流程提供可行的 LLM 實作路徑。
papers.title: MACGen: Toward Functionally Correct and Secure Code Generation via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.title_zh: MACGen：透過多代理人協作邁向功能正確且安全的程式碼生成

Table 2 (Section 6): TSIM achieves highest accuracy in all three backend blocks (69.6 Gemma2:9b, 80.2 Gemini 2.5 Flash, 73.8 GPT-4o-mini); the tuned non-episodic control reaches 56.2 with 3.0k context tokens vs TSIM's 1.0k.

Table 3 (Section 6.3): progressive ablation under GPT-4o-mini rises monotonically 26.2 (Std RAG) → 43.4 (fixed-token) → 55.5 (semantic-drift) → 74.2 (full stack), isolating segmentation and multi-view contributions.
Appendix F Table 29: paired bootstrap 95% CI for TSIM vs MemGPT under Gemini 2.5 Flash is [4.15, 6.97], the closest API-backed comparison.

Appendix A.1: blind realism audit on 300 stratified examples with three anonymous annotators, mean pairwise Cohen's κ=0.895 and 99.0% majority-gold agreement; Table 8 reports naturalness 3.80, answerability 4.91.

Appendix E.2 Table 23: LongMemEval-S diagnostic labeled 'transductive transfer diagnostic rather than a held-out generalization estimate'; TSIM 71.0% vs 61.2% context-matched fixed-chunk control, boundary-assisted session row 74.4% not significantly better (McNemar p=0.1109).

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM conversational-memory evaluation paper squarely within scope: it introduces SCALE-QA (flat, unsegmented, mixed-topic threads with counterfactual constraints and exact evidence traces) and TSIM (streaming semantic-drift episode segmentation + raw/summary/cluster multi-view indexing + evidence-first episode ranking), targeting RAG/long-context/agent-memory readers. Methodologically the work is unusually thorough: six baselines (Standard RAG, Hybrid-RRF, RAPTOR, MemGPT, HippoRAG, plus a tuned non-episodic control), three backends, full-dataset 3,000-question runs, a progressive ablation (26.2→43.4→55.5→74.2), threshold sensitivity with CIs, paired-bootstrap significance, variance/token audits, a 300-example blind human audit (κ=0.895), and a LongMemEval-S transfer diagnostic. Novelty is solid but the building blocks (embedding-drift segmentation, multi-granularity retrieval) are recombination; the episode-integrity framing is the main conceptual contribution. Key caveats: the authors built both benchmark and method, TSIM constants were calibrated on dev splits of the same distribution while several baselines use paper-default settings, all headline evidence is self-generated on the new benchmark, and the transfer diagnostic is explicitly transductive rather than held-out (Appendix E.2). Counterfactual synthetic construction and four-way MCQ grading limit distributional and behavioral generalization, as the limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is strong: public dataset/code, deterministic runtime builder, exact frozen constants (Table 18), and reproduction manifests.
topics: LLM backend evaluation (GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemma2:9b)

primary_link.title: Reconstructing the Right Episode: Evaluating Interleaved Conversational Memory Beyond Long Context

papers.summary: Conversations with chat assistants increasingly span many topics in a single long-running thread, challenging memory systems. Existing long-context and memory benchmarks often expose session or topic boundaries, or probe direct personal-memory questions. These settings understate a harder assistant-memory regime: a flat mixed-topic thread where the system must infer which earlier episode makes a later task decision valid. We introduce SCALE-QA, a constraint-grounded task QA benchmark for flat un
papers.summary_zh: 真實助理對話常在單一長對話串中交錯多個主題，早期埋下的區域性約束可能在數千輪後才決定某個問題的正確答案。現有長上下文與記憶基準多半揭露主題或章節邊界，無法隔離此類失敗。本文提出「情節完整性失敗」概念：決定性證據雖存在於對話中，系統卻檢索出片段、過時預設或過度壓縮的摘要，而非完整的「作用中情節」。為此作者建構 SCALE-QA，一個含 3,000 道經審核問題、橫跨 10 個領域、以約束為基礎的四選一基準，並附確定性的長度可控執行環境建構器。參考方法 TSIM 先以語意漂移規則將輪次流串流式分割為情節，再以原始、摘要與叢集路由三種檢視建立多視圖索引，最後以證據優先的評分回傳最相關情節。在 128k 設定下，GPT-4o-mini 的完整上下文準確率僅 29.8%，TSIM 達 73.8%；三種後端上 TSIM 皆最佳，較最強基線提升 5.6 至 17.6 個百分點，且在 1M token 診斷中以約 1.3k 檢索 token 達 96.5%，優於耗費 1.05M token 的完整上下文。限制包括資料為反事實合成、選擇題格式無法涵蓋開放式回答。其意義在於指出：長對話記憶的瓶頸不是上下文長度，而是能否重建使證據生效的正確情節。

evidence: Abstract: 'degrading key retrieval metrics such as the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of state-of-the-art models by up to 77%'

Sec 3.1 Threat Model: white-box access to a surrogate embedding model, attack targets the indexing phase via 'corpus poisoning and software supply-chain attacks', AST-preserving identifier renaming constraint

Sec 4.2 Table 2: 'our transferred attack achieves about a 5x higher Delta Sim. than CodeAttack while reducing the required queries from ~10.8M API calls to 1k calls' (18.66 vs 10.45 white-box; 28.03 vs 5.18 black-box)
Sec 4.3 Table 3: 10% corpus attack on CosQA drops CodeT5+ MRR 74.08 to 1.79 and Voyage-code-3 MRR 87.06 to 9.52

Sec 4.7 Table 7: w/o gradient reduces Delta Sim from 38.86 to 30.91 on CodeT5+; w/o query token similarity reduces Nomic transfer from 39.25 to 22.68; style preservation is neutral on embeddings but critical for LLM transfer (Table 5)
Sec 4.6 Table 6: Robust-Only FT drives Delta Sim to -22.70 but MRR falls 72.4 to 34.1; Mixed FT keeps MRR 72.3 yet 'remains highly vulnerable' to adaptive white-box attack (Delta Sim 34.70)
Sec 4.5 Table 5: two adversarial candidates reduce GPT-5.4-mini accuracy from 96 to 81 (Python) and Gemini-3.1-Pro from 95 to 79
Appendix A Limitations: 'the underlying causes of this transferability remain unclear... we cannot draw a definitive conclusion'

Appendix B Reproducibility: 'we do not publicly release the attack codebase... researchers... are encouraged to contact the first author'; compute reported in Table 8 (6.8 GPU-hours for 10k CodeT5+ attacks)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope adversarial-robustness paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (Code & Programming, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, plus RAG-style embedding retrieval and LLM targets). It is not a pure domain application. The method (gradient-guided, style-preserving identifier renaming with query-token similarity, optimized on a small surrogate and transferred to larger/closed-source models) is a sensible but incremental combination of known ingredients (DAMP-style gradient attacks, semantic-preserving transformations, Wan et al. corpus poisoning), with the transfer-to-LLM-retrieval result the most novel element. Rigor is strong: explicit threat model (Sec 3.1), 20k pairs on two benchmarks, baseline comparisons with cost accounting (Table 2), component ablations (Table 7), hyperparameter and iteration ablations (E.10), shared-corpus and cross-language studies, and an honest defense analysis showing adaptive white-box attacks defeat Mixed FT (Table 6/19). Evidence is quantitative and traceable (MRR drops to 1.79-9.52 in Table 3; 5x Delta-Sim over CodeAttack at 1k vs 10.8M calls in Table 2), though no seed variance/significance testing is reported and LLM experiments use only two injected candidates. Limitations are candidly stated (Appendix A: cause of transferability unclear). Reproducibility is the weak spot: the attack codebase is deliberately not released (Appendix B), leaving only compute/hyperparameter details, public datasets, and contact-based access.
topics: adversarial attacks on code language models

primary_link.title: Vulnerable Code Search: Transferable Attack for Code Language Models

papers.summary: Reliable code retrieval is crucial for developer productivity and effective code reuse. However, current neural code language models (CLMs) powering search tools are susceptible to adversarial attacks targeting non-functional textual elements. In this paper, we introduce a programming language-agnostic, transferable, adversarial attack that exploits this CLM vulnerability. Our approach perturbs identifiers within a code snippet without altering the snippet's functionality to artificially align t
papers.summary_zh: 嵌入式程式碼搜尋仰賴程式碼語言模型（CLM）將查詢與程式碼編碼至共同空間，但此類模型對功能不變的文字擾動極為脆弱。本文提出一種與程式語言無關、可轉移的對抗攻擊：在不改變程式語意的前提下，以梯度引導的最佳化替換識別字（函式與變數名稱），使無關程式碼片段與目標查詢的相似度人為提高。方法結合三要素：以一階泰勒展開近似並貪婪搜尋最具影響力的替換、維持 camelCase 與 snake_case 等命名風格一致、以及獎勵與查詢 token 嵌入相近的候選字，並以 AST 不變與識別字唯一性約束保證語意保持。攻擊在小型代理模型（CodeT5+、OASIS）上計算後，可轉移至更大的 Nomic-embed-code、封閉源 Voyage-code-3，乃至 GPT-5.4-mini 與 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的儲存庫檢索。實驗顯示，僅污染 10% 候選池即可使多數模型的 MRR 最多下跌 77 個百分點；共享語料庫設定中，僅注入 4% 對抗片段即顯著劣化排名，且攻擊對語意等價的改寫查詢依然有效。防禦評估顯示：純穩健微調犧牲一半以上檢索效能，混合微調在白盒攻擊下仍易受攻擊。此研究揭示現有模型高度依賴詞彙層特徵而非語意理解，凸顯基準分數與真實穩健性之間的落差，呼籲發展語意感知的更強韌方法。

Section 4.7 / Table 13: Verified−Raw gains +0.238 (Qwen3-8B), +0.153 [0.109,0.197] (Llama-3.1-8B), +0.079 [0.036,0.120] (GLM-4-9B) under identical data/recipe; raw imitation flat or harmful on two backbones.

Data Availability + Appendix E: code at github.com/Lancelot-wy/RefineCut and benchmark at HuggingFace Randallhy/RefineCut-Bench; LoRA r=32/α=64, per-stage steps/lr/β, ~14.5 GPU-hours on one A100, prompts in Appendix I, adapter checksums released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is LLM/agent training methodology, not pure video-domain work: the planner never observes pixels (Section 2.1) and the paper trains open-weight LLMs (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, GLM-4-9B) via verifier-replayed multi-teacher distillation, mixed-granularity DPO, and Evo-style self-improvement — strongly matching LLM, Agents & Tool Use, and Alignment/RLHF preferences. Novelty is moderate: verifier/execution-based supervision, DPO self-improvement, and trajectory distillation are established; the combination (deterministic verifier replacing LLM judge for a creative planning task, plus a new benchmark) is fresh but assembled from known parts, as the paper itself admits (Appendix A). Rigor is strong: pre-registered transfer criterion with CIs (Table 13), ablations isolating verifier vs rubric vs margin (Table 3), canonical-clean and Human50 anti-overlap/style checks, semantic-input interventions, sensitivity reweighting (Table 10), and honest in-protocol circularity disclosure in Limitations. Evidence is solid but the headline VES is trained-on metric; external corroboration (blind judge 68–70% direction agreement; human A/B preference 0.780, κ=0.620) partially mitigates. Generalizability is capped by one domain verifier and preference stages trained only on Qwen3-8B, though verified-over-raw transfers to two other backbones. Reproducibility is excellent: public code/benchmark, hyperparameters, prompts, compute budget, and adapter checksums. Future-dated teacher models (GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) are unverifiable externally but are inputs, not claims.

primary_link.title: Plans You Can Check: Verifier-Grounded Learning of an Open-Weight Planner for Executable Video-Editing

papers.summary: Practical video editing is not only pixel generation: an editor must turn a brief, a clip pool, music metadata, and hard constraints into an executable timeline. We study this decision layer as \emph{executable video-editing planning} and introduce RefineCut, which, unlike workflow systems that wrap a prompted frontier model, trains a compact open-weight planner for it. The planner edits a typed timeline through structured patches covering clip selection, trimming, ordering, transitions, and dur
papers.summary_zh: 實務影片剪輯不只是像素生成，而是把簡報、片段庫、音樂中繼資料與硬性約束轉為可執行時間軸的受限規劃問題。本文提出 RefineCut，不包裝提示化的前沿模型，而是訓練緊湊的開放權重規劃器。任務被形式化為「可執行影片剪輯規劃」：規劃器以 RFC 6902 風格的 JSON Patch（RefinePatch）編輯型別化時間軸，確定性驗證器逐條重算顯式約束清單。由於剪輯沒有唯一正解，作者不直接模仿教師：第一階段將 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-Max、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 三位教師的候選分支逐一透過驗證器重播，保留最佳分支作為 SFT 目標與偏好對，訓練出 8B 的 Mixed-Pref 規劃器；第二階段 RefineCut-Evo 讓學生以驗證器與 ER1–ER7 評分為自身修復打分，以高邊際偏好對進行 DPO 自我改進。在自建的 RefineCut-Bench（3,578 個任務、7,971 個片段）上，VES 從 0.620 提升至 0.858，Evo 階段再達 0.924；增益可轉移至 Llama-3.1-8B 與 GLM-4-9B，且 8B 規劃器在同一封閉迴圈中勝過兩位教師、與第三位打平，每任務約 11.7 秒且不需教師呼叫。限制包括驗證器無法評判美感、上游字幕品質會限制上限、偏好訓練僅在 Qwen3-8B 上進行。此工作證明：當創作任務具備可執行規格時，確定性驗證器可取代人工標註或 LLM 評審，成為主要的訓練訊號。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment methodology (inference-time alignment, reward models, reward hacking, DP) squarely matching LLM and alignment preferences. Novelty is a competent combination of known components—SoftBoN, Huang et al.'s ITP, Lebensold et al.'s Gaussian above-threshold mechanism and FSRC—with the genuinely new contribution being the privacy/regret analysis showing Gumbel noise simultaneously provides ε-DP and KL-regularization, plus an n-independent ex-post DP bound; the authors themselves admit PrivBoN is 'algorithmically equivalent' to SoftBoN (Remark 3.5). Rigor is solid: full proofs in Appendices B-C including a log-concavity argument via Prékopa-Leindler (Lemma C.2), with honestly acknowledged limitations (closed-form threshold ε* requires Gaussian errors, Appendix B.4; finite-sample term exponential in Rmax/σ). papers.summary: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBo
papers.summary_zh: Best-of-N（BoN）取樣是最普及的推論時對齊策略，但隨候選數 n 增加，其 argmax 會過度剝削代理獎勵模型的誤差，產生獎勵駭客問題；同時獎勵模型以敏感的人類偏好資料訓練，每次評分都可能洩漏訓練資訊。本文證明單一介入——在選擇前對獎勵分數加入校準雜訊——可同時解決兩者。私有 Best-of-N（PrivBoN）以尺度 σ=2Δr/ε 的 Gumbel 雜訊擾動獎勵後取最大值，經 Gumbel-max 技巧等價於指數機制，同時滿足 ε-差分隱私，並在 n 趨近無限時收斂至 KL 正規化最佳策略。當隱私預算超過臨界值 ε* 時，隱私要求的雜訊即為後悔最佳的溫度，隱私「免費」且達到資訊理論天際線。由於 ε* 依賴未知的覆蓋係數，作者進一步提出 PrivITP，結合 χ² 正規化拒絕抽樣與兩階段高斯機制，實現與 n 無關的 ex-post (ε,δ)-DP，並以 FSRC 組合支援多查詢部署。在 GSM8K、MMLU、MATH 與四種獎勵模型上的實驗顯示：BoN 準確率隨 n 先升後降，而 PrivBoN 與 PrivITP 具單調擴展性；PrivITP 在相同隱私水準下持平或優於 PrivBoN，FSRC 約可多回答三倍查詢。限制在於理論依賴高斯誤差假設與有界獎勵輸出。此研究首次為推論時對齊提供形式化隱私保證，並揭示隱私與正規化本是同一介入的兩面。
papers.title: Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment
papers.title_zh: 無悔的隱私：差分隱私的推論時對齊

links.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'With Qwen3.6-27B, LocalLSTC reaches 64.7% SR-100 on OSWorld and 65.3% on WindowsAgentArena, outperforming the strongest prior local results on both benchmarks.'
§4.2.3 Table 3: fixed Qwen3.5-9B ablations show SR-100 drops from 49.1% to 36.4% (w/o L2S) and 41.5% (w/o S2L); removing Step Abstraction costs 17.5 points.

§4.2.1 and Appendix A.4 Tables 5-6: 91.6% of failed local trajectories contain a control failure (GPT-5.6-sol annotation), human-verified on 185 trajectories with Any F1 86.1%/85.2% and Cohen's κ=0.686/0.647.
§3.2.3: 'The mechanism builds on HiSA's Step Abstraction for GUI execution' and 'LocalLSTC inherits this refinement mechanism from HiSA (Li et al., 2026b)', limiting novelty of core components.
§4.1 Implementation: OSWorld backbone configurations 'run independently twice', while 'other results use one run'; baselines in Table 1 use 'their reported results'.

Reproducibility statement: 'The implementation, task-level outputs, and evaluation artifacts are released through an anonymous code repository'; Appendix E provides full prompt templates and D.8 Table 11 lists runtime parameters.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic LLM research: a training-free control architecture for locally deployed GUI/computer-use agents built on LLM planners (Qwen3.5/3.6, Gemma-4), matching high-weight preferences for agents/tool use, LLMs, local LLM deployment, structured output, and test-time planning. Novelty is moderate: the L2S/S2L temporal-scoping of persistent state is a coherent reframing, but Step Abstraction and context refinement are explicitly inherited from the authors' prior HiSA, and subgoal tracking, FSM-style verification, and plan-as-state ideas exist in Agent-SAMA, AgentProg, and Plover (§2.3, §3.2.3). Rigor is solid: controlled backbone replacement (GPT-5 vs Qwen3.5-9B) across four frameworks, GPT-based control-failure annotation validated against two blinded human annotators (Any F1 86.1%/85.2%, κ=0.686/0.647, Appendix A.4 Tables 5-6), bootstrap CIs for failure reduction (§4.2.1), component ablations with exact configurations (Table 3, Appendix B Table 8), and runtime-event diagnostics (Table 4). Evidence strength is good but tempered by reliance on literature-reported baseline numbers rather than re-runs, a single WindowsAgentArena run (§4.1), and headline local-SOTA claims against heterogeneous prior setups; token/time costs are reported alongside SR (Table 3), a plus. Generalizability is supported by two OS benchmarks, five backbones, and model-agnostic training-free design, though demonstrated only within desktop GUI domains. Reproducibility is strong: full prompt templates (Appendix E), runtime parameter table (D.8 Table 11), validation/execution rules, and an anonymous code release per the Reproducibility statement.

primary_link.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents

papers.summary: Modern GUI-agent frameworks achieve strong desktop task performance with frontier API models, yet persistent control information often remains implicit in growing interaction trajectories. At each step, the planner reconstructs the active task stage, accumulated evidence, and runtime feedback before deciding the next action. This dependence becomes more pronounced under weaker local reasoning backbones. Across four representative state-of-the-art frameworks, replacing GPT-5 with Qwen3.5-9B reduc
papers.summary_zh: 本地部署 GUI 代理可讓截圖、檔案與憑證留在本地邊界內並降低外部服務依賴，但較弱的本地推理骨幹使長程任務控制明顯退化。實驗顯示，在四個代表性框架中把 GPT-5 換成 Qwen3.5-9B，OSWorld 的 SR-100 平均從 60.9% 跌至 37.7%，且 91.6% 的失敗軌跡至少含一項控制失敗，涵蓋階段維持、進度評估、重複迴圈、錯誤恢復與過早終止五類。本文提出 LocalLSTC，一個不需訓練的控制架構，依時間尺度組織控制資訊：Long-Term Control 跨互動保存作用中子目標、證據與執行回饋；Short-Term Execution 以有限承諾執行當前步驟；Long-to-Short Planning（L2S）由持久狀態形成承諾，Short-to-Long Control（S2L）將執行結果抽象為子目標對齊的證據並更新狀態，構成七步 L2S–S2L 控制迴圈。在 Qwen3.6-27B 上，LocalLSTC 於 OSWorld 達 64.7% SR-100、WindowsAgentArena 達 65.3%，皆為文獻中最強的本地結果；固定 Qwen3.5-9B 的消融顯示移除 L2S 或 S2L 分別使 SR-100 降至 36.4% 與 41.5%，其中 Step Abstraction 與最終驗證貢獻最大。限制在於評測僅涵蓋兩個桌面基準與 8B–27B 等級模型。此研究確立「控制資訊的時間性組織」是本地 GUI 代理一個獨立的架構維度。
papers.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: LocalLSTC：本地部署 GUI 代理的長短期控制架構

links.title: On Scope Classification and Current Knowledge-Editing Benchmarks: A Negative Result, with INLAY as a Gradient-Free Case Study

evidence: Abstract & §6.2/Table 2: oracle router equals one-line static policy to four decimals in all nine dataset-by-condition cells over 1,689 queries (e.g., CounterFact structured Static 1.0000 = Oracle 1.0000; pooled 0.7874 both), headroom +0.0000 everywhere.
§6.2/Figure 5: abstention succeeded on 19/1,689 queries and was never the sole winning action (0/1,689), grounding the zero-headroom mechanism.

§7: structural diagnosis — counterfactual benchmarks ask for the post-edit answer so parametric answering is wrong by construction, and a benchmark without negatives cannot reward rejection; synthetic edit-withheld condition moves pooled headroom +0.0000 → +0.0420 with REJECT-only-correct 0/1689 → 52/1689, flagged as a synthetic proxy in Limitations.

§5.4/Table 1: honest negative disclosure — RAG beats every method on matched-manifest RippleEdits (0.3964 GPT-J, 0.4381 Qwen vs INLAY 0.2253/0.2871); §5.1 reports WISE beating INLAY on Qwen2.5-7B CounterFact (0.9466 vs 0.8944).

§8/Table 3: self-audit discloses a gate-bypass bug; corrected matched-RippleEdits deltas (+0.0030/+0.0020) are within noise, and the margin gate is disclosed as a no-op in the single-edit protocol behind headline numbers.

Limitations: MQuAKE-CF cells n=63 with a +6.4-point structured result resting on four discordant pairs (min exact McNemar p=0.125); no MEMIT/GRACE matched-RippleEdits runs; single encoder/cross-encoder stack untested for sensitivity.
§4 & Reproducibility: subject-disjoint splits, one scoring convention across methods, seed 0, and release of code, logged-run write-ups, and six regression tests.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful negative result squarely in-scope for LLM knowledge editing and benchmark evaluation: it computes an exact per-query action ceiling (oracle router ties a static policy in all nine cells over 1,689 queries) and constructively demonstrates the missing negatives condition. Relevance is strong via LLM, knowledge/RAG, evaluation-benchmark, and memory topics, though it does not touch agents, code, Japanese NLP, or alignment. Novelty rests on the benchmark-critique methodology rather than INLAY itself, which is a straightforward frozen-model/logit-bias memory design close to kNN-LM and IKE. Rigor is above average (subject-disjoint splits, unified scoring convention, Wilson intervals, Holm correction, McNemar caveats, disclosed self-audit bugs) but tempered by single-system evidence, one retrieval stack, n=63 cells, and reliance on internal audit files; the generalization claim to the whole SERAC-descendant family is argued structurally, not measured across other systems.

primary_link.title: On Scope Classification and Current Knowledge-Editing Benchmarks: A Negative Result, with INLAY as a Gradient-Free Case Study

papers.summary: Every memory-based knowledge editor in the SERAC lineage depends on a scope decision: given a query, does a stored edit apply? We report that current knowledge-editing benchmarks cannot measure this decision at all. Using INLAY, a gradient-free editor we built to obtain exact per-query ground truth (the model is frozen, edits live in an external addressable memory, and applying an edit is a bias added along one token's unembedding direction at decode time), we execute every candidate router acti
papers.summary_zh: SERAC 譜系的記憶式知識編輯器都依賴「範疇決策」：給定查詢，判斷儲存的編輯是否適用。本文以自建的免梯度編輯器 INLAY 為工具——模型凍結、編輯存於外部可定址記憶、應用時在解碼階段沿單一 token 的 unembedding 方向加入偏置——在 1,689 個查詢上逐一執行並評分每個候選動作（背誦編輯、依檢索證據推理、或棄權），取得逐查詢的真值。結果令人意外：在 CounterFact、WikiUpdate、MQuAKE-CF 三個資料集乘上三種輸入條件的九個實驗格中，總選最佳動作的 oracle 路由器與一行靜態策略在小數點後四位完全相同，逐查詢路由的最大可增益為 0.00；棄權作為唯一正確動作的次數為零。原因在結構：這些是反事實基準，評測問題要求「編輯後」的答案，故依參數知識作答必然錯誤；沒有負例的基準無法衡量分類器拒絕的能力，此結論適用於整個範疇分類器家族。作者自行建構缺失條件——對半數樣本移除其編輯卡片——使合併 headroom 從 +0.0000 升至 +0.0420，並首次讓棄權獲勝。本文同時誠實報告 INLAY 的劣勢：WISE 在 Qwen2.5-7B CounterFact 上勝出、RAG 在嚴格配對的 RippleEdits 上勝過所有受測方法，並揭露自我稽核發現的兩個 bug。其意義在於指出：需有「此編輯不適用」為正確答案的負例基準，才能真正評估範疇分類。
papers.title: On Scope Classification and Current Knowledge-Editing Benchmarks: A Negative Result, with INLAY as a Gradient-Free Case Study
papers.title_zh: 論範疇分類與現行知識編輯基準：一個負結果，以 INLAY 作為免梯度個案研究

links.title: Learning New Facts with QLoRA: An Acquisition-Retention Frontier

evidence: Abstract/§4.1: 'QLoRA rank acts as a plasticity control' — rank 64 reaches high factual accuracy but 'unrelated capabilities collapse'.
Appendix B (Table 5): per-benchmark OOD averages over five seeds fall from 70.7±0.7 (r=8) to 28.1±6.3 (r=64); TruthfulQA comparatively stable.
§3.1: 'All runs are repeated over five random seeds'; Qwen3-4B base with QLoRA ranks 8–64 and FFT; standard-LoRA control on Qwen3-1.7B.
§4.2 Table 2: target-acquisition checkpoint comparison; e.g., at ~90 paraphrase accuracy, r=32 retains 73.3–89.9% of OOD while FFT tops out at 76.1 paraphrase accuracy.
§4.3 Table 3: math adaptation shows small OOD drops (1.58–2.23 points) with near-identical math averages, so the frontier 'is not evident in this math setting'.
Limitations: benchmark is 1,938 examples across 14 cities; main results single-model; unquantized control 'changes model scale' and lacks matched FFT baseline.
Front matter: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/zhngstl/new_facts_forgetting'; Appendix E reports full hyperparameters including LoRA alpha=2r keeping α/r constant.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM fine-tuning methodology paper: controlled study of QLoRA rank vs. FFT on factual acquisition and retention using an anonymized OSM benchmark on Qwen3-4B, with five seeds, a matched target-acquisition comparison (Table 2), an unquantized LoRA control, and weight-space/spectral drift diagnostics. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, PEFT/QLoRA, forgetting, interpretability-style diagnostics), though no Japanese/NLP-specific content. Novelty is moderate: 'LoRA learns less and forgets less' (Biderman et al.) is prior work; the contribution is the within-adapter rank frontier and the observation that low-rank retention partly reflects low plasticity, which is an expected-direction result on a purpose-built benchmark. Rigor is solid but constrained: learning-rate selection by lowest training loss, single main model, and an unquantized control that changes model scale (Qwen3-1.7B), so quantization and scale are not fully disentangled (Limitations admits this). Evidence is strong within the tested setting (Appendix B shows broad OOD drops from 70.7 to 28.1 average as rank rises), but generalizability is limited: 1,938 examples, 14 small cities, anonymized synthetic identifiers, and the math experiment (Table 3) shows the frontier largely vanishes, which the authors honestly report. Reproducibility is good: public code/data link and detailed hyperparameters (Appendix E).

primary_link.title: Learning New Facts with QLoRA: An Acquisition-Retention Frontier

papers.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning is often assumed to preserve pretrained capabilities because it updates only a small number of parameters. We show that this assumption depends strongly on adapter capacity. We study factual acquisition in a controlled OpenStreetMap-derived benchmark where Qwen3-4B must acquire anonymized geographic associations while retaining unrelated capabilities. Comparing full fine-tuning (FFT) with quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) at ranks 8, 16, 32, and 64, we find th
papers.summary_zh: 參數高效微調（PEFT）常被假設因只更新少量參數而能保留預訓練能力，但此假設高度依賴 adapter 容量。本文在源自 OpenStreetMap 的受控基準上研究事實習得：Qwen3-4B 須學習匿名化的地理關聯（涵蓋 POI 類別、所屬城市、最近道路等五種關係），同時保留無關能力。匿名化降低對預訓練世界知識的依賴；訓練集含 1,938 個指令範例，評測使用 900 個表面模板不相交的釋出集，衡量同事實的釋義泛化。比較全量微調（FFT）與 rank 8、16、32、64 的 QLoRA，結果顯示 rank 清楚引導習得–保留邊界：低 rank 保留域外表現（HumanEval、IFEval、MMLU-Redux、BBH）但習得較少；高 rank 提升釋義準確率，卻在無關基準付出越來越大代價，rank 64 的 OOD 平均跌至 28.1%。FFT 行為保守：保留能力良好但達不到最高習得區間；目標準確率配對比較確認低 rank 的「安全」部分源於可塑性不足。分布、權重空間與 SVD 診斷與行為結果一致：高 rank 的 KL 散度、稠密更新範數與侵入維度皆更大。標準 LoRA 控制實驗顯示趨勢不需量化即成立。另項數學適應實驗顯示邊界較弱，暗示此效應在安裝全新事實關聯時最為顯著。限制包括資料集規模、模型覆蓋與 OOD 評測範圍。此研究提醒：PEFT 對知識注入並非本質安全，adapter rank 是控制可塑性的關鍵旋鈕。
papers.title: Learning New Facts with QLoRA: An Acquisition-Retention Frontier
papers.title_zh: 以 QLoRA 學習新事實：習得與保留的取捨邊界

links.title: Where vs What: Decomposing Structural and Content Failures in LLM-Generated Structured Outputs

evidence: Abstract and Section 6.2/Table 4: SA-RLVR lifts JSON VPA from 0.264 (Base) to 0.629 vs 0.281 for a matched Best-of-10 SFT baseline, with reward weight r = VPA + 0.3*SCR (Section 6.1, Eq. 4).
Section 5.1/Table 1: 'scissors pattern' - at L-level Qwen2.5-7B has VP 0.820 but VPA 0.215 (DR 73.8%), DeepSeek-V4-Flash DR 35.4%.
Section 5.4/Table 3: mechanistic ablations - opaque names raise DR 42.1%->49.6% and repeated names 44.6%->52.8% while VP stays stable, supporting the semantic-shortcut interpretation.

Section 6.1/6.2: OOD splits differ in difficulty (JSON-ID depth 3-5, base VPA 0.264; OOD-JSB base VPA 0.795), so 'generalization' gains across splits are not difficulty-controlled; reward ablation (Table 4 bottom) shows composite vs EM/VPA-only differences of only ~0.02-0.05 VPA without variance estimates.

Limitations section: acknowledges synthetic-only tasks, single 7B model with LoRA, 500-step training with non-plateaued learning curve, no multi-seed RLVR, and weak cross-topology table transfer (Table-OOD VPA ~0.085).

Appendices A-F: algorithmic task construction (1,500 JSON + 600 table tasks per model), metric pseudocode (Listing 1), prompt templates (Listings 2-4), and full training hyperparameters (Table 11: LoRA rank 64, GRPO, 4xA6000) support reproduction, though no artifact link is provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology paper: a diagnostic framework (SCD) decomposing structural vs. value failures in LLM structured outputs, plus an RLVR/GRPO method (SA-RLVR) using the decomposed metrics as verifiable rewards. Directly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/structured output, RLVR alignment, evaluation). Novelty is solid: the 'right value, wrong position' decomposition and the 'structure degrades first' scissors pattern are not captured by JSONSchemaBench/BFCL-style monolithic metrics, and reward ablations (EM vs VPA-only vs composite, Table 4/12) support the design. Rigor is good: controlled algorithmic task generation, two topologies, six models, depth/planted-count/semantic-cue/ambiguity ablations, and an honest limitations section. Evidence strength is tempered by single-seed RL training, no significance tests, and a confounded generalization comparison: JSON-ID uses depth 3-5 synthetic schemas while OOD-JSB base VPA is 0.795 vs 0.264 on JSON-ID (Section 6.1/6.2), so cross-split gains partly reflect split difficulty rather than schema generalization; table-coordinate VPA stays near baseline (~0.06-0.09), which is candidly reported. Generalizability is limited by fully synthetic tasks and training only Qwen2.5-7B with LoRA. Reproducibility is above average (metric pseudocode, prompt templates, full hyperparameter table) but no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Where vs What: Decomposing Structural and Content Failures in LLM-Generated Structured Outputs

papers.summary: Structured outputs such as JSON and tables are central to modern LLM-based systems, yet generation failures are evaluated monolithically, conflating two distinct error modes: placement errors (correct values at wrong positions) and value errors (wrong values at intended positions). We introduce Structure-Content Decomposition (SCD), a framework that independently measures structural fidelity and content accuracy. Applying SCD to nested JSON and table tasks across six models (7B to frontier), we
papers.summary_zh: 現代 LLM 系統大量依賴 JSON 與表格等結構化輸出,但既有評測多以單一指標衡量失敗,無法區分「值正確卻放錯位置」與「值本身錯誤」兩種失效模式。本文提出結構—內容分解(Structure-Content Decomposition,SCD)框架,以三層指標——格式有效性、結構描述符合率(SCR)與值放置準確率(VPA)——獨立衡量結構保真度與內容正確性,並輔以值存在率(VP)與錯置率(DR)診斷。在巢狀 JSON 與表格兩種拓撲、六個模型上,研究發現一致的「結構先退化」剪刀現象:複雜度升高時 VP 維持高檔,VPA 卻驟降;最高複雜度下 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 錯置 35% 已召回的值,Qwen2.5-7B 更高達 74%。控制消融顯示遞迴深度是主要驅動因素,且模型疑似依賴語意捷徑而非真正的拓撲結構定址。據此提出 SA-RLVR,把 SCD 指標轉為 GRPO 的可驗證獎勵,僅以 LoRA 微調 Qwen2.5-7B,便將 JSON VPA 由 0.26 提升至 0.63,並泛化到未見過的 schema,遠超過對應 SFT 基線的 0.28;表格領域格式正確率由 26.5% 升至 85.5%,但座標級放置改善有限。局限在於任務為演算法合成的控制式設計,生態覆蓋有限,訓練規模受限且學習曲線尚未收斂。此工作確立結構定址是可獨立評估與最佳化的能力,對依賴工具呼叫與代理工作流程的系統極具參考價值。
papers.title: Where vs What: Decomposing Structural and Content Failures in LLM-Generated Structured Outputs

links.title: Agent Mesh: Reliability Primitives for Non-Idempotent Agent Delegation - Identity Adequacy and Evidence Adequacy

evidence: Abstract: 147 numbered incidents across 81 identified runs on a production agentic software-delivery platform (66,185 lines, 59 modules), each with measured cost and, in the majority, a mutation proof that reverting the fix reproduces the failure.

Section III (Method): costs from durable records, guards mutation-tested with two deleted as unprovable, one diagnosis validated by a numeric prediction reproduced three times; withdrawn diagnoses recorded rather than deleted.

Section IV-E and Table I: twelve distinct incidents where the enforcement layer blocked correct work, the most expensive costing 107 agent turns with zero accepted writes due to a mis-diagnosed repair clamp.
Section V and Table II: five subsystem failures share one cause (identity that failed to discriminate), with two subsystems deriving the corrective rule independently.

Table III (Mechanism status): distinguishes running/measured mechanisms from specified-but-not-built ones (effect ledger, distinct refusal verdicts, per-tenant partitioning, token/effect trace ledgers); Section IX confirms the effect ledger P3 is specified, not demonstrated.
Section VIII and Table V: two-arm fault-injection controlled evaluation with designed kill criterion is specified but not conducted; several metrics gated on instruments that do not yet exist.
Section IX (Threats): observational design, single system, self-diagnosed corpus, survivorship, strict-platform bias; primitive effectiveness 'unmeasured' and deployment outcomes possibly confounded.
Section VII: deployment outcomes are before/after (blast radius 5→2, clamp yielding five admissions from structurally zero) on a system changing for other reasons, so effect sizes are not claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit agent-infrastructure research: reliability primitives (breaker, ledger, routing, budgets) for LLM-agent delegation on a code-generation/repair platform, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs). Novel framing: service-mesh assumptions shown violated for inference-time effectful delegations, with 'identity adequacy'/'evidence adequacy' as cross-cutting causes and 'enforcement-layer correctness' as an unclaimed gap (Table VI). Rigor is careful for an observational failure study (mutation-tested guards, fix-revert reproduction, withdrawn diagnoses reported, explicit no-inferential-statistics stance in IV-H), but the design is single-system, self-diagnosed, with no baseline; deployment outcomes are confounded before/after observations (Section IX). Evidence for the findings is per-incident, mechanically measured and traceable (54-call loop, 21-event ledger contamination, 107-turn zero-write clamp, blast radius 5→2), yet survivorship and strict-platform bias limit strength, and primitive effectiveness is explicitly 'unmeasured' with key components (effect ledger, distinct refusal verdicts, token ledger) not built (Table III). Generalizability is claimed framework-agnostically via three interception seams but rests on one platform. Reproducibility is partial: reference harness, fault schedules and workloads claimed released; the 66k-LOC platform and corpus are only described in supplementary material, and the controlled evaluation is specified, not run.

papers.summary_zh: 自主代理在推論時才動態組合操作,使委派天生具副作用、操作集無法事先列舉且捨棄即真實損失;服務網格慣用的三大假設——請求可冪等、延遲代表失敗、丟棄免費——因而全數失效。本文對一套生產級代理軟體交付平台(66,185 行、59 個模組)進行回溯失敗研究,涵蓋 147 起編號事件與 81 次可識別執行,多數診斷以回復修正、重現故障的方式確認。關鍵發現包括:54 次連續成功的相同工具呼叫構成對所有錯誤率斷路器隱形的死迴圈;以建構上恆定的檢查名稱計算進度訊號,造成第三輪必然誤跳脫,使一次執行從六個元件掉到三個;置於工作區之外的事件日誌在六次呼叫間累積 21 個事件,令正確元件永遠無法通過測試;錯誤歸因為兩元件故障喚醒五個元件,三個旁觀者改壞了正確程式碼;另有 12 起管制層阻擋正確工作的事故,最貴耗費 107 個代理回合且零次寫入被接受。作者將五個子系統的共同病因歸結為「身分適足性」,其對偶為「證據適足性」,並據此提出七項以委派為強制單位的可靠性基元與部署成效。研究明言屬觀察性、單一系統、團隊自診斷,效應帳簿等機制尚未建置,僅完成雙臂故障注入實驗的設計。其貢獻在於首度系統性記錄代理基礎設施層的失效樣態與成本。

evidence: Abstract: re-assigning one slot to the critical path raised current-record-consistent decisions by +74.0, +72.7 and +61.3 points, positive in six of six models
