Section 3 (Prospective evidence): prompts, records, thresholds, exclusion rules, scoring and analysis script frozen, SHA256-hashed and timestamped with OpenTimestamps before the first confirmatory episode; corrected run's spec deposited to OSF before execution (Appendix B)

Section 4.6: held-out scenario contained a temporal inconsistency ('expires in 3 days' vs. six-week onboarding); original result reported as run and a pre-specified corrected replication added (+73.3, Appendix C)
Section 4.1: agents named the target's provenance path in 181/900 (20.1%) and 208/900 (23.1%) episodes with the constraint stated, vs 66.9%/72.9% with it removed
Section 6 (Limitations): 16 enumerated limitations including 'Synthetic, controlled environment', 'The intervention is an oracle, and a bundle', and 'No scheduler evaluated'
Appendix E: policy arms executed as consecutive temporal batches and model identifiers passed without dated-snapshot pinning; provider-side drift not excluded by design
Appendix B (Reproducibility): every number emitted by one script from raw episode files; an independent implementation reproduces every count and interval for all four runs
Table 6: per-model effects range +0.0 to +100.0 and track native missed-path rate; Haiku 4.5 in corrected held-out run is a saturation case (25/25 native inspection)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical LLM-agent memory-safety study squarely within preferred topics (agent memory, verification budgeting, agent misbehavior, provenance). Methodological discipline is unusually strong: frozen and timestamped specifications, a pre-deposited corrected replication, 5,400 confirmatory episodes across four runs with replication, held-out domain, per-model and per-family analyses, leave-one-model-out checks, and an honest saturation case (Table 6). Novelty is moderate: the instrument, scenario, models and prompts are reused from the author's prior work; the new contribution is the supersession manipulation and the forced-critical same-budget contrast. Evidence for the internal claim is strong and consistent (+61 to +74 points, 6/6 models in three runs), but the setting is synthetic, the intervention is an oracle bundle, and execution was batched with unpinned provider aliases (Appendix E). Generalizability is limited by the six-memory store, one archive semantics, two providers, and no deployable policy evaluated. Reproducibility claims are exceptional (episode files, manifests, independent recomputation scripts released).

primary_link.title: When Stale Constraints Go Unchecked: Budgeted Verification Failures in Inherited Agent Memory

papers.summary: An agent that inherits a consolidated memory may inherit a constraint that was true when written and has since been withdrawn by a newer authoritative record. Under a scarce verification budget, does the agent recover the withdrawal, and if not, is the resulting stale-consistent decision avoidable without spending more? We model supersession explicitly -- provenance is immutable; what changes is which record is current -- and assign by design the memory's form, the world's state and the verifica
papers.summary_zh: 記憶增強代理繼承的整合信念,可能源自事後已被權威紀錄取代的來源:記憶所述限制在撰寫當下為真,如今卻已過時,而出處連結本身依然正確。本文首度實驗操弄此情境——沿革不變、改變的是何者為現行紀錄——並在固定兩份紀錄的驗證預算下,比較三種政策:代理自選、將一個名額重新指派至關鍵出處路徑、或指派至隨機非關鍵紀錄。在六記憶成長情境中,當限制被明寫時,代理僅約 20% 的回合查核其出處(移除限制後升至約 67–73%);當該限制已被取代,原生配置在主實驗、新措辭複製與採購領域保留實驗中,分別產生 77.3%、74.7% 與 74.7% 與過時記憶一致的決策。同一預算下,強制查核關鍵路徑使符合現行紀錄的決策提升 +74.0、+72.7 與 +61.3 個百分點,六個模型方向全數為正;當紀錄與記憶一致時介入幾無效果(+0.7 至 +2.0)。原始保留情境事後發現時間不一致,修正後的穩健複製(規格事先存證)得 +73.3,其中一模型因原生查核率為零而呈飽和。全計畫共 5,400 個確認性回合,規格凍結並以時間戳記存證。作者強調介入使用實驗者對關鍵路徑的知識,屬診斷工具而非可部署排程器,亦未測量過時限制的實際盛行率。核心啟示是:記憶系統可能需要與語意相關性分離的新鮮度或取代訊號,否則最相關的記憶恰恰讓代理不去查核其來源。

links.title: Learning What to Share and What to Personalize: Hierarchical Strategy Co-Evolution for Agent Memory

evidence: Abstract: HiPS decouples memory management into a globally shared foundation and a user-specific adaptive tier with Universal Strategy, Persona Delta Distillation, and Cross-Level Rule Flow
Section 5.1: backbone is Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct while Mem-α uses Qwen3-4B and MemSkill uses Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, so backbone strength is not controlled across baselines
Section 5.1: training set consists of 423 instances sampled from 70% of the PersonaMem 32k subset, an in-domain overlap with evaluation
Table 1: HiPS best in all twelve settings, e.g., PersonaMem 32K 73.49 vs MemSkill 64.45 and PrefEval Explicit 89.20 vs MemSkill 82.60
Table 2: ablations show component importance flip; removing Flow drops PERMA C-S from 66.95 to 45.39, removing USD drops PersonaMem 128K from 62.01 to 53.70
Sections 5.2-5.5: results reported as point estimates with no standard deviations, seeds, or significance tests
Appendix G: compliance for PG and R_follow estimated via a lightweight keyword-based heuristic, acknowledged as imperfect
Table 3: cross-model transfer of distilled strategies to GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 flash, and GPT-5 (71.48 with GPT-4o-mini-optimized strategies)
Appendix C (Table 10, Fig. 6): full hyperparameters and sensitivity analysis over eight hyperparameters
Appendix F and Appendix D: complete USD/PDD prompt templates and five seed rules; Appendix H: Algorithm 1; Abstract footnote: code at https://github.com/Hyp26cs/HiPS
Limitations: English-only evaluation acknowledged; claims histories up to 1M tokens while reported results cover only 32K and 128K (Table 1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent memory paper: hierarchical personalized memory-management strategies for LLM agents (Sections 1-4), hitting top-weighted preferences (LLMs, Agents & Tool Use, Long Context & Memory, GRPO alignment). Novelty is moderate: the shared/personal strategy decomposition with divergence-gated PDD and Cross-Level Rule Flow is a new formulation relative to static shared strategies (MemCoE, Sec. 2), but composes known pieces (LLM distillation, GRPO, submodular selection). Rigor is solid but flawed: 8 baselines across 12 settings, 5 ablations (Table 2), hyperparameter sensitivity (Fig. 6), yet baselines use heterogeneous backbones (Mem-α on Qwen3-4B, MemSkill on Qwen3-Next-80B in Sec. 5.1), training uses only 423 instances, in-domain training data overlaps PersonaMem evaluation, and no variance or significance testing is reported. Evidence strength limited by single-run numbers and a keyword-based compliance heuristic (Appendix G) that underpins both PG and the adherence reward. Generalizability is supported by out-of-domain benchmarks and cross-model transfer (Table 3), though English-only (Limitations). Reproducibility is good: full prompts (Appendix F), hyperparameters (Table 10), algorithm (Appendix H), and a public code link (Abstract footnote); the Limitations section also claims 1M-token evaluation while main results only report 32K/128K, a minor consistency concern.

The quality of these user profiles relies on the underlying memory management strategy: at each step, the agent must determine what to retain, compress, or discard. However, existing methods typically employ a static, one-size-fits-all strategy established before training. In practice, the optimal memory
papers.summary_zh: 記憶增強代理須逐步決定保留、壓縮或捨棄哪些對話內容,但既有方法的管理策略多為靜態且全體用戶共用:以族群平均獎勵訓練會稀釋小眾行為的訊號,無法從互動回饋中學習,顯式策略又常在訓練前凍結,隨政策演化逐漸失準。本文提出 HiPS,將策略分解為全域共享的 Universal Strategy 與用戶專屬的自適應 Persona Delta:Universal Strategy Distillation(USD)以結構化 diff 對比跨人格的高、低獎勵軌跡,持續演化共享規則並追蹤各規則的證據等級;Persona Delta Distillation(PDD)僅對分歧度超過門檻的使用者生成個人化規則,避免對已被通用規則涵蓋者引入雜訊;Cross-Level Rule Flow 則依累積證據在兩層間遷移規則。訓練上,以子模組選擇在 token 預算內注入策略,並以任務獎勵加權遵循獎勵驅動 GRPO;蒸餾緩衝僅依任務獎勵排序,防止規則自我驗證的循環偏誤。在 PersonaMem、PrefEval、PersonaBench 與 PERMA 共十二個設定上,以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 為主幹的 HiPS 全面超越 RAG、Mem0、A-Mem、LightMem 及 MemAgent、MemSkill 等強化學習基線,如 PersonaMem 32K 達 73.49。消融揭示元件重要性翻轉:領域內由 USD 與預測增益主導,領域外則 Flow 與 Gate 決定泛化(移除 Flow 使 PERMA C-S 由 66.95 跌至 45.39);策略亦可跨模型遷移。局限包括僅評測英文基準、情境最長約 1M token,長期人格漂移尚待處理。

links.title: GRIP: Granular Reward-Guided Parameter Interpolation for Efficient Reasoning

evidence: Section 4.2 Table 1: GRIP achieves 76.5 avg accuracy at 7930 avg tokens vs Qwen3-Thinking 76.0 at 10856 (27.0% token reduction), matching SLERP accuracy with 14.5% fewer tokens.

Section 4.1 Baselines: CMA-ES is matched to GRIP on training prompts (DeepScaleR-preview), module-wise parameterization (D=74), and accuracy-length fitness; AIME25, MATH500, GSM8K, GPQA-D, LCB held out for both methods.
Section 6 Limitations: evaluation only at 4B scale, dense Transformer backbones only (no MoE), and identical-architecture within-family pairs required, so cross-family fusion is not supported.

Appendix A.3 Table 2: layer-wise ablation (36+2 params) is evaluated at step 230 while module-wise (72+2) result is the step-750 GRIP configuration, an uneven-step comparison (73.5/7571 vs 76.5/7930).

Section 4.1 Implementation Details: K=74 fusion logits, lr 0.1, lambda=0.4, G=16 rollouts, 512 prompts-batch, 750 optimizer steps, eval via LightEval at temperature 0.8, top_p 0.9, 32,768 token limit.
Section 4.3: attention coefficient sweep is nearly flat (pass@1 in [0.690,0.722], length +26%) while FFN sweep moves pass@1 0.612 to 0.782 and length +178%, motivating per-module ratios.
Appendix A.5: training set is DeepScaleR-preview with 40,196 examples; evaluation sets are AIME25 n=30, MATH500 n=500, GSM8K n=1319, GPQA-Diamond n=198, LiveCodeBench v6 n=175.

Appendix A.6: full software stack listed (Python 3.12.3, SLIME 0.2.4, Megatron-Core 0.16.0rc0, SGLang, LightEval commit 33acf35f) and states 'We will release the source code for GRIP' — a promise, not a verified artifact.
Section 4.5: CMA-ES median per-coordinate RMS shift 0.083 vs GRIP 0.018, path-to-net-displacement 21.8x vs 4.9x, supporting smoother reward-guided optimization over evolutionary search.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: LLM reasoning efficiency via reward-guided module-wise interpolation of a reasoning and instruction-tuned LLM (Qwen3-4B pair), optimized with GRPO/DAPO-style RL. The contribution is a meaningful but incremental twist on existing merge-for-efficient-reasoning work (Wu et al. 2025a/b) that already used fixed ratios and black-box search; the gradient-based reward-guided ratio optimization is the new part. Rigor is solid on baselines (Linear, SLERP, TIES, DARE-TIES, DELLA, and compute-matched CMA-ES on identical search space/reward) and includes ablations (module- vs layer-wise, coefficient sweeps), but is weakened by a single model pair, single-seed results without variance, temperature-0.8 evaluation, AIME25 having only 30 problems (80.0 vs 73.3 is ~2 problems), and a layer-wise ablation evaluated at step 230 vs module-wise at step 750. Evidence is detailed and quantitative but noise-sensitive on small eval sets. Generalizability is limited by 4B scale, dense-only backbones, and the identical-architecture within-family requirement, partially offset by out-of-domain evaluation on GPQA-D and LCB. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters, environment, and data statistics, though code release is only promised.

primary_link.title: GRIP: Granular Reward-Guided Parameter Interpolation for Efficient Reasoning

papers.summary: Reasoning-oriented large language models often achieve strong problem-solving performance by generating long chains of thought, but this behavior substantially increases inference cost and latency. In contrast, instruction-tuned models tend to answer more concisely, yet often lack comparable reasoning ability. This accuracy-efficiency mismatch motivates a lightweight approach that combines the strengths of both models without full model retraining. In this paper, we propose GRIP (Granular Reward
papers.summary_zh: 推理導向的大型語言模型雖具強大解題能力,卻常生成冗長的思考鏈,使推論成本與延遲大幅上升,即所謂「過度思考」現象。提示工程效果不穩定,訓練式方法成本高昂,固定係數的模型合併又缺乏任務自適應控制。本文提出GRIP,一個輕量的獎勵引導參數內插框架:在架構相同的推理模型與指令模型之間,為每個模組(注意力、FFN、嵌入層與LM head等)指派可學習的內插比例,以sigmoid參數化確保係數落在有效區間,並凍結兩個來源模型,僅以GRPO式的強化學習目標更新這些純量參數。獎勵函數同時考量答案正確性與回應簡潔度,僅對正確答案施加長度懲罰。在Qwen3-4B Thinking/Instruct配對上,GRIP於AIME25、MATH500、GSM8K、GPQA-D與LiveCodeBench五項基準,相對原始推理模型平均減少27.0%的生成token,平均準確率更由76.0升至76.5,並優於Linear、SLERP、TIES、DELLA與CMA-ES等基線。分析顯示注意力與FFN對準確率與長度的影響截然不同,學得的逐層、逐模組融合係數明顯分化,模組級設計比層級設計平均準確率高3.0點。限制包括僅在4B規模驗證、未涵蓋MoE架構,且要求兩個模型架構完全相同。此方法為降低過度思考提供全模型訓練之外的輕量替代方案,兼具實務價值與對融合模式的可解釋洞見。

Section 2.1-2.5 and Appendix A: typed findings, four-lane frontier, PI/Chair synthesis, Gems, and lineage trace formalize the evidence-inheritance method (Algorithm 1, Eq. 1-5)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM-agent systems paper: Praxist is a multi-agent autonomous R&D framework (peers, PI/Chair panel, design contracts, typed evidence graph, lineage) with LLMs as the substrate (deepseek-v4-pro vs Claude Opus 4.8 baseline), hitting high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code, Reasoning/RL elements). Novelty is moderate: the typed-evidence/frontier-lane/lineage design is a sensible synthesis of AIDE/AlphaEvolve-style search, Reflexion-style memory, quality-diversity allocation, and provenance systems rather than a new mechanism. Rigor is unusually candid: the paper repeatedly bounds its own claims (single-sweep MLE-bench with no seed variance, internal-only integrity adjudication excluding 90,423 attempts, post-hoc quant artifact selection outside the confirmed lane, SLAM timestamp confound that voids the accuracy-gain claim, privileged-state fusion harness). However, key comparisons are confounded: the cost win is largely a model-pricing artifact, the Weco baseline uses a different model and search surface, and several case-study margins are small or non-causal, tempering evidence strength. Broad task coverage (ML engineering, control, trading, SLAM, fusion) supports generalizability in principle but each open-ended domain is a single demonstration. Reproducibility claims (code, released run archives, SHA-256 hashes, detailed configs) are concrete but depend on unreproducible LLM backends and one unreleased simulation study.

papers.summary_zh: 自主研發代理雖能撰寫、執行並改進可執行產物,但多數系統將每次嘗試視為近乎獨立,日誌與記憶只記錄「發生了什麼」,無法追溯哪個設計元素帶來改善、其證據是否經得起驗證,長期研究因此不斷重複學習相同教訓。本文提出Praxist,一個以譜系為中心的世代式系統:將可重現產物與外部評估結果轉換為型別化證據圖譜,包含findings、分車道結構的frontier、agenda,以及壓縮跨世代教訓的Gems;系統將局部產物建構與世代層級的證據綜合分離:設計分配採量化多樣性規則,同儕依據設計契約平行建構產物並由外部評估器評分,PI/Chair角色再綜合成下一世代的議程,譜系全程記錄研究事件,使最終成果附帶可稽核的形成歷程。在75項MLE-bench任務上,Praxist取得60面獎牌(80.0%),其中49面金牌,優於Claude Code搭配Claude Opus 4.8的55面(73.3%)與34面金牌,模型花費約3,054美元,僅為對照組38,370美元的約十二分之一。四個開放式案例(火箭著陸、量化交易、SLAM、tokamak磁控)皆改善任務原生基線,例如火箭著陸成功率達100%,交易策略CAGR為基線的2.3倍。限制在於案例研究非標準化對照,SLAM比較受時間戳慣例混淆,火箭成果限於凍結模擬器。此工作顯示強成果、低成本與可稽核譜系可同時達成,對長期自主研發深具意義。

Section 4.3, Table 1: DeepInception on Qwen2.5-7B falls from 78.0/14.6 (ASR-rej/ASR-gpt, No Defense) to 4.1/3.5 (Ours); CodeChameleon on Gemini-3-Flash-Preview falls from 24.0/5.1 to 1.1/0.8
Section 4.1 Evaluation protocol: cold-start streaming with memory initialized empty, only earlier-prompt failures induce rules, early successes counted as ASR to avoid evaluation leakage
Section 4.5 / Figure 3: ablations (w/o Trigger, w/o Enforcement, w/o Reflection) on Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B under CodeChameleon are described qualitatively with no numeric values in the text
Appendix A.7, Table 2: XSTest over-refusal rises from 3.6% with empty memory to 9.6% after accumulating four attack families' rules, attributed to classifier homonym errors

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM research: jailbreak defense via a persistent cross-interaction rule memory implemented as a four-agent test-time framework, touching AI safety, agents, prompting, and LLM-as-judge evaluation, so preference relevance is high. Novelty is moderate-to-good: persistent wrapper-level rule induction with selective triggering and an expanding label space is a genuine mechanism-level step beyond static prompts and transient self-reflection (AutoDefense/AegisLLM retain no cross-interaction state), though memory-based self-improvement for agents is a crowded direction. Rigor is solid on paper: cold-start streaming protocol avoiding train/test leakage, two ASR metrics with an external judge decoupled from the internal learning signal, four baselines plus AegisLLM and ICD in the appendix, ablations, K/C sensitivity, and XSTest over-refusal analysis. Evidence strength is capped because the abstract and conclusion claim robustness under an 'adaptive composite-wrapper attack' with no corresponding experiment, table, or figure anywhere in Sections 4.1-4.5 or the appendices; ablation (Fig. 3) and self-evolution (Fig. 2) results are described only qualitatively without numeric values; single runs with no significance testing; and 'generalization across an attack family' is effectively within-family since each stream contains one attack type, so cross-attack transfer of induced rules is never directly shown. Generalizability is decent (two open-weight models plus an API model, black-box only) but restricted to four single-turn prompt-level attack families, explicitly excluding multi-turn and agentic settings per the Limitations section. Reproducibility is aided by full agent prompts (Appendix A.6), the judge prompt (Fig. 4), the refusal list (A.3), and hyperparameters (K=2, C=4, tau=7), but there is no code release statement.

primary_link.title: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework Defense against LLM Jailbreak Attacks

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit techniques such as role-playing, obfuscation, code transformation, and multi-step indirection to elicit harmful outputs. As jailbreak strategies keep emerging, defenses have proliferated in an ongoing cat-and-mouse game, yet most remain static: their safety behavior is fixed at deployment, so they cannot accumulate defensive experience or adapt to unseen strategies. We propose a self-evolving test-time defense built
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型持續受到越獄攻擊威脅,而現有防禦多屬靜態:安全行為在部署時即已固定,無法累積防禦經驗或適應未見過的攻擊策略。本文提出以持續性、跨互動規則記憶為核心的自演化測試時防禦。當攻擊成功時,框架將失敗抽象為方法層級的規則,捕捉結構性攻擊包裝(如巢狀角色扮演、程式碼混淆)而非有害主題,因此單一規則可泛化至整個攻擊家族,標籤空間亦隨新型包裝出現而自動擴張。機制完全透過外部記憶與提示運作,不更新任何參數,故適用於開源與黑箱API模型。系統由規則觸發、政策決策、回應生成與自我反思四個協作代理實現,並採選擇性觸發(每次最多注入K條規則)、語意去重與每標籤容量上限,以免干擾良性查詢。在DeepInception、CodeChameleon、ReNeLLM與FlipAttack四類黑箱攻擊及多個模型上,攻擊成功率大幅下降,同時MMLU與GSM8K效用僅下降約兩點以內;推論開銷為3.07倍呼叫次數與1.43倍延遲。自我演化分析顯示ASR隨互動流快速收斂至近零;XSTest上的過度拒絕僅由3.6%升至9.6%。限制包括僅涵蓋四類提示層級攻擊、缺乏明確的規則修剪機制,且分類與評判代理會繼承基礎模型的判斷誤差。此工作證明持久性的測試時適應能帶來靜態防禦無法達成的穩健性。

links.title: Cross-lingual Representation Learning via Centroid Intervention Fusion

evidence: Abstract: claims up to +3.378 pp average over four backbones vs strongest pairwise baseline and code availability at https://github.com/VRCMF/CIF.git
Section 3.2: method = residual perturbation around identity, centroid computation, Frobenius-norm distance ranking, trimmed mean, with α≥0 stated in Eq. 10

Appendix A.2: α tuned over grid from -1 to 1 (inconsistent with α≥0 in Eq. 10); all methods share the same tuning budget and no language-specific tuning; 500 parallel pairs from News Commentary v16/CCAligned
Table 1: CIF best on all eight benchmarks with 3-seed mean/std and paired t-test significance at p=0.05; gains over INCLINE range +0.52 to +3.38
Table 2 (Section 4.3): ablation where removing both centroid and drop reduces CIF to INCLINE-level numbers (e.g., XCOPA 53.98 vs full 57.36)
Table 11 (A.7): per-checkpoint results across Qwen2.5-7B, BLOOMZ-7b1-mt, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3; text states CIF outperforms INCLINE on 29 of 32 dataset–checkpoint pairs
Table 6 / Appendix A.3: honest regressions reported, e.g., FLORES zh -3.21 and WMT23 ru -3.68 vs INCLINE
Appendix A.9: scalability argument — CIF deploys L operators vs N×L for pairwise methods at inference
Section 5.1: authors caveat centroid-alignment figure as descriptive diagnostic since centroid is estimated from same languages
Section 7 Limitations: text-only settings unclear for multimodal/interactive; fixed intervention strength and fixed filtering strategy
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/NLP methodology paper (not out of scope): inference-time activation intervention on frozen LLMs (Qwen, BLOOMZ, LLaMA, Mistral; Section 4.1) for cross-lingual transfer, evaluated on multilingual reasoning, NLI, factual editing, and MT benchmarks. Preference relevance is solid for LLM (2.5), NLP (1.5), and interpretability-adjacent activation steering (1.8), with secondary touches on commonsense reasoning benchmarks and inference/deployment efficiency (Appendix A.9); Japanese appears only in per-language analyses, not as focus. Novelty is moderate: the contribution reduces to rewriting pairwise projections as identity-plus-residual, taking a trimmed mean of residuals (robust aggregation imported from Byzantine-robust FL, Section 3.2) — a simple but new consolidation in the INCLINE lineage. Rigor is above average: 3 seeds with std and paired t-tests (Table 1), ablation of centroid fusion vs trimming (Table 2), α/drop sensitivity (Tables 9-10), leave-one-language-out (Table 7), per-checkpoint results (Table 11, CIF wins 29/32), and equal tuning budgets for all baselines (Appendix A.2); the main rigor flaw is that Section 3.2 declares α≥0 while Appendix A.2 tunes α over a −1..1 grid, and n=3 t-tests are weak. Evidence strength is good: consistent modest gains (+0.5 to +3.4 pp over INCLINE; large low-resource gains e.g., XCSR hi +12.30) with honest reporting of regressions (FLORES zh −3.21 BLEU, WMT23 ru −3.68), though centroid-alignment diagnostics are self-referential (Section 5.1 admits this). Generalizability is decent across four model families and diverse scripts/families with LOO transfer, but text-only with acknowledged fixed hyperparameters (Section 7). Reproducibility is strong: code link, exact checkpoints (A.7), prompt templates (Table 5), data sources and grids (A.2), package versions (A.10).

primary_link.title: Cross-lingual Representation Learning via Centroid Intervention Fusion

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit uneven multilingual performance, especially when dealing with low-resource languages. Inference-time intervention offers a lightweight way to improve cross-lingual transfer by modifying the hidden states produced by the LLMs during the forward pass, without updating model parameters. However, existing cross-lingual intervention methods typically learn separate projections from source to target languages, which limits scalability and prevents knowledge sharing
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的多語言表現不均,低資源語言尤其落後。推論時介入透過修改前向傳播中的隱藏狀態,提供不需更新參數的輕量跨語言遷移方式;然而既有方法(如INCLINE)為每個語言對學習獨立投影矩陣,不僅難以擴展,也無法在語言間共享介入知識。本文提出質心介入融合:先以平行語料為每個來源語言學習線性投影,再將各矩陣改寫為恆等轉換周圍的擾動殘差,計算質心後,以質心引導的修剪捨棄距離最遠的離群投影,最後平均保留者,得到單一跨語言共用的介入算子;推論時對各層隱藏狀態施加共享介入,模型全程凍結,部署算子數量由N×L降至L。在XCOPA、XStoryCloze、XWinograd、XCSR、XNLI、MzsRE、WMT23與FLORES-101八項基準上,涵蓋Qwen、BLOOMZ、LLaMA與Mistral四個模型家族,CIF相對最強的成對介入基線INCLINE平均提升最高3.378個百分點,於32個資料集-檢查點組合中的29個勝出,對印地語、阿拉伯語、越南語等低資源或非拉丁文字語言增益尤其顯著(如XCSR上印地語+12.30)。分析顯示各語言投影殘差確實共享低維質心結構,印證融合設計的合理性。限制包括僅涵蓋文字任務、介入強度與修剪量為固定超參數,且部分語言(如FLORES上的中文)可能退步。此方法為多語言擴展提供可規模化的替代方案。

links.title: From Passive Response to Proactive Correction: Enhancing LLM Robustness Against Input Fact Perturbations

evidence: Abstract: 'we propose DEDUCE, a three-stage framework that transforms LLMs from passive responders into proactive error correctors... We also present MisFactQA, a dataset containing factual errors of varying degrees, and propose new metrics for evaluating model robustness.'

Section 6 (Related Work): 'While prior work has developed methods for detecting false premises to ensure robust answering (Wang and Blanco, 2025; Yuan et al., 2024), these approaches often neglect the critical need to explicitly address and correct the user's underlying misconception' — situates the incremental novelty over existing false-premise detection.

Section 5.1: 'we use o3-mini-medium as an automated judge for evaluation... Cohen's κ=0.936, and strong alignment on the clarification score, with Pearson's correlation coefficient r=0.916' — supports judge validity but all automated results rest on one judge.
Appendix A.2: 'The reported results are based on a single run.' — limits statistical rigor despite temperature=0.0.
Section 5.2 (Table 2 discussion): 'On the Gemma3-12B model, our approach improves upon the best baseline by a substantial margin of 25.99% in accuracy on FalseQA.'
Section 5.4 (Table 4): ablations removing Strategy(Q) and MisSum(Q) on LLaMA-3.1-8B show degradation across TruthfulQA, MisFactQA, FalseQA; 'The Strategy module has the largest impact.'

Appendix A.1 (MisFactQA): 'we obtain 900 pairs of questions that share the same underlying information but exhibit different error types. In addition, we construct 1,140 questions with fact perturbations' with Claude-3.5-Sonnet filtering plus two-annotator manual verification (Appendix B.2).
Appendix F: human evaluation on 100 sampled instances with two CS-trained annotators, inter-annotator κ=0.877 and judge agreement κ=0.936 / r=0.916.

Limitations: 'experimental evaluation centers on mid-scale models including Qwen2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Gemma3-12B' and 'Other forms of unreliable inputs, such as ambiguous queries or adversarially crafted prompts, are not explored.'

Title-page footnote 1: 'https://github.com/WangPing-Kayla/Deduce' plus Appendix A.2 prompts (Figures 6-13) and Table 7 LoRA hyperparameters support reproducibility; dataset release beyond the link is not explicitly confirmed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Centrally in-scope LLM methodology: robustness to input fact perturbations, addressed via a prompting pipeline plus LoRA fine-tuning, with a new benchmark (MisFactQA), new metrics, and LLM-as-judge evaluation validated against humans. This intersects multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/deliberation, evaluation, training, prompting). Novelty is moderate: false-premise detection exists (Yuan et al. 2024; Wang & Blanco 2025 IAQ-FA), and the Generator/Reviewer/Arbiter deliberation closely resembles established self-refinement/debate patterns; the main novel pieces are the proactive-correction framing, compound-error types, and fine-grained metrics. Rigor is solid—three model families, five baselines, component ablations (Table 4), error-type analysis (Appendix C), deliberation-depth analysis, and efficiency/token accounting (Table 5)—but weakened by single-run reporting, a coarse binary Correction Rate, and possible advantage to DEDUCE-T whose distilled outputs structurally embed reference-answer content that the accuracy judge requires. Evidence is strong on relative gains (e.g., +25.99% Acc over best baseline on FalseQA for Gemma3-12B) with judge-human agreement κ=0.936, yet all automated scores rest on one LLM judge and 100-instance human validation. Generalizability is decent (Qwen/LLaMA/Gemma plus GPT-4o-mini and DeepSeek-V3) but English-only and confined to factual errors per the stated limitations. Reproducibility is supported by a public code link, all prompts in appendices, and training hyperparameters, though dataset release and single-run variance are not fully verified.

primary_link.title: From Passive Response to Proactive Correction: Enhancing LLM Robustness Against Input Fact Perturbations

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce confident yet factually incorrect responses when user inputs contain misleading premises, a phenomenon we attribute to fact perturbations in the input. Existing approaches to hallucination mitigation typically assume reliable user inputs, overlooking how such factual errors can actively mislead model reasoning. To address this vulnerability, we propose DEDUCE, a three-stage framework that transforms LLMs from passive responders into proactive error
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）遇到含有錯誤前提的使用者輸入時，常自信地產生與事實不符的答案。本文將此現象歸因於輸入中的事實擾動，並指出現有幻覺緩解研究多假設使用者輸入可靠，忽略了輸入端錯誤對模型推論的干擾。作者提出DEDUCE三階段框架：Detect透過原子事實分解與驗證偵測錯誤；Devise以Generator、Reviewer、Arbiter三方角色進行多觀點策略審議；Correct依序執行策略，先指出錯誤、說明正確資訊，再回答原問題，並提供Prompting與Tuning兩種實作。團隊另建構MisFactQA資料集，涵蓋單一錯誤前提、內部矛盾與複合錯誤，並提出誤導率（MR）、修正率（CR）與澄清分數（CS）等新指標。在TruthfulQA、FalseQA與MisFactQA上，DEDUCE於Qwen、LLaMA、Gemma系列一致超越ICL、CoT、SFT等基線，例如Gemma3-12B在FalseQA準確率提升約26%，GPT-4o-mini與DeepSeek-V3亦見改善；實驗並顯示CoT在輸入含錯時反而可能放大錯誤。限制包括僅評測中型模型，且未涵蓋歧義或對抗性提示等不可靠輸入。此研究將幻覺防治焦點由模型端轉向輸入端，強調主動辨識並糾正使用者誤解，對提升實務部署的可靠性具參考價值。

links.title: Why RAGs Hallucinate: Penalty-Aware Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems with Knowledge-Gap Canaries

evidence: §3.2: quality score Q = Pr[correct] − k·Pr[wrong] with k=4 gives rational-abstention threshold p ≥ k/(k+1); explicitly framed as operationalizing Kalai et al. [5] (Related Work, para 1), so the core scoring idea is inherited.

§3.3 + §4.1: canaries are the 18 of 1,000 questions whose collected source document lacks the gold answer, 'discovered during corpus verification' and kept rather than designed — a low-cost but simple mechanism.
Table 3/§5.1: RAG accuracy-given-attempt clustered at 97.0–98.0% while abstention spans 0.2%–11.1% and canary violation 16.7%–98.1% with Wilson CIs; central claims are quantified and CI-backed.
Table 4: paired bootstrap, Bonferroni α=0.0083; only OpenAI vs CustomGPT.ai (+0.095, p=1e-4) survives correction; OpenAI vs Gemini is 'no (marginal)' — honest significance reporting.
§5.3: 'at the question level the difference is 3 canaries versus 4 out of 18, which no test separates (Fisher exact p=1.00)' — avoids overclaiming within-pair ordering.

§4.2 'Prompt asymmetry, disclosed': CustomGPT.ai never received the decline clause; abstention rates for the other two systems are 'partly prompt-conditioned' — a material confound, disclosed post hoc.
§8 Limitations: one dataset, English-only, short-form; Flash-not-Pro Gemini tier; canary n=18/54; 815 re-cast votes in one repeat; private-corpus extrapolation 'our benchmark does not test'.

§8 Reproducibility: code, per-request audit logs, judge votes, and statistics scripts released at github.com/adorosario/why-rags-hallucinate; §3.7 describes an independent script validated to reproduce aggregates — strong audit claims, though replication depends on pinned commercial APIs and future model checkpoints.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation-methodology paper that operationalizes Kalai et al.'s confidence-target analysis (§3.2, Q = Pr[correct] − 4·Pr[wrong]) for commercial RAG products, adding a knowledge-gap canary measurement (§3.3) and a blind cross-family judge panel (§3.5). Strongly matches LLM/RAG/hallucination/evaluation preferences. Strengths: careful protocol (pre-registered quota repair, Bonferroni-corrected paired bootstrap in Table 4, three-repeat stability §5.5, judge agreement 98.9% §5.6) and unusually candid disclosure of prompt asymmetry (§4.2) and vendor conflict of interest (§8); appropriately declines to order CustomGPT.ai vs OpenAI on canaries (Fisher p=1.00, §5.3). Weaknesses: the scoring rule is adopted rather than new and canaries are a simple post-hoc corpus-coverage artifact of only 18 questions/54 trials (§8 Limitation 6); single English short-form dataset; the private-corpus fabrication claim motivating the work is explicitly untested (§7); Gemini-judge leave-one-out check not reported (§3.5); results are a snapshot of pinned, non-replicable commercial endpoints. Vendor-authored with disclosed COI; affiliated product does not lead the headline metric.

primary_link.title: Why RAGs Hallucinate: Penalty-Aware Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems with Knowledge-Gap Canaries

papers.summary: Volume-based accuracy rewards retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for guessing: a system that answers everything outscores one that declines when its knowledge base cannot support an answer. Building on the confidence-target analysis of Kalai et al. (2025), we present a penalty-aware evaluation framework for deployed RAG products, combining (i) asymmetric scoring (correct +1, wrong -4, abstain 0), (ii) knowledge-gap canaries, questions whose answers are verifiably absent from the knowle
papers.summary_zh: 以答題數量計分的準確率評測會獎勵RAG系統「有問必答」，使其傾向猜測而非在知識庫無法支撐時拒答，幻覺因而被評測制度本身養成。本文提出一套「懲罰感知」評測框架並應用於已上線的商業RAG產品：採非對稱計分（答對+1、答錯-4、棄權0），設計「知識缺口金絲雀」——答案經驗證不存在於知識庫的題目，任何作答（即使碰巧正確）皆視為參數記憶外洩的接地違規；另搭配跨模型家族三評審盲測、失敗歸因管線與完整審計日誌。作者對三套商業系統與無檢索基線，在SimpleQA-Verified上進行1,000題×3輪實驗。結果顯示各RAG系統作答時的準確率高度相近（97.0–98.0%），但棄答率相差達五十倍（0.2%對11.1%），金絲雀違規率相差約六倍（16.7%對98.1%）：Gemini幾乎逢題必答，仰賴參數記憶回答庫外問題，OpenAI RAG與CustomGPT.ai則在檢索無所獲時傾向拒答。採用懲罰感知計分後排名重排，OpenAI RAG在所有懲罰強度下均居首。作者隸屬CustomGPT.ai，已透過盲測與公開日誌緩解利益衝突。限制包括單一英文短答資料集與金絲雀題數偏少（18題）。此框架顯示未將棄答行為計入的評測並非中立，值得RAG採購與排行榜設計借鏡。

links.title: Reflection Steering: Disentangling Reflection from Reasoning in Activation Space for Token-Efficient Inference

evidence: Abstract: 'reduces reasoning tokens by 16.9% on average across six matched settings' with a bounded deployment-time strength parameter α.
Results, Table 1: on Qwen3-30B-A3B MATH-500, Reflection Steering achieves 21.8% token reduction with -0.1 pp accuracy vs raw model; ReflCtrl gives 13.9% at -1.0 pp; CREST increases tokens by 8.0%.
Results, Multi-seed consistency: paired TOST passes on MATH-500 (p=0.0012) and MATH-350 (p=0.0074), but 'GPQA-Diamond does not pass the same equivalence test (-1.52 points, [-4.38, 1.18])'.
Results, Prospective pilot: 21.0% token reduction (lower bound 17.6% above pre-registered 10% target) but accuracy lower bound -1.69 'does not meet the one-point criterion'.

Results, RQ2 Table 3 (GPQA-Diamond ablations): without orthogonalization accuracy drops to 67.2% vs 70.7% full method; 'All layers + projection' lowers accuracy to 66.7%; 'Calibrated + additive' increases tokens by 27.8%.
Results, Direction specificity (Figure 4): orthogonalization reduces median reasoning-proxy overlap from 0.0332 (raw) to 0.00042, near the isotropic-random reference of 0.00048.
Experimental Setup, Models: 'We focus on Qwen-family open-weight checkpoints... transfer beyond this family remains untested'; comparisons are 'default-point rather than equalized-tuning frontiers'.
Results, RQ3 Table 4: cross-model token savings of 6.6%/9.6% (Qwen3-8B) and 26.4%/15.8% (QwQ-32B) with model-dependent layer selection (14/44, 2/34, 6 layers selected per Implementation details).
Results, Direction-construction stability: cosines 0.9942/0.9940 for 140→150/150→160 growth; N=150 described as 'an empirical operating point... rather than as a proven sufficient budget'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM work: activation steering in large reasoning models (Qwen3-30B-A3B/8B, QwQ-32B) to cut redundant reflection tokens, directly matching LLM, reasoning/CoT, interpretability, and inference-efficiency preferences. Novelty is incremental: mean-difference directions, PCA denoising, projection-based concept erasure, and layer calibration are existing tools; the contribution is their combination plus orthogonalization against a pooled-mean 'general reasoning' proxy, positioned against close prior work (ReflCtrl, CREST, SEAL, Manifold Steering). Rigor is above average: matched token accounting, three seeds, cluster-level paired TOST, a record-disjoint MATH-350 split acknowledging in-sample direction construction, a pre-registered prospective pilot on 500 fresh problems, component ablations (Table 3), and direction-stability analysis (Figure 5). Evidence is solid for token savings (21.8% MATH-500 at -0.1 pp accuracy; 16.9% mean over six settings) and for component necessity, but weaker elsewhere: GPQA-Diamond fails the ±1-point equivalence test (-1.52 pp), the prospective pilot's accuracy bound (-1.69) misses the one-point criterion, and the α=0.7 operating point was retrospectively selected. Generalizability is capped by an explicitly Qwen-family-only scope ('transfer beyond this family remains untested'), model-specific calibration, and only two benchmarks. Reproducibility is aided by open-weight models, public benchmarks, detailed equations, hyperparameters, and layer selections, but no code/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Reflection Steering: Disentangling Reflection from Reasoning in Activation Space for Token-Efficient Inference

papers.summary: Large reasoning models often produce reasoning traces with verification, revision, and backtracking. When reflection merely re-checks established results, it wastes reasoning tokens and increases latency. Most existing reflection steering methods add a label-derived mean-difference direction across preset layers, but its entanglement with reasoning and length signals destabilizes the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. In this paper, we propose Reflection Steering, a training-free framework for contr
papers.summary_zh: 大型推理模型常在推理軌跡中反覆驗證、修正與回溯，當反思只是重複確認既有結論時，會浪費推理token並增加延遲。既有反思引導方法多以標籤差異的平均方向介入，但此方向與推理內容、長度等訊號糾纏，容易傷及有用的推理。本文提出Reflection Steering，一個免訓練的表徵層方法：先在各層對比反思與非反思隱藏狀態估得初始方向，再以PCA去噪，並對一般推理方向做正交化以移除共享成分；接著在小型校準集上測試各層於多個介入強度的表現，僅保留能穩定降低反思行為且不破壞生成的層；推論時以有界投影移除（強度參數α）只縮減當前激活在該方向上的分量。作者亦以teacher-forced稽核證實早期層介入會被下游放大，故層級校準有其必要。在三個Qwen家族模型與MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上，六組對照設定平均減少16.9%推理token；Qwen3-30B-A3B於MATH-500減少21.8%token而準確率僅降0.1點，配對等效檢定支持±1點內等效。消融顯示正交化是保住準確率的關鍵，加法式引導反而增加token。限制為僅驗證Qwen家族、GPQA未達等效標準，且校準層與最佳α具模型相依性。此方法提供部署時可調的token節省與品質平衡介面。

links.title: Think-Probe-Respond: Improving Large Language Models as Judges of Research Idea Novelty

evidence: Section 4 / Table 1: six proprietary SOTA LLMs achieve macro-F1 <=17.1 and MAE ~1 on RINoBench, with predictions concentrated in classes 3-4 and near-total failure on extreme novelty classes (the identified 'medium novelty' bias).

Section 5: TPR probes the final-layer hidden state at the last think token with a logistic regression classifier, all LLM parameters frozen, and conditions the final response on the predicted class description; rationale for last-layer choice is a footnote citing prior work rather than an ablation.

Section 5.2: TPR surpasses the best competing approach by an average of 22.30% macro-F1 across nine open-source models (Qwen3 4B/14B/32B, GPT-OSS-20B, Gemma-3 4B/12B/27B, Llama-3.1 8B/70B); Table 2 shows best TPR macro-F1 of 25.2 (Gemma-3-27B), while per-class F1 shows more balanced predictions including classes 1 and 5.

Section 6 / Table 3: probing at the final think token t_n yields strongest or near-strongest macro-F1 for nearly all models during a no-intervention run, while response-phase probing is generally weaker, supporting the claim that novelty beliefs consolidate during reasoning.

Appendix E / Table 6: MAE is ~1.0-1.2 for every approach including TPR; the authors explicitly argue macro-F1 is preferable because MAE rewards conservative middle-ground predictions, though this means ordinal accuracy gains are not demonstrated.

Section 8 Limitations: experiments confined to RINoBench (machine learning research ideas only) and TPR requires hidden-state access, excluding closed-source LLMs; novelty judgments acknowledged as subjective.

Appendix C/D: LoRA details (r=16, alpha=32, lr 2e-4, 2 epochs), hardware (2x NVIDIA A100 80GB), scikit-learn/HF implementations, and full prompts (Figures 3-4) are provided; RINoBench is stated to be publicly available, but no code release for TPR is explicitly claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM methodology paper: LLM-as-judge for research idea novelty, combining chain-of-thought reasoning analysis, hidden-state probing (interpretability), and benchmark evaluation across 9 open-weight LLMs plus 6 proprietary LLMs. The core contribution—diagnosing a 'medium novelty' bias where rationales are human-aligned but scores are miscalibrated, then extracting latent judgments via a lightweight logistic-regression probe at the last think token and conditioning the final response on it—is a credible and reasonably novel use of probing, though probing classifiers and steering-based conditioning build on existing techniques and the probing-over-time analysis is descriptive. Rigor is solid: multiple strong baselines (zero/few-shot, CoT, four prompt methods from prior systems, LoRA fine-tuning), ablations on probing timestep and reasoning length, and a well-argued metric choice (Appendix E). Evidence is genuinely supportive (class-balanced F1 gains, open-source TPR models beating proprietary zero-shot models) but absolute performance stays low (best macro-F1 25.2), MAE is essentially unchanged (~1.0-1.2 for all methods), baseline numbers appear only in a figure, and no significance tests are reported. Generalizability is limited by a single benchmark restricted to ML research ideas and the need for hidden-state access; reproducibility is decent (prompts, LoRA hyperparameters, hardware, public benchmark) but no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Think-Probe-Respond: Improving Large Language Models as Judges of Research Idea Novelty

papers.summary: Automated novelty judgment can accelerate scientific discovery by enabling efficient evaluation, refinement, and comparison of research ideas. While large language models are increasingly adopted for this task, we investigate a previously overlooked limitation in their judgment capabilities: despite generating reasoning rationales that closely mirror those of human experts, their final novelty judgments often diverge substantially. We demonstrate that this miscalibration stems from a systematic
papers.summary_zh: 以LLM評審研究想法的新穎性可加速科學評估，但本文發現一個被忽略的失準現象：模型的推理論述與人類專家高度相似，最終的新穎性評分卻往往偏離人類判斷。作者以六個專有模型在RINoBench（1,381個附專家標註的研究想法）上實驗，發現系統性的「中間偏誤」——模型幾乎只預測3或4分，極端類別（1分不新穎、5分高度新穎）幾乎全錯，而其論述的召回率其實不低，顯示「內在信念」與「外在評分」脫節。據此提出Think-Probe-Respond（TPR）：Think階段讓模型逐步推理但不產生數字評分，避免錨定；Probe階段在最後一個思考token擷取最後層隱藏狀態，以輕量邏輯迴歸探針分類潛在新穎性判斷；Respond階段將預測類別描述加回輸出，讓模型據此生成最終論述。在九個開源模型（Qwen3、GPT-OSS、Gemma 3、Llama 3.1）上，TPR平均較最強基線提升22.30% macro-F1，預測分布更均衡，小模型甚至可超越零樣本的大型專有模型；探針於思考階段尾端效果最佳，回應生成階段訊號則被稀釋。限制包括RINoBench聚焦機器學習領域、需存取隱藏狀態故不適用閉源模型，且新穎性判斷本質主觀。此研究揭示了LLM「知道卻說不出」的校準問題，對AI輔助科學評審深具意義。

links.title: Routed Graph Handoff: Adaptive Format Selection for Multi-Agent LLM Delegation

evidence: Abstract: claims +12.7 pp on tau-retail at 3.2x compression (p<0.01), consistent with Table 1 (12.0 to 24.7) and Table 2 CI [+6.0, +19.3]
Section 3.1/Table 1: AppWorld NGH-only 37.1 vs NL 51.7 (-14.6 pp, CI [-22.8, -6.4]); router recovers full parity at 51.7, demonstrating regression prevention

Section 3.4/Table 2: all schema-aware protocols (Routed NGH 24.7, RL Qwen 20.7, T5 Autoencoder 20.0, Hybrid 19.3, LLMLingua-2 18.7) outperform schema-unaware (Pred. Delta 17.3, TF-IDF 16.7); Routed NGH is the only zero-training protocol and highest TSR
Abstract vs Table 1: BrowseComp claimed +8.7 pp but table values 38.7 to 47.3 give +8.6 pp (minor rounding inconsistency); CI [+2.7, +14.7] and Holm-Bonferroni correction are reported in Section 3.1
Appendix G/Table 4: GPT-5 mini second backbone shows direction-consistent gains (BrowseComp 65 to 68, BFCL 82 to 85, AppWorld 50 to 52) but no confidence intervals are provided for this replication
Appendix C/I: 76% inter-agent misalignment figure is rule-based, validated at 92% agreement on 50 sampled failures, with threshold sensitivity bounded in Appendix I

Limitations: schema designed on 47 tau-bench trajectories (disjoint from evaluation); realized routing is coarse per-benchmark clustering; fine-grained instance-level routing (8.6 pp oracle headroom, Appendix D) left as future work

Appendix J: schema, prompts, model versions, splits, and evaluation code enumerated but 'will be released upon publication'; commercial API models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5 mini, Nova Pro) reduce self-contained reproducibility
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multi-agent LLM communication paper squarely within high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code/Tool-Calling, efficiency): it treats inter-agent handoff format as a design variable, introduces a typed graph schema plus a 155-token router, and identifies a structure-flexibility tradeoff. Rigor is above average: four benchmarks (1,052 trajectories), paired bootstrap CIs with Holm-Bonferroni correction, an 8-protocol comparison isolating schema-aware vs schema-unaware compression, a router-necessity ablation, oracle headroom decomposition, rule-based error taxonomy with 92% manual agreement, and threshold-sensitivity analysis (Appendix I). Evidence is largely internally consistent, though BrowseComp's claimed +8.7 pp matches Table 1 as +8.6 pp (rounding), the GPT-5 mini replication (+2/+3 pp) lacks CIs, and BFCL is only artificially cast as a handoff (honest parity result). Novelty is moderate-incremental: structured agent communication and routing exist (RouteLLM, GPTSwarm, LLMLingua), but format-routing between graph and NL with the tradeoff analysis is a fresh combination. Generalizability is supported by cross-vendor checks (Claude x Nova Pro, GPT-5 mini) and a domain-agnostic router prompt, but the schema is hand-designed on 47 tau-bench trajectories and realized routing is coarse (100% graph on three benchmarks), acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is well-prepared (Appendix J lists schema, prompts, decoding settings, splits, eval code) but artifacts are only promised 'upon publication.' Not out of scope: this is core agentic-LLM methodology, not a pure domain application.

primary_link.title: Routed Graph Handoff: Adaptive Format Selection for Multi-Agent LLM Delegation

papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems coordinate through natural-language messages that consume 40--60\% of their token budget. Replacing these with structured graphs reduces cost but fails on tasks requiring adaptive reasoning. We propose \textbf{Routed Graph Handoff}, where a lightweight LLM router (155 tokens, 0.15\% overhead) selects between a typed dependency graph and natural language for each delegation. On four benchmarks (1,050+ trajectories), the routed system matches or exceeds NL-only on every tas
papers.summary_zh: 多代理LLM系統的代理間訊息預設採用自然語言,往往消耗40-60%的Token預算;改用結構化圖形可降低成本,卻在需要調適性推理的任務上失效。本文提出Routed Graph Handoff:由一個輕量級LLM路由器(約155個Token、僅0.15%開銷)在每次委派時,選擇使用型別化依賴圖或自然語言。在四個基準(逾1,050條軌跡)上,路由系統在所有任務皆持平或超越純自然語言:τ-retail提升12.7個百分點並達3.2倍壓縮(p<0.01),BrowseComp提升8.7個百分點(2.2倍壓縮),BFCL與AppWorld維持持平。若移除路由器,純圖形委派在AppWorld會倒退14.6個百分點,路由器以近零成本消除此退化;研究並強調接收端必須搭配圖形感知執行提示,否則毫無助益。協定比較進一步顯示,結構感知方法一致優於不具結構感知的壓縮方法。限制方面,路由屬於粗粒度的任務類型層級,Oracle分析顯示仍有8.6個百分點的改善空間,需仰賴執行時期訊號;結構圖亦可能不適用於開放式創作等領域。此研究揭示結構與彈性之間的取捨,示範以低成本路由兼顧品質與成本,對多代理系統的委派格式設計深具參考價值。

links.title: Escaping Low-Dimensional Overlap: Multi-Task Model Merging via High-Dimensional Sparse Disentanglement

evidence: Abstract: 'In a highly conflicting four-task setting on Qwen2.5-1.5B, our method further achieves a 2.78% improvement over the strongest baseline.'
Sec 4.3 / Table 1: Qwen2.5-7B 3-task merging, Ours average 68.49 vs best baseline Task Arithmetic 67.71; HumanEval 74.40 below Fisher-Merge 75.60.
Sec 4.4 / Table 2: 4-task Qwen2.5-1.5B, Ours 36.48 vs DELLA 33.70 and TIES-Merge 29.53.
Sec 4.5 / Table 3: Projection ablation SAE 31.56 vs PCA 30.80 and Random Projection 31.01; layer selection GR-ZOO 31.56 vs Fisher 29.90, Random 27.64.
Table 4 (Appendix C): candidate/selected layers 197/16 (8.12%), cold GR-ZOO 467.13s, single-layer SAE 366.75s, peak GPU 25,153.93 MB, Top-K=32, threshold tau=1e-4, expansion 4x.
Table 5 (Appendix D): pairwise active overlap 0.3368 -> 0.0983 and task-specific active ratio 29.40% -> 73.84% after SAE.
Sec 4.2 / Figure 3: GR-ZOO recovery 62.31% (Math) and 41.46% (Code) vs full-gradient 65.73% and 46.34%.
Appendix F / Table 9: Ours 36.48 vs L1 SAE 35.24 in 4-task; HumanEval drops 32.93 -> 32.32 and BeaverTail 52.97 -> 50.55, gains concentrated in General domains.
Appendix E Tables 6-7: Top-K and threshold sensitivity with std devs, but captions mention 'IFEval-S' while columns report MMLU.
Limitations: SAE training 'still incurs additional computational overhead prior to merging' and thresholds 'may vary slightly across different model architectures (e.g., LLaMA-3 or Mistral)'.

Appendix H: Lemma 1, Theorem 1 (orthogonal decomposition cannot remove superposition conflict), Theorem 2 (sparse overcomplete decomposition bounds conflict by mu_D*sqrt(s_i s_j)*||z_i||*||z_j||) with proofs; Appendix G discloses extensive LLM-assisted proof drafting.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM-methodology paper: training-free multi-task merging of Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B experts across math reasoning, code generation, instruction following, general knowledge, and safety (Sec 4.1), strongly aligned with LLM, interpretability (SAE/superposition), and reasoning/code/safety preferences. Novelty is moderate-to-good: projecting task vectors into a sparse overcomplete SAE space before fusion extends SAE use from activation analysis to parameter-space merging (Sec 2.2), and GR-ZOO is a sensible but incremental rank-based zeroth-order layer selector (Sec 3.3). Rigor is mixed: eight baselines, projection/layer-selection ablations (Tables 3, 10), component diagnostics (Table 11), sensitivity with std (Tables 6-7), cost profiling (Table 4), and Appendx-H theory with proofs; however gains at 7B are thin (68.49 vs 67.71, Table 1), Code/HumanEval sometimes trails baselines, only one model family is tested, main tables lack significance testing, and Table 6/7 captions reference 'IFEval-S' while columns report MMLU. Evidence supports the mechanism (disentanglement metrics Table 5; GR-ZOO near-gradient recovery Fig 3) but headline margins are small outside the high-conflict 4-task 1.5B setting (36.48 vs 33.70, Table 2). Generalizability is limited by the single Qwen2.5 family and admitted hyperparameter calibration needs (Limitations). Reproducibility is aided by detailed configs (Appendix C: K=32, tau=1e-4, 4x expansion, AdamW lr 1e-4, 197/16 layers) but no code release and unspecified GR-ZOO parameters (R, epsilon, calibration set size).

primary_link.title: Escaping Low-Dimensional Overlap: Multi-Task Model Merging via High-Dimensional Sparse Disentanglement

papers.summary: Model merging provides an efficient way to construct multi-task generalist models without additional training, but its performance often degrades under severe task interference. Task interference in model merging primarily stems from \textit{superposition}, where task-specific features become entangled within the parameter space. This entanglement renders conventional decomposition methods insufficient for effectively isolating useful task directions from interfering components. In this paper, w
papers.summary_zh: 模型合併能在不需額外訓練的情況下整合多個任務專家模型,但任務干擾常導致效能下降。本文從疊加(superposition)視角切入:任務向量在參數空間中高度糾纏,傳統的座標剪枝或正交分解難以分離有用的任務方向。作者提出高維稀疏解纏合併框架,利用改良式稀疏自編碼器(SAE,結合Top-K活化、殘差擬合、解碼器標準化與正交性約束)將逐層任務向量投影至高維稀疏特徵空間,於特徵層級區分共享與任務特有特徵後再融合;並引入Group-Ranked Zeroth-Order Optimizer(GR-ZOO),僅以正向傳播估計各層敏感度,挑選關鍵層進行SAE處理以降低計算成本。在Qwen2.5-7B的三任務合併上,平均分數68.49超越Task Arithmetic等基準;在高衝突的四任務(Qwen2.5-1.5B)情境中,平均36.48,較最強基準提升2.78個百分點。消融實驗顯示SAE投影與GR-ZOO層選擇皆優於PCA、隨機投影等替代方案,理論分析亦說明稀疏過完備分解可降低跨任務衝突。限制包括SAE訓練帶來額外前置成本,擴張倍率與相似度門檻等超參數需針對不同架構微調。此方法為模型合併的干擾問題提供機制性解釋與可行的緩解路徑。

links.title: Can your AI agent be cheaper? Investigating the effects of task specifications on token spend in agentic coding tasks

evidence: Abstract: across 2,700 runs, reducing a full task specification to a bare user story raises token spend by 29.7%, and a single cheap probe prices unseen-task spend within 36%.

Section 3.2: grid of 5 tasks x 12 specifications x 3 thinking efforts x 15 repeats = 2,700 runs, all with Kimi K3 via a Modal endpoint at temperature 1.0 using the mini-swe-agent scaffold in SWE-bench Docker images.
Section 4.2: ratio between most and least expensive specification narrows from x2.13 at low effort to x1.61 at max, and removing acceptance scenarios falls from +20.1% turns to +2.1%.
Section 4.3: median geometric standard deviation of repeats is x1.34 and no specification changes it; output tokens are 2.7% of tokens processed but 51.1% of dollars at a 96.3% cache hit rate.
Section 4.4 / Table 1: prediction without a probe is 161% median error; one probe run at $0.11 cuts it to 36% (r=0.72 vs r=0.08 without probe on the prior-work correlation metric).
Appendix C: priors theta~Normal(0,0.5^2), sigma~HalfNormal(0.3) with a four-way prior sensitivity check (Table C1); the text admits that at 95% two of three 'established' effects include zero.
Appendix A: initial 60-turn limit censored sparse specifications, so affected runs were re-executed at 120 turns; the endpoint does not return deterministic output for a fixed seed.
Section 5: authors state 'Our study uses a single model, which is a core limitation' and note task sparsity and single model as key limitations.
Appendix B: full specification matrix (Table B1) and exact token lengths (Table B2) are provided; the text notes 'Neither anchors nor spec ablations are length-controlled.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical study of how task-specification detail and thinking effort affect token cost in agentic coding with an LLM (Kimi K3) on SWE-bench Verified. Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences: agents & tool use, code/programming, prompting, and reasoning-budget/test-time compute. Novelty is moderate: the design inverts prior work ([4] varies models at fixed prompts; others vary surface form only), and the claim that no prior work varies task-description detail while measuring token cost and variance appears supported by the related-work section, but the method (prompt-section ablations, hierarchical model, shared-shape + probe predictor) is straightforward. Rigor is a strength: 2,700 runs with 15 repeats, Bayesian hierarchical models with stated priors and sensitivity analysis (Table C1), honest threshold discussion (at 95% two of three established effects include zero), and re-execution of censored runs after raising the turn limit. Evidence is quantitative with credible intervals, but rests on only 5 tasks, 1 model, 1 scaffold, and no length control; several section effects are not separable from noise. Generalizability is explicitly limited by the authors (single model, sparse tasks). Reproducibility is middling: model, endpoint, temperature, scaffold, spec matrix, token counts, and full statistical model are documented, but seeds are non-deterministic and no code/artifact release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Can your AI agent be cheaper? Investigating the effects of task specifications on token spend in agentic coding tasks

papers.summary: Agentic coding workflows are now widely deployed in real-world systems. With long-horizon reasoning and tool use, token usage has become an important consideration for both cost and efficiency. Two engineers using AI will solve the same problem differently. How the specification of a task shapes an agent's token spend, and whether that spend can be predicted in advance, are open questions. Here, we study the effects of different task specifications on agentic token spend with the Kimi K3 model a
papers.summary_zh: 在agentic編碼工作流程中,Token用量已成為成本與效率的關鍵,但任務描述如何影響代理的Token花費、以及花費能否事先預測,仍缺乏系統性量化。作者以Kimi K3模型在三種思考強度(low、high、max)下,對SWE-bench Verified的五個任務各搭配12種規格變體(含完整規格、逐一刪除區段、僅剩user story,以及原始失敗測試輸出與oracle兩個錨點),重複15次,共2,700次執行,並以貝葉斯階層模型估計效應。主要發現:將完整規格刪減為僅剩user story,會使Token花費增加29.7%、回合數增加16.4%,但各任務敏感度差異極大(13%至115%);接受情境是唯一移除後具一致效果的單一區段;規格內容不影響解題率,也不影響執行間變異(中位數幾何標準差約×1.34),變異主要隨平均成本等比放大;且提示的槓桿效果隨思考強度上升而遞減。預測方面,單次約0.11美元的探測執行即可將未見任務的成本預測誤差中位數從161%降至36%;輸出Token僅佔處理量的2.7%,卻佔51.1%的成本。主要限制為僅使用單一模型與稀疏任務集。此研究提供評估與預測代理成本的實用方法,對部署AI編碼工作流程極具參考價值。

links.title: Refusal geometry reflects refusal training: diverse refusal prefixes can raise stable rank and weaken refusal vector ablation attacks

evidence: Abstract: 'activation updates resulting from refusal-completion first-token losses explain the resulting refusal direction and refusal subspace' and 'diverse refusal starts can raise stable ranks... making refusals harder to remove with a vector ablation attack'.

Section 4.1: single target model allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct (16 blocks, d=2048); datasets AdvBench, WildJailbreak, XSTest; refusal/harm scored with allenai/wildguard judge; layer 7 for frozen-model analyses.

Section 4.3: three diagnostics (mean-direction cosine, principal-angle overlap, stable rank) support Eq. 17; stable ranks ~1-3 with N=60 'excluding trivial rank cap'; leading axis of G has cosine 0.56 with refusal direction and 0.96 with mean of G at layer 7.

Section 4.4: raw-gradient transfer factor tau_15->7 = 2.270 +/- 0.175, range [1.925, 2.469] across nine m settings; k=20 shared map captures 99.8% source energy with Frobenius/spectral/transfer-factor errors 0.594/0.316/0.343.
Section 4.5: tau_G = 2.161 +/- 0.418 and tau_GradUpdate = 0.829 +/- 0.132; Figures 8-9 show higher sr(Delta_H) associated with smaller harmfulness/refusal deltas under difference-in-means ablation.

Section 4.6: controlled fine-tuning on 40 camel-ai/chemistry prompts with m in {1,4,8,12,16} refusal first-token buckets, checkpoints matched at refusal rate 0.6; Figure 11 links diversity to higher residual rank and smaller refusal deltas.

Appendix B: shared-map Lemma 3.6 result is 'an in-sample fit certificate rather than an independent prediction'; Appendix D: 'case study of one small OLMo model family, relatively small prompt sets, and English-language data'; same-set, single-attack-family threat model; multi-vector ablation and SAE attacks out of scope.

Appendix C/E: reproducible details given (eta=1e-6 per-example update for G, metric definitions in Appendix F, proofs of Lemma E.2/Corollary E.3 and Theorem E.4/Lemma E.5); no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM safety/alignment/interpretability paper studying why refusal is mediated by a low-dimensional activation direction. Core novelty is a training-origin explanation: cross-entropy gradients on refusal-completion first tokens are shown analytically (Lemma 3.1, Theorem 3.2, Lemma 3.6) and empirically to align with the difference-in-means refusal subspace, with first-token concentration controlling stable rank and, in turn, vulnerability to single-vector ablation; the 'diverse refusal starts' hardening lever is a new actionable finding. Rigor is solid: formal proofs, controlled synthetic fine-tuning with refusal-rate-matched checkpoints, explicit baselines (identity/scalar-identity maps), and unusually honest limitation sections distinguishing in-sample fit certificates from predictive bounds. However, evidence rests on a single small model (OLMo-2-0425-1B family), tiny prompt sets (N=40-80), English-only data, a correlational rank-vulnerability link in frozen-model analyses, and only difference-in-means ablation; no code release is stated. Generalizability beyond the case study is explicitly unverified. High preference relevance (AI Safety, Alignment, Interpretability, LLM) with moderate novelty and rigor, constrained evidence scope, and limited external validity yields a mid-to-good overall score.

papers.summary: Refusal training protects AI models from jailbreaks by training models to decline unsafe queries, reducing the risk of misuse. Recent work finds that refusal behavior in aligned language models can be mediated by a single activation direction or a low-dimensional refusal subspace shared across harmful prompts: ablating those directions suppresses refusals while largely preserves other model capabilities. Yet it remains unclear why safety-critical features in a wide range of models emerge and con
papers.summary_zh: 對齊後的語言模型中,拒答行為常可由單一活化方向或低維子空間中介,使其容易遭受拒答向量消融攻擊,但此低維結構的成因始終缺乏解釋。本文以OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct為案例,分析拒答訓練的梯度幾何:當有害提示配對拒答完成句時,首個目標Token的交叉熵梯度所誘導的活化變化,其均值與主方向皆與拒答方向及拒答子空間部分對齊。理論上,重複的拒答開頭(如固定以「I」開頭)會使首Token目標矩陣的穩定秩(stable rank)趨近1,梯度與拒答殘差因而低秩集中,單一向量消融即可瓦解拒答行為。作者透過凍結模型實驗與受控微調驗證此「硬化槓桿」:將拒答開頭多樣化(1至16種首Token)可提升梯度與活化變化的穩定秩,並使差異均值單向量消融後的拒答降幅變小;逐層傳遞因子約呈兩倍的秩放大。限制方面,研究僅針對單一小模型家族與英文資料,攻擊面僅涵蓋差異均值單向量消融,穩定秩亦不直接衡量因果中介強度。此工作將拒答幾何連結至訓練資料的Token層級特性,為從資料端強化安全對齊、抵抗越獄攻擊提供機制性見解。

links.title: Vowel Signs Are Not Letters: A Pre-tokenization Ceiling on Multilingual Tokenizer Fertility

evidence: §3/§5 Table 1: Proposition 1 gives training-free |T(s)| >= |P(s)| floor; all five control arms settle within 2.2% of their bound (Nepali 4.78 measured vs 4.67 bound), spanning 2.2x in predicted effect.

§5: matched pair differs only in the word_class argument over sha256-verified identical 2,000 MB corpora at 65,536 vocabulary; Nepali drops 4.78 -> 1.58 tok/word while English pays 2.1% via vocabulary reallocation.
§4 Figure 1 / Table 10: control fertility varies 1.7% across a 5%-95% Nepali corpus-share sweep vs 33.9% for treatment, separating structural ceiling from data shortage without code inspection.

§9 Table 5: fixed tokenizer reaches 0.3899 vs 0.4080 bits/byte held-out Nepali (-4.43%) at equal compute and still leads condition C (0.3925) given 1.59x compute; Limitations concede the 0.65% B-C gap is one seed with no error bars.

§7 Table 3: 63.3% of 1,345 classified top text-generation repositories (72.5% of downloads) carry letters-only pre-tokenizers; Limitations note the census is a single live-ranking snapshot measuring exposure, not harm.

§10 / Appendix B: 'make paper-harness' regenerates every number on a laptop CPU; released 65,536-entry tokenizer on HuggingFace; downstream eval fully specified at 19.1 H100 GPU-hours with corpus sha256s, library versions, and git commit 156f4527 recorded.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/NLP methodology paper: identifies a GPT-2-inherited letters-only pre-tokenization regex that imposes a training-free fertility floor on abugida scripts, matching the LLM, NLP, and training/scaling-efficiency preferences, though not the higher-weighted reasoning/agents/Japanese topics. Novelty is moderate because the repair itself is conceded prior art (o200k mark-aware class; Velayuthan & Sarveswaran 2025); the contribution is the tight Proposition 1 bound, matched-pair isolation, non-responding-sweep diagnostic, and ecosystem census. Rigor is strong: sha256-verified matched corpora with one argument changed, pre-specified language selection by predicted effect, a compute-matched control condition C, lossless round-trip checks on baselines, and unusually candid limitations (single seed, 0.65% downstream gap, translated FLORES text, 50/50 mixtures). Tokenizer-level evidence is precise and near-complete; downstream evidence (one scale, one seed, bits-per-byte only) is thin but honestly framed. Generalizability is demonstrated across 26 languages for the bound and 5 trained pairs for the controlled effect, with downstream claims deliberately narrowed. Reproducibility is exceptional: released tokenizer, one-command CPU harness regenerating all numbers, pinned hashes, commits, and census records.

primary_link.title: Vowel Signs Are Not Letters: A Pre-tokenization Ceiling on Multilingual Tokenizer Fertility

papers.summary: Byte-level BPE tokenizers that use the HuggingFace ByteLevel pre-tokenizer inherit GPT-2's word regex, where a word is defined as \p{L}+, one or more Unicode letters. In abugida scripts, vowels are written as combining marks; this pattern therefore splits each word at every vowel sign. Since BPE merges only within a pre-token, those splits persist through training regardless of vocabulary size or corpus composition. We formalise this effect as a training-free lower bound on fertility. Across 26
papers.summary_zh: 本文揭露 HuggingFace ByteLevel 前置切分器沿襲 GPT-2 正規表示式 \p{L}+（僅比對 Unicode 字母）對元音附標文字的結構性缺陷：在 abugida 中母音以結合記號書寫，屬 Mn/Mc 類別而非字母，導致每個母音符號處都被切斷；由於 BPE 合併僅發生在前置切分單位內，此切分無論詞彙表多大、語料如何調整都無法復原。作者據此證出免訓練的 fertility（每詞平均 token 數）下限，並以三類證據支持：尼泊爾語佔比由 5% 掃至 95% 時，受損 tokenizer 的 fertility 僅移動 1.7%，修復版移動 33.9%；五組僅差一個字元類別的配對實驗中，控制組全部落在預測下限 2.2% 以內，尼泊爾語由 4.78 降至 1.58 tokens/word，英文僅付出約 2.1%；三個 268M 模型中，修復版在相同運算量下 held-out Nepali bits per byte 改善 4.43%，即使讓損壞版多花 1.59 倍運算量仍居領先。普查 3,479 個 HuggingFace 儲存庫，63.3% 下載量最高的文字生成模型沿用僅字母字元類別，佔總下載量 72.5%。缺陷波及全部 17 種 abugida（藏文 1.47× 至泰文 9.02×），阿拉伯文與希伯來文加上母音標注後亦達 6.50× 與 6.14×。限制為修復屬既有技術（o200k 已採 mark-aware 詞類）、訓練配對僅五種語言、下游實驗每條件單一種子。此文顯示為英文設計的字元類別會替其他文字設下資料無法突破的天花板，而修復只需一個字元類別。

links.title: The Reasoning Tax: Token Economics of LLM Reasoning Across Task Types and Deployment Contexts

evidence: Page 1 footnote: 'Data, code, and figures available at https://github.com/Sachin-Wani/reasoning_tax' supports reproducibility claims.
Section 3.2 (pages 3-4): TES defined as accuracy delta over non-reasoning baseline divided by generated-token multiplier, with TES>1 / <=1 / <=0 interpretation bands.
Section 4.5 (page 8): one IFBench pair excluded because Grok non-reasoning variant generated 870,000 output tokens vs 48,000 for reasoning variant; explicitly documented anomaly handling.

Table 2, Section 5.2 (page 10): marginal TES declines with reasoning effort across GPT-5.x and DeepSeek V4 Pro, including negative accuracy transitions (GPT-5.2 LiveCodeBench -0.5pp; DeepSeek V4 Pro GPQA Diamond -1.7pp).
Section 5.3 (page 11): median Reasoning Cost Share of 94.7% across reasoning entries, several runs exceed 99%.
Table 3, Section 6.1 (page 12): DCM ranges 2.0x to 25.6x across six models on 8xB300, with MoE models showing larger multipliers; on-prem per-token cost derived from $1.013M five-year TCO.
Section 8 (page 15): limitations include benchmark-level mean token counts, approximated baselines (TES-A), pricing-epoch dependence, and single-turn scope; no per-problem uncertainty estimates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM research: a marginal token-efficiency metric (TES) for reasoning models spanning reasoning/CoT, evaluation benchmarking, inference serving economics, and agentic deployment discussion. The marginal (accuracy-gain-per-token-multiplier) framing differs from prior absolute efficiency metrics (OckBench, ReEfBench) and the RCS/DCM deployment-cost angles are practically useful, but the metric is a simple ratio, the overthinking/diminishing-returns phenomenon is already documented, and the task-structure taxonomy is post-hoc. Rigor is moderate: transparent definitions, explicit exclusion of an anomalous 870k-token IFBench pair, and self-run validation on 8xB300, but most data comes from third-party Artificial Analysis aggregates without controlled sampling/harness conditions, benchmarks are tiny for some tasks (AIME n=30, IFBench n=58, CritPt n=71), and no statistical significance testing or confidence intervals accompany the headline deltas. Evidence is concrete (median RCS 94.7%, DCM 2.0x-25.6x, per-model TES tables) but observational, with pricing-epoch dependence and single-turn scope acknowledged in the limitations. Reproducibility is aided by a public repository with full schema and a fully specified on-prem cost model, though closed-model API snapshots cannot be re-run. A solid, well-documented empirical benchmarking contribution rather than a methodological advance.

primary_link.title: The Reasoning Tax: Token Economics of LLM Reasoning Across Task Types and Deployment Contexts

papers.summary: Accuracy-only benchmarking of reasoning-capable large language models misses a central deployment question: when do extended thinking tokens earn their cost? We introduce the Token Economy Score (TES), a marginal benchmarking metric that measures the accuracy gain of a reasoning model over a non-reasoning baseline, normalized by the generated-token multiplier. We define paired and approximated TES variants for model families with reasoning toggles and frontier models without direct non-reasoning
papers.summary_zh: 推理型大型語言模型在數學、程式與科學基準屢創新高，卻可能產生數量級更多的思考 token；只看準確率的評測無法回答延伸思考是否值回票價。本文提出 Token Economy Score（TES）：以推理模型相對非推理基線的準確率增益（百分點）除以生成 token 倍數，衡量邊際推理效率；對具思考開關的家族採配對式 TES-Δ，對無非推理版本的 frontier 模型採 TES-A，並另定義思考成本占比 RCS 與部署成本倍數 DCM。作者彙整 151 次模型—基準評測，涵蓋七個基準與 27 個模型組態。核心發現是任務結構比名目難度更能預測推理效率：AIME 2025、LiveCodeBench 等序列推斷任務平均 TES 超過 1，而 MMLU-Pro、GPQA Diamond 等知識回憶任務雖難，TES 卻偏低，因為事實回憶與飽和天花板壓縮了增益空間。各家族提高 reasoning effort 皆出現劇烈邊際遞減，某些組合（如 DeepSeek V4 Pro 於 GPQA Diamond）加強思考反而降低準確率，呼應過度思考的失敗模式。成本面上，RCS 中位數達 94.7%，推論支出多由內部思考主導；以 8×B300 實測，自建部署比雲端 API 便宜 2 至 26 倍，MoE 架構優勢最大，可使原本不划算的推理工作負載轉為可行，作者據此提出四象限選擇準則：依任務結構、effort 等級與部署情境選擇性啟用推理。限制包括採用基準層級平均 token 數、Gemini 僅能以 TES-A 近似對照、成本依賴特定時期定價，以及 TES 為單輪指標，尚無法處理代理系統跨步驟的情境累積。

links.title: Query Expansion Is More Than Generation: Improving Dense Retrieval through Better Integration

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 12.89% relative improvement over widely-used expansion-only/text-concatenation baselines across TREC-DL, LoTTE, and BEIR

Section 5.1 / Table 2: fixed-expansion diagnostic; AnchorQE (alpha=.15) exceeds the DR baseline in all 20 strategy-benchmark comparisons while published and tuned text re-encoding fall below it in 16/20

Section 5.2 / Table 4: 10,000-query paired bootstrap and sign randomization tests; SC-AnchorQE beats published integration in 20/20 groups and DR baseline in 19/20, with collection-level CIs excluding zero

Section 5.5 / Table 7: complete 3-generator x 3-retriever matrix; SC-AnchorQE above DR baseline in 44/45 and above development-tuned fixed AnchorQE in 41/45 comparisons, no significantly negative interval
Section 6.1 / Table 8: unsupervised factor-rule ablation; conjunctive product is best stream-level rule (17/20) and outperforms cosine, overlap, RBO, entropy, and mean-based alternatives
Section 5.3 / Table 5: one-request AnchorQE vs 9-request weighted CombSUM at .19 ms/q vs 4.33 ms/q, with claimed ranking equivalence verified via .9998 top-10 overlap
Section 8 (Limitations): stream-stationarity assumption, strict no-lookahead simulation rather than temporal traffic, single shared factor per stream

Appendix A: QuDAR reproduction at commit 0702721e with a re-implemented sparse backend; reproduced QuDAR baselines score far below SC-AnchorQE (e.g., T19 .6332 vs .7366), fidelity not externally verifiable
Section 4.1 and Appendix B: decoding parameters, seeds, and exact prompts are specified, but the document contains no code, index, or artifact availability statement
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-for-retrieval methodology: LLM generators (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B) produce query expansions integrated into frozen dense retrievers, squarely matching RAG & Knowledge and LLM preferences. The controlled fixed-expansion protocol isolating the integration variable is a genuinely useful reframing, and the evaluation is unusually rigorous (18 streams, paired bootstrap, sign randomization, 3x3 generator-retriever matrix, factor-rule ablations, serving-cost check, qualitative cases, explicit limitations). However, the core technique is simple and incremental: normalized vector interpolation is close to existing score fusion and HyDE-style vector averaging, the equivalence proposition is elementary, and the calibration signal is a heuristic product of two ratios. QuDAR reproduction numbers look implausibly weak, and no code/artifact release is stated. Strong, well-supported empirical paper with moderate novelty.

primary_link.title: Query Expansion Is More Than Generation: Improving Dense Retrieval through Better Integration

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate query expansions without task-specific training, yet the same expansions often make a frozen dense retriever worse. We identify an underexplored factor: prior work has often focused on what text is generated, while how generated text is incorporated into dense retrievers has received less systematic attention. By holding generated expansions fixed, we show that performance degradation can often be attributed to the integration method itself. We introduce
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型可在零樣本下生成查詢擴展，但同樣的擴展文字常令凍結的稠密檢索器變差。作者指出被忽略的變因是整合方式：僅用擴展檢索會丟棄原始查詢，文字串接則因分詞、注意力與池化使查詢與擴展糾纏，兩者皆未顯式控制擴展對查詢表示的影響力。本文提出 AnchorQE：分別編碼並正規化原始查詢與擴展，再以內插因子 α 混合，將查詢錨點保留於單一向量，免重訓、免重建索引；理論上證明其排序等價於加權 CombSUM 分數融合，並給出擴展角位移的最壞情況上限。為免依賴標註調參，SC-AnchorQE 僅用資料流開頭 8 筆未標註查詢，以擴展自身檢索強度與其和原查詢檢索證據一致性兩比率的乘積估計 α 後凍結。實驗涵蓋 TREC-DL、LoTTE 與 BEIR：固定擴展文字下，傳統整合在 20 個比較中 16 個低於純稠密檢索基線，AnchorQE 則全數超越，相對增益最高 12.89%；SC-AnchorQE 在 20 個比較全數勝過各方法原始整合，並於多數情況追平或超越以開發集調校的固定權重（最高 3.81%）。單向量整合只需一次索引請求，遠低於融合法的 N+1 次；三生成器乘三檢索器共 45 個組合中 44 個優於無擴展基線。限制包括流層級因子遇分佈劇變可能失準、單一共用因子無法因應每筆異常擴展，且整合改善無法彌補生成品質本身不足。
