llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper: adaptive privileged-teacher self-distillation for mathematical reasoning on Qwen3, squarely matching LLM and reasoning/CoT preferences plus training/optimization. The asymmetric alternating update (clipped forward KL student, full reverse KL teacher) is a sensible but incremental extension of the recent OPSD method, related to mutual/online distillation and interactive imitation learning. Rigor is solid: matched baselines (SFT, GRPO, OPSD at 100/200 steps, two custom privileged variants), three scales, a clean teacher-objective ablation (DualOPSD-C) that separates adaptation from extra steps, KL/truncation diagnostics, and paired bootstrap intervals for the scale interaction. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1 deltas match the abstract: +23.61/+13.89/+10.00 at 8B) but rests on one seed, one model family, and only 90 eval problems per scale, and the 1.7B result is negative, which the authors honestly report. Generalizability is explicitly constrained by the scale-dependent effect; reproducibility is strong via Appendix A prompts, hyperparameters, and cost accounting, though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: DualOPSD: Adaptive Privileged Teachers for On-Policy Self-Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged copy of the student model to provide dense supervision without an external teacher. OPSD keeps this privileged teacher fixed, even though the student distribution and output style change during training. We propose DualOPSD, an asymmetric alternating framework that adapts both policies. The student first learns from the privileged teacher. The teacher then moves toward the updated student distribution on the same student trajectory. This updat
papers.summary_zh: 線上自我蒸餾（OPSD）以同一基礎模型的特權副本擔任教師：教師可讀取僅限訓練期使用的參考解答，在學生自行取樣的軌跡上逐 token 提供緻密監督，但教師全程固定。作者指出此假設過強——逐點裁切雖能擋下與學生不相容的風格訊號，凍結的教師卻無從回應屢遭拒絕的監督，也跟不上學生分佈的變化。DualOPSD 提出非對稱交替更新：學生先以裁切後的前向 KL 向特權教師學習；教師隨後在同一條學生軌跡上，以完整反向 KL 朝更新後的學生分佈收斂，不需額外取樣或正確性驗證器。兩政策以單一凍結基礎模型上的兩個 LoRA adapter 實作，各自擁有參數與最佳化器狀態。實驗於 Qwen3 非思考模式三種規模進行：8B 時 DualOPSD 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 的 avg@12 較 OPSD 提升 23.61、13.89、10.00 點；4B 亦有增益，1.7B 反而退步，顯示效果強烈依賴模型規模。三種規模的截斷率皆下降，但長度變化無法完全解釋準確率；4B 診斷顯示師生雙向 KL 同時下降。消融實驗確認教師端完整反向 KL 優於裁切變體，且增益並非僅來自額外步數。訓練成本僅增約四成（4B 由 1.00 增至 1.40 A100 小時）。限制包括單一模型家族、單一訓練種子、每規模僅 90 道競賽題，1.7B 的反轉使結論無法宣稱與規模無關。此研究將特權教師由靜態目標轉為能回應學習者的閉迴路，為蒸餾中教師端的設計開出新方向。
papers.title: DualOPSD: Adaptive Privileged Teachers for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.title_zh: DualOPSD：線上自我蒸餾的自適應特權教師

links.title: When Pruning Meets Interpretability: Preserving Sparse Autoencoder Robustness in LLMs

evidence: Sec. 3, Thm. 3.2: degradation bound decomposes into intrinsic SAE error plus (1+L)^2 * epsilon^2 and a cross term, with epsilon^2 = tr(DeltaW * Sigma_xin * DeltaW^T) (covariance-weighted norm).
Sec. 3, Cor. 3.3 and Eq. (9): hierarchy magnitude (identity covariance) < Wanda (diagonal) < SparseGPT (full second-order) as approximations of epsilon^2.

Table 1 (Sec. 6): gemma-2-2b at 50% sparsity; magnitude pruning in middle layers drops SCR Top-10 from 0.3047 to 0.1301 and TPP from 0.0424 to 0.0089, while Wanda/SparseGPT stay near baseline; KL scores remain >=0.96, supporting the claim that Core metrics understate damage.

Table 7 (App. A.4): measured epsilon^2 ordering SparseGPT < Wanda < Magnitude holds in every layer group (e.g., middle: 20.70 < 21.16 < 47.13); middle layers have lowest local epsilon^2 yet highest degradation, attributed to upstream perturbation accumulation.

Table 3 (Sec. 6): layer-wise schedule lowers perplexity on gemma-2-2b (Wanda 212->148, SparseGPT 141->98 at 50% average sparsity); Sec. 7 Limitations concedes it is 'a preliminary illustration' and is not benchmarked against OWL.

Sec. 5: four model-SAE pairs (pythia-70m, gemma-2-2b, gemma-2-9b, mistral-7b) with fixed pretrained SAELens checkpoints; Wanda/SparseGPT calibration on 128 OpenWebText samples; sparsity levels 25/40/50%.

Sec. 7 Limitations: SAE weights fixed (no retraining), four relatively homogeneous architectures, residual-stream SAEs only, unstructured pruning only, no theoretical explanation of the middle-layer finding.
Abstract and Sec. 5: code 'publicly available at sae-robustness-under-pruning'; no statistical significance testing or seed variance reported anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability + compression work: studies SAE robustness under magnitude/Wanda/SparseGPT pruning with a perturbation-energy framework, validated on SAEBench across four LLMs. Strongly aligned with LLM, interpretability, and efficiency preferences; not an out-of-scope domain. Theory is correct but elementary (Lipschitz triangle-inequality bound plus a trace identity), and the 'joint sufficiency' argument for the metric suite is informal. Evidence is solid: controlled fixed-SAE design, per-layer tables, threshold-sensitivity check, and direct measurement of epsilon^2 confirming the predicted method ordering, though the strict SparseGPT>Wanda ordering is slightly oversold relative to tables where Wanda sometimes wins, no error bars/significance tests are given, and the layer-wise sparsity result is perplexity-only on one model without an OWL baseline (acknowledged in Limitations). Generalizability limited to residual-stream SAEs, unstructured pruning, and a homogeneous model set. Reproducibility is good: public code, public SAELens checkpoints, calibration data and sparsity levels specified.

primary_link.title: When Pruning Meets Interpretability: Preserving Sparse Autoencoder Robustness in LLMs

papers.summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret the internal representations of large language models (LLMs), yet their reliability under post-hoc model compression remains poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how pruning affects SAE behavior and theoretically show that, for a fixed SAE, its impact is governed by perturbation energy, a covariance-weighted norm. This perspective exposes a key limitation of magnitude pruning: by ignoring activation geometry, it distorts the
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏自動編碼器(SAE)是機制可解釋性研究的核心工具,但其在大型語言模型經事後壓縮(如權重剪枝)後是否依然可靠,先前缺乏系統性理解。本文提出擾動理論框架,證明對固定的 SAE 而言,剪枝造成的退化由「擾動能量」(ε²,一種以共變異數加權的範數)主導:影響不僅取決於權重改變多少,更取決於擾動如何與輸入共變異數結構對齊。此觀點揭示 magnitude 剪枝忽略激活幾何,會誘發最大擾動能量並嚴重破壞 SAE 行為;而 Wanda 與 SparseGPT 等激活感知方法隱式控制該量,較能保留可解釋性。實驗以 SAEBench 的四類指標(Core、Feature Absorption、SCR、TPP)在 gemma-2-2b、gemma-2-9b、mistral-7b 與 pythia-70m 上驗證理論排序,並一致發現中間層(9–17 層)對剪枝最為敏感,據此提出逐層稀疏度分配策略,在相同平均稀疏度下取得更低困惑度。局限包括:全程固定 SAE 權重、僅檢驗四組模型—SAE 配對、限於非結構化剪枝,逐層分配亦僅屬初步示範。此研究為部署壓縮模型時,既有可解釋性分析能否轉移提供理論依據與實用指引。
papers.title: When Pruning Meets Interpretability: Preserving Sparse Autoencoder Robustness in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 當剪枝遇上可解釋性:於大型語言模型中保留稀疏自動編碼器的穩健性

links.title: Beyond Scaling: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Hardware Kernel Optimization via an Experience-Driven Workflow and Experience Graph Memory

evidence: Abstract: reports 1.54x geometric-mean per-operator speedup vs CANNBot under GLM-5.2; context ablation raises pass rate 60.0%->84.6% and cuts tokens 15.9B->1.113B
Section 'Metrics and Artifact Provenance': pass rate uses full 1,060-case denominator with missing operators counted as failures; geometric mean explicitly labeled a descriptive statistic
Section 'Scope of the Evidence': each Table 1 cell 'is represented by its best archived job' and 'Repeated paired runs are required to estimate run-to-run variance'
Ablation Study 2 / Table 3: the 'Without' speedups are derived via matched positive-timing ratios rather than a direct run; L4 effect rests on only 28 paired cases; 412-pair aggregate is 1.434x
Appendix A, Table 5: Ascend-source memory raises coverage 60.3%->83.3% but lowers fixed-intersection geometric mean 0.388x->0.145x; combined setting reaches 0.786x, below PyTorch parity
Section 'Evaluation Configurations': final-evaluator JSON leaves model/agent/context fields blank, so labels come from the author-maintained run mapping

Section 'Experience Graph Memory': scoring hyperparameters w_self=w_succ=0.5, gamma=0.7 are specified, but context caps are 'fixed for each reported model' without reported values; no code-release claim appears in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent systems paper: the methodology (Experience Graph Memory, tiered active context management/injection, fixed-parameter agent loop) sits squarely in high-weight agent/memory/RAG/long-context/code preferences, with kernel optimization as the evaluation domain rather than the contribution. Novelty is moderate: decision-to-outcome graph memory with discounted downstream scoring and budgeted context assembly is a sensible but incremental combination over ExpeL, MemGPT, and ReMe (which the paper itself uses as substrate). Rigor is above average due to precise metric definitions, full-denominator pass rates, paired timing analysis, and unusually candid limitation discussion, but is held back by single-run, best-archived-artifact selection per cell, a conflated active-vs-passive ablation, and a 'Without' memory condition that is derived from matched timing ratios rather than independently run. Evidence strength is moderate: large 1,060-case suite and a genuine cross-hardware appendix, but no variance estimates, conditional speedup statistics over small subsets, and generated kernels remaining below vendor-library/PyTorch parity in aggregate (0.066x vs CANN fields; 0.786x vs PyTorch on K3), so headline 1.54x is a ratio of conditional geometric means, not absolute acceleration. Generalizability is decent (two models, two hardware stacks, two kernel languages) with the honest finding that feasibility knowledge transfers but performance knowledge does not. Reproducibility is limited: pinned environments and hyperparameters (w=0.5, gamma=0.7) are given, but no code/artifact release is stated, context caps are undisclosed, and run labels rely on an author-maintained mapping.

primary_link.title: Beyond Scaling: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Hardware Kernel Optimization via an Experience-Driven Workflow and Experience Graph Memory

radar.summary: Hardware kernel optimization requires repeated compilation, correctness testing, profiling, and revision. LLM agents can automate parts of this process, and stronger foundation models, longer context windows, and longer execution horizons have improved optimization within individual tasks. These advances alone do not enable an agent to learn from completed optimization runs. Existing kernel-optimization agents seldom preserve a decision, its observed execution feedback, and the later decisions t
radar.summary_zh: 硬體核心(kernel)最佳化需反覆編譯、正確性測試、效能剖析與修訂,但現有 LLM 代理多將執行回饋僅用於當前任務,難以累積為可重複使用的知識,保留全部軌跡又會與當前任務爭奪脈絡空間。本文提出 KOPE 框架,在基礎模型參數固定的前提下,將每次嘗試的決策、編譯診斷、正確性與量測效能記錄於「經驗圖記憶」(KOPE-Mem),以有向圖保留決策順序、觀察結果與替代分支;並透過「主動脈絡管理與注入」在固定 token 預算下檢索相關經驗組裝提示。在華為 Ascend 910C 的 CANN Bench(53 個運算子、1,060 個案例)上,GLM-5.2 之每運算子加速幾何平均達最強基線 CANNBot 的 1.54 倍;消融顯示主動脈絡管理將通過率自 60.0% 提升至 84.6%,token 消耗自 15.9B 降至 1.113B;啟用經驗圖記憶使通過率自 55.2% 升至 84.6%,並在 412 個配對案例取得 1.43 倍幾何平均加速。附錄的 RISC-V(SpacemiT K3)重定向實驗顯示跨硬體經驗可轉移覆蓋率,但效能需仰賴目標端經驗方能恢復。局限為各組態僅單次封存運行,變異尚待重複實驗估計。對公開資料稀缺的新硬體,此框架展現持續最佳化的可行路徑。

links.title: How Unlikely Is "Unlikely"? Assessing Verbal Probability Perception Across Large Language Models

evidence: Section 3 (Models): 19 models across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, Alibaba under three prompt conditions; 10 repeats per word-condition and 5x-repeated roundtrips per sampled number.

Section 4.1: 'the aggregate LLM mean (approx 51) sits well above the human mean (approx 37)' at 'possible', with the widest confidence band; anchors 'impossible', 'even chance', 'certain' recovered with near-zero variance.

Section 4.2: upward bias significant via Wilcoxon signed-rank across 19 models (p<.01 under both prompts), but negative-word asymmetry only marginal (paired t-test p=0.05, Wilcoxon p=.067) and explicitly treated as 'suggestive rather than established'.

Section 4.4, Table 2: MARE ranking with quantization floor and permutation tests; Mistral-7B not distinguishable from chance (p=.1024) under any correction; Bonferroni threshold alpha/19 approx .0026 applied.
Section 4.4: 'Each model ends up with 26 blocks each, instead of 30 blocks' yet MARE is defined with N=150, an internal trial-count inconsistency (26x5=130).

Section 5 (Limitations): default temperatures 'not standardized across providers', N=10 per triplet, single fixed instruction template, untested prompt robustness, and dated human benchmark from Mosteller and Youtz (1990).

Section 4.3: qualitative trace analysis quoting GPT-5.4-nano scale inversion ('I estimate a 90% chance' at 'impossible') and gpt-oss-20b task misidentification (evaluating likelihood of the prompt text itself).
No code, data, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; reproducibility rests on verbatim prompts (Prompts 1, 2, 3a, 3b) and API access to named models.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systematic behavioral evaluation of 19 LLMs on verbal probability interpretation against the Mosteller-Youtz human benchmark, squarely within LLM methodology scope (evaluation, prompting/explanation elicitation, uncertainty communication). Novel contributions include a bidirectional roundtrip consistency test with a derived quantization floor (Appendix A) and permutation-based chance baselines separating vocabulary limits from genuine incoherence. Statistical practice is unusually self-critical: underpowered polarity-asymmetry tests (p=.05/.067) are explicitly flagged as suggestive, and Bonferroni/Holm corrections are applied to 19 permutation tests (Section 4.4, Table 2). Deductions: a minor internal inconsistency (26 blocks x 5 trials = 130 vs stated N=150 in Section 4.4), non-standardized default temperatures acknowledged as a confound, a single fixed prompt template, only 10 samples per (model, word, condition) cell, no code/data availability statement, and a narrow stimulus set (11 English expressions, no statement context). Findings (upward bias, anchor fidelity, 'possible' instability, scale-linked roundtrip stratification) are well-supported within their stated scope but not released for independent verification.

primary_link.title: How Unlikely Is "Unlikely"? Assessing Verbal Probability Perception Across Large Language Models

radar.summary: Large language models increasingly produce and interpret verbal probability expressions, yet whether these expressions carry consistent meaning across models (or match human perceptions of uncertainty) remains unknown. We present a systematic cross-model evaluation using a word-to-number mapping task grounded in established human benchmarks. Eleven uncertainty expressions were presented to 19 models under two conditions, forced single-number response and explanation elicitation, alongside a nove
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常以「likely」、「unlikely」等口語機率詞彙傳達不確定性,但這些詞在不同模型間的數值意涵是否一致、是否符合人類認知,先前缺乏系統檢驗。本文以 Mosteller 與 Youtz 的人類薈萃基準為依據,向 19 個模型呈現 11 個機率表達,在強制單一數值回應與解釋引發兩種提示條件下測試,並新增雙向往返(roundtrip)實驗檢驗映射的內部一致性。結果顯示 LLM 相當忠實地追蹤人類基準:詞序保留,「impossible」、「even chance」、「certain」三個錨點以近零變異重現;「possible」則呈現最高變異與跨模型分歧,呼應人類研究中該詞的雙峰不穩定解讀。然而模型系統性高估各表達的機率,尤以負向詞彙為甚。解釋引發降低模型內變異卻擴大模型間分歧;往返實驗呈明顯分層,前沿模型維持一致的雙向映射,Mistral-7B 等則與隨機無異,同家族比較亦支持規模效應。此偏誤具實務風險:讀者可能低估模型以負向措辭傳達的機率,導致錯誤安心或過度悲觀。局限包括預設溫度未標準化、每組合僅 10 個樣本、單一提示模板,且人類基準年代久遠。

Table 10 (Appendix C.1): paired deltas with CIs excluding zero on all four benchmarks, e.g., SCI-VerifyBench +3.12 [+2.44, +3.80].
Table 2 (Section 4.4): 2,665 direct decisions, 32.13% fallback call reduction, 149 prompt-only errors corrected; direct audit Table 11 reports M-err.=0 with Wilson LB 99.86.
Table 12 (Appendix C.2): generic heuristic control covers 502 examples with 15 regressions, reducing micro accuracy 91.15 to 91.02.
Table 13 (Appendix C.2): promotion-check ablation shows support-only policy accepts 95 candidates admitting 36 replay errors and 286 counterexample failures.
Table 14 (Appendix C.2): swapping fallback to Qwen3-4B improves macro 89.31 to 91.62 with same code modules, supporting cross-model transfer.

Section 4.2: margins over best per-benchmark baselines are small (+0.15, +0.53, +0.22, +0.10) and baselines (CoSineVerifier, SCI-Verifier) are reported numbers with starred averages using fewer than four benchmarks.
Table 5 (Appendix B.1): construction uses GPT-5.5 'xhigh reasoning' agents; Table 15 estimates submission session cost $2.55K-$5.10K, proprietary and non-deterministic.
Table 7 (Appendix B.2): leakage audit shows zero exact/fuzzy verifier-triple overlaps against 8,295 evaluation examples.
Limitations section: scope restricted to reference-based binary verification; open construction agents, versioned rule libraries, and release mechanics deferred to future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: reference-based answer verification for reasoning models and RLVR outcome rewards, with an agent-style non-parametric loop (LLM agents mine rule cards, generate code modules, optimize prompts). Strong controlled attribution (same GPT-5.4-Mini fallback; official prompt 91.03 vs prompt 91.29 vs prompt+code 93.05 macro), paired CIs excluding zero on all four benchmarks, a negative heuristic control, promotion-check ablation, leakage audit, and a Qwen3-4B fallback-swap diagnostic. Novelty is moderate: it adapts a known non-parametric skill-learning pattern (Voyager/Skill-Pro lineage, self-cited) to verification with a sensible conservative replay-validation gate. Weaknesses: headline 'outperforms SOTA' rests partly on reported numbers from different, uncontrolled models with small margins (+0.15/+0.53/+0.22/+0.10); construction depends on proprietary GPT-5.5 with costly sessions (~$2.55K-$5.10K estimated) and curated 5,000-example pool; artifact release is phrased conditionally ('should contain'), limiting reproducibility; scope confined to binary verification. Nonetheless in-scope, honest about prompt-only gains being mixed, and unusually well-audited.

primary_link.title: AutoVerifier: Residual-Guided Non-Parametric Optimization for Reference-Based Answer Verification

radar.summary: Reference-based verifiers are important for evaluating reasoning models and providing accurate outcome rewards in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To improve verification accuracy, prior work has explored rule-based, model-based, and tool-augmented verifiers for checking answer equivalence across diverse answer forms. However, the equivalence of answer forms such as $1+3.14$ and $1+π$ may depend on the question and scoring criterion. We frame such implicit assumptions as verifier
radar.summary_zh: 基於參考答案的驗證器廣泛用於評估推理模型,並在可驗證獎勵的強化學習中提供結果獎勵。然而諸如「1+3.14」與「1+π」是否等價,取決於題目與評分標準,這類隱含假設被本文界定為「驗證器歸納偏誤」。作者提出 AutoVerifier,一種殘差引導的非參數最佳化方法:先在 5,000 個建構樣本上重放現有驗證器,將重複出現的錯誤聚類為規則卡,記錄偏差及支持例與反例;僅當重放驗證確認無直接退化時,才將具確定性比較邏輯的規則卡晉升為程式碼模組,需模型判斷者則納入提示引導,使被接受的更新可稽核、可編輯、可重複使用。在 VerifyBench、VerifyBench-Hard、SCI-VerifyBench 與 VerifierBench 四項基準上,AutoVerifier 達 93.05% 巨觀準確率,優於規則式、模型式與工具增強等驗證器;相較僅用提示的設定,加入程式碼模組提升 1.76 個百分點,並減少 32.13% 的備援模型呼叫。局限包括僅限二元參考驗證、固定建構池與凍結推論介面。此方法示範如何從驗證錯誤中自動學得可稽核的比較邏輯,對基準評測與 RLVR 獎勵品質皆有價值。

links.title: A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: compiles knowledge-graph subgraphs into per-entity LoRA adapters on Qwen3.5-2B and tests whether fine-tuning stores recoverable closed-book facts, directly engaging parametric RAG, knowledge storage in LLM weights, and retrieval. Preference relevance is high (LLM, RAG & Knowledge, memory, training/LoRA, weight-space analysis). Novelty is moderate-good: it builds on Parametric RAG/Dynamic PRAG but tests their implicit storage assumption on KG subgraphs and reports a clean storage-retrieval dissociation. Rigor is above workshop average: paired bootstrap CIs, wrong-adapter and random-weight negative controls, permutation/column-shuffle nulls for the geometry correlation, honest floor-effect caveats and metric-artifact handling. Evidence is solid within its narrow scope but rests on only 150 entities, 30 retrieval queries, 4 held-out QA pairs per entity, model-generated QA pairs, one model and one benchmark; the composition experiment yields no result (all conditions at floor). Generalizability is explicitly limited (single-domain film KG, single-valued relations only). Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, prompt template, and SVD math are provided, but no code/data release and the QA-pair generation procedure is underspecified.

primary_link.title: A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory

radar.summary: Graph retrieval-augmented generation places retrieved subgraphs into the model's context window at query time, paying a recurring token cost and exposing source data on every call. We study an alternative: compiling a knowledge graph offline into a bank of LoRA adapters, one per entity, that serve as a parametric knowledge layer queried by injecting weights rather than text, at zero query-time context cost. On the MetaQA dataset, we find that subgraph-trained adapters encode context-free factual
radar.summary_zh: 圖形檢索增強生成(Graph RAG)每次查詢都需將檢索到的子圖放進上下文,付出重複的 token 成本並暴露原始資料。本文研究替代方案:離線把知識圖譜逐實體編譯成 LoRA 轉接器庫,查詢時以權重注入取代文字檢索,實現零上下文 token 成本的參數化記憶。在 MetaQA 電影知識圖譜上,以 Qwen3.5-2B 為基底的實驗顯示,子圖訓練的轉接器確實儲存可泛化的閉卷知識:單值關係的精確匹配分數較近乎全盲的基底模型(0.007)提升 +0.243,且僅有正確的轉接器能取回該知識,oracle 差距為 +0.283;與錯誤轉接器、隨機權重轉接器的對照證實知識具實體專一性。然而核心發現是儲存與檢索的脫節:僅憑問題文字,無論句嵌入或 ΔW 權重幾何的檢索都只有隨機水準,因為語義相近實體的轉接器並不含答案,知識屬局部儲存且不會轉移;權重幾何雖與子圖語義相關(ρ=+0.329),卻無法轉為功能性檢索,多跳組合亦無法以樸素合併解決。成本分析指出參數化記憶的查詢上下文 token 為零,但每個轉接器約 10.4 MiB,適合穩定且高頻查詢的子圖。此研究確立參數化知識圖譜記憶可行,並點出以語義相似度以外的機制選擇與組合轉接器,是邁向實用部署的關鍵待解問題。
radar.title: A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory
radar.title_zh: 參數化知識圖譜記憶中的儲存—檢索落差

links.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography

evidence: §3.5 & Table 1: three scales (467M/709M/1.03B params) trained with identical architecture, vocabulary size, and training procedure; only surface form varied.

§4.2 & Table 2: romanized pretraining achieves best macro-F1 at every scale (e.g., XNLI macro 72.61 vs 69.36 text at Small; 81.60 vs 79.67 at Large), bolded as significant under approximate randomization test p<0.05 (§4).
§4.2 'Romanized finetuning a text-pretrained model degrades performance on seen languages': Text→Rom macro drops on XNLI (69.36→63.47 Small; 79.67→70.38 Large) and MASSIVE (69.81→45.25 Small).
§4.2 & Table 7: controlled GPT-2 English-only experiment reproduces prior romanized fine-tuning gains (MASSIVE macro 45.0→60.9 at GPT-2 Large), qualifying Husain et al. (2024).
§4.2 Tables 3 & 5: romanization wins transfer to unseen languages (e.g., XNLI Large macro 74.48 vs 68.14 text).
Appendix E, Tables 13-15: 32-bit BPE overflow bug patched to 64-bit; MASSIVE macro-F1 changes ≤0.46 and all representation orderings preserved.

§6 Limitations: models far below 7B+ contemporary scale; only alphabetic/abugida scripts (no logographic); Phonemizer quality and heuristic IPA stripping may affect IPA conclusions; P2G conversion for generative use unevaluated.
Abstract/§6: 'Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance' — no currently available artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multilingual LLM pretraining study (decoder-only causal LMs trained from scratch to 1.03B params) with direct relevance to LLM (w2.5), NLP, Training/Optimization, Prompting/ICL, and tokenization-efficiency preferences; no Japanese-specific content and no agents/code/safety coverage limits the preference fit. Novelty is solid: first controlled three-way comparison of orthographic text vs IPA vs romanization in autoregressive pretraining, plus a counterintuitive finding that Text→Rom fine-tuning regresses performance on languages already covered by a multilingual base model, while reproducing prior gains on English-only GPT-2 (Table 7). Rigor is high: matched architecture, data, 100K vocab, and training procedure across three scales; significance testing via approximate randomization (p<0.05, §4); hyperparameter grids (Appendix C); bilingual reference ablations; and an unusually transparent handling of a discovered tokenizer integer-overflow bug with re-runs showing orderings preserved (Appendix E). Evidence is extensive across seen/unseen languages and prompting vs fine-tuning regimes (Tables 2-6), though the compute/token-count asymmetry (50B text vs 33B IPA/rom tokens, §3.2) is only argued to be conservative rather than matched, and BPC numbers are acknowledged as non-comparable (Appendix B). Generalizability is moderate: ≤1B non-embedding-scale, only alphabetic/abugida scripts (no logographic), four unseen transfer languages, and Phonemizer quality caveats (§6). Reproducibility is middling: detailed pipelines and hyperparameters are reported, but code/data are only promised 'upon acceptance' (Abstract/§6) and no artifact link exists.

primary_link.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography

radar.summary: Multilingual language models transfer knowledge across languages through shared subword vocabulary, a mechanism that breaks down when related languages use different writing systems. Prior work addresses this via script equalization (romanization or IPA transcription), but direct comparisons are rare; the focus has been on encoder-only models, with most work adapting existing pretrained models. We systematically compare different input representations in autoregressive multilingual pretraining,
radar.summary_zh: 多語言模型仰賴共享子詞詞彙實現跨語言轉移,但相關語言若使用不同書寫系統,此機制便告失效。過往解法多以羅馬化或 IPA 音標進行文字系統均等化,但多半是在 encoder-only 模型上於 fine-tuning 階段補救,鮮少在自迴歸模型的預訓練中直接比較。本文在控制變因下,以三種規模(467M、709M、1.03B)從零預訓練自迴歸語言模型,涵蓋四組類型學配對的八種語言(英—西、俄—波、印地—烏爾都、坦米爾—馬拉雅拉姆),比較原生文字、IPA 與羅馬化三種輸入表示。結果顯示:羅馬化預訓練在零樣本提示(XStoryCloze、XCOPA)、XNLI、MASSIVE、XL-Sum 等已見與未見語言的各項評估、所有規模下都最強,且優勢隨模型規模擴大;IPA 在多數情境優於原生文字,僅在音韻高度重疊、書寫系統迥異的印地—烏爾都配對追平羅馬化,對未見語言的轉移則落後。令人意外的是,將原生文字預訓練模型在羅馬化資料上 fine-tuning(過往文獻建議的做法)反而損害模型已涵蓋語言的表現,僅在模型本來缺乏該書寫系統覆蓋時有幫助;作者以英文單語 GPT-2 重現先前文獻的增益,證實此不對稱性。限制包括模型規模僅約 1B、未涵蓋中文等表意文字系統,以及 IPA 音素化品質與轉回原生文字的可行性尚待評估。結論主張:若重視對未見書寫系統的轉移,羅馬化應視為預訓練階段的核心設計選擇,而非事後補救。
radar.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography
radar.title_zh: 一種形式轉移一切:超越原生書寫系統的多語言模型預訓練

links.title: SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills

evidence: Section 3.1-3.3: agent receives only (P, Sigma_t, O_t); reasoning trace discarded after validated state update; complexity analysis claims O(1) prompt and O(T) cumulative tokens vs O(T^2) for append-only history (Eqs. 5-7).

Section 5.1: baselines are Prompt (ReAct), Memory (Summarization), Stateful (LangGraph), plus Truncated, Summary-capped, and ReAct+LLMLingua controls; Gemini-3-Flash, Gemma-4-31B-it, Qwen-3-8B-it; temperature 0.0, top-p 1.0; 5 generator seeds, paired t-test p<0.01 claimed for T>=50.
Table 1: at T=200, SKILL.state 0.94±0.02 accuracy with ~1,811-token prompts and 122k total tokens vs Memory 0.84±0.09 with 84,364-token prompts and 6.18M tokens.
Table 5 (budget-matched, T=100, ~1,800 tokens): Truncated 0.18, Summary-capped 0.52, ReAct+LLMLingua 0.22 vs SKILL.state 0.94 — key evidence gains are not merely from shorter prompts.

Table 4: InterCode CTF pass@1 54.2% (vs Memory 46.4%, Stateful 41.8%); tau-Bench Airline 32.4% (vs Stateful 28.1%); token cuts 60.4%/65.9% on CTF and 40.5%/45.4% on Airline — arithmetic consistent with the text in Section 5.5.

Tables 7-8 / Section 5.7: on Gemma-4-31B at T=100 SKILL.state scores 0.42±4.1% equal to Stateful 0.42±4.5%, with 68% of errors being premature state overwrites — accuracy gains shrink on open-weight models.

Section 7 Limitations: sufficient-statistic assumption fails when schema is unknown in advance, relevant past observations go unrecognized, or the objective is defined over the trajectory; single-agent only; concurrent multi-agent writes unexercised.
Anomaly: Table 1 (T=50, no noise) reports Memory 0.93±0.03, but Table 2 at 5 noise events reports Memory 1.00 despite Appendix C stating noise never alters ground-truth state.

Appendix A provides exact runtime prompts for all four runtimes; Appendix B gives SkillExecBench state/action/transition specs and Algorithm 2 pseudo-code; however, no code or benchmark release link appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic: an LLM agent runtime contribution (agents/tool-use, long-context/memory, efficiency) replacing append-only history with explicit structured execution state, evaluated on agent benchmarks. Novelty is moderate: the core idea (structured state, discard reasoning traces) is simple and adjacent to dialogue state tracking, LangGraph-style state, and MemGPT-style memory; the contribution is a clean runtime framing plus O(1)/O(T) complexity analysis rather than a new mechanism. Rigor is above average: three primary runtime baselines plus three budget-matched compression controls (Table 5 is the key ablation showing 0.94 vs 0.18-0.52 at matched ~1,800-token budgets), three model families, 5 seeds with claimed paired t-tests, and an error taxonomy for open-weight models. Evidence is largely internally consistent (Table 4 pass@1 and token-reduction arithmetic checks out; flat ~1,700-1,900-token prompts across horizons), but weak spots exist: a 4-scenario recovery study, no variance reported for public benchmarks, an anomaly where Memory improves from 0.93 (Table 1, T=50, no noise) to 1.00 under noise (Table 2) despite noise being non-state-altering, and accuracy advantages nearly vanish on open-weight models (Gemma T=100: 0.42 vs 0.42 Stateful), limiting generality claims. Honest limitations section covers the sufficient-statistic assumption, single-agent scope, and structured-output fragility. Reproducibility is partial: exact prompts (Appendix A), task-generation pseudo-code, and deterministic decoding are provided, but no code/data release URL is stated and headline results use a proprietary model.

primary_link.title: SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents executing complex, long-running procedural skills. Existing agent runtimes maintain execution by continually appending observations, actions, and intermediate reasoning traces to an ever-growing conversation history, causing latency degradation and context-poisoning failures over long horizons. We present SKILL.state, a runtime architecture that replaces append-only conversational history with an explicit, mutable execution state
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理人執行長時程的多步驟流程技能時,現行執行環境普遍把觀察、動作與推理軌跡不斷附加到對話歷史,造成提示膨脹、token 消耗以 O(T²) 增長,過時資訊更引發情境汙染。本文提出 SKILL.state,以明確、可變動的結構化執行狀態取代僅附加式歷史:每步模型只收到不可變的技能規格、當前結構化狀態與最新觀察,推理軌跡在產出經驗證的狀態更新後立即丟棄,達到 O(1) 提示足跡與 O(T) 累積 token 複雜度。實驗涵蓋自建 SkillExecBench(倉儲管理、軟體儲存庫)與公開基準 InterCode CTF、Sierra τ-Bench,使用 Gemini-3-Flash、Gemma-4-31B-it 與 Qwen-3-8B-it:SKILL.state 在各時程維持或超越基準準確率,提示固定在約 1,700–1,900 token,T=100 時相較 Stateful 基線減少 16.2 倍 token 消耗;CTF pass@1 達 54.2%(較最強基準高 7.8 點);高雜訊下仍維持 0.97 以上準確率;外部狀態遭改動時零步即可恢復,歷史式基線則需 5–8 步。預算對齊實驗中,滑動視窗與 LLMLingua 壓縮皆大幅失效,證明增益來自結構化狀態而非提示變短。限制在於假設執行狀態可成為充分統計量、綱要需預先定義,且目前僅支援單一代理;小型模型的失敗多為結構化輸出錯誤(如誤刪狀態鍵)。此抽象與模型無關,為可規模化的長時程代理執行提供了有效基礎。
radar.title: SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills
radar.title_zh: SKILL.state:可規模化的長時程代理人技能

links.title: From Memorization to Absorption: Mixed-Policy RL for Continual Knowledge Injection

evidence: Section 6.2, Table 2: GRIN achieves 35.11% avg on Blank and 43.65% avg on Counter (fail@k 24.05%) vs. strongest SFT baseline Self-Tuning at 24.30%/24.59% (fail@k 38.14%); GRIN slightly trails Self-Tuning on Blank single-fact recall (52.49% vs 54.54%).

Section 6.2 ablation rows of Table 2: Grin w/ GRPO collapses to 1.83% avg on Blank, Grin w/ LUFFY reaches 20.38%, and Grin w/ SFT reaches 14.11%, supporting that both the data and the Golden-GRPO objective are necessary.
Section 6.2 'Compute-matched training' and Figure 2: baselines trained to 50 total epochs plateau beyond 15 epochs well below GRIN's 43.65% Counter average, addressing the compute confound.
Section 6.1: 'Accuracy is judged by an LLM (gemini-3.5-flash)' with no human validation of judge agreement, no variance over seeds, or significance tests reported anywhere in the paper.

Section 4.2: 'All questions are LLM-generated unless otherwise noted' but the generating model for evaluation questions is not specified, while Stage 2 (Section 5.2) samples training questions from the base model, leaving a possible train/eval question-style overlap unexamined.

Section 6.2 Table 3: cross-model replication on Counter with Llama3.2-3B shows GRIN leading three of four accuracy metrics (30.45% avg vs Self-Tuning 27.23%) but essentially tied on fail@k (27.72% vs 27.38%); Blank was not replicated on the second model.
Appendix F Reproducibility Statement: 'Code and benchmark data will be made publicly available; a code and data archive accompanies this submission' - release is promised, not verifiably available.

Limitations section: authors acknowledge single-round injection only, wiki-style entity-grounded domains, and a reward function (ROUGE-L/Exact Match) 'tailored to factual recall' that may not transfer to other knowledge formats.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on continual knowledge injection via mixed-policy RL (Golden-GRPO), squarely matching LLM/training/RL/knowledge preferences; not an out-of-scope domain application. The algorithmic contribution is a sensible but incremental modification of LUFFY-style mixed-policy RL (replacing the importance-weighted off-policy branch with an advantage-scaled supervised gradient, plus Dr. GRPO-style advantages), motivated by a credible gradient-vanishing analysis (Appendix E). Experiments are reasonably strong: training-free and training-based baselines, ablations isolating method vs. data (Grin w/ SFT, w/ GRPO, w/ LUFFY), compute-matched 50-epoch training, and a cross-model check on Llama3.2-3B. However, all accuracy is LLM-judged (gemini-3.5-flash) without human validation of the judge, no seed variance or significance testing is reported, and the model that generated evaluation questions is unspecified despite Stage 2 training questions being sampled from the base model itself, creating a possible style-match bias favoring GRIN. Generalizability is limited to 3-4B models and wiki-style factual text with a recall-oriented reward, as the authors concede; single-round injection only. Code/data promised but not verified released. A solid, moderately novel contribution with supportive but not airtight evidence.

primary_link.title: From Memorization to Absorption: Mixed-Policy RL for Continual Knowledge Injection

radar.summary: Continual knowledge injection is essential for keeping large language models up-to-date in a fast-evolving world. Existing methods rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which memorizes injected facts in their training format but fails to generalize across paraphrasing, document combinations, and reasoning. To address this, we propose Golden-GRPO Injection (GRIN), a three-stage self-learning framework for continual knowledge injection. Golden-GRPO is a mixed-policy reinforcement learning algorith
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型需要持續注入新知識以跟上現實變化,但現有方法多依賴監督式 fine-tuning(SFT),只把事實背誦在訓練格式中,面對改寫、多文件組合與推理便失效,也無法處理模型既有的錯誤先驗。本文提出 GRIN,一個三階段的持續知識注入框架:第一階段由模型自行從文件抽取原子問答對做 SFT;第二階段以語料為條件取樣多樣的(問題、標準答案)池;第三階段以 Golden-GRPO 訓練——一種專為知識注入設計的混合策略強化學習,當 on-policy 生成全數失敗時,把黃金答案當作 off-policy 軌跡注入,並以 off-policy 優勢縮放的直接監督梯度取代會消失的重要性加權梯度,確保每步都有學習訊號,隨模型學會後自然轉向 on-policy 探索。作者另建立 Blank(新知識習得)與 Counter(反事實覆寫)兩個文件級基準,各含單一事實回想、多源檢索與推論三層評估。以 Qwen3-4B 實驗,GRIN 在 Blank 平均達 35.11%(最強 SFT 基線 Self-Tuning 為 24.30%),推論題 31.69% 對 7.10%;Counter 平均 43.65%,fail@k 最低(24.05%);單純 GRPO 崩潰至 1.83%,LUFFY 亦不及;Llama3.2-3B 上結果一致;計算量對齊下基線在 50 個 epoch 仍遠低於 GRIN。限制包括僅驗證單輪注入、語料限於維基式事實文本、獎勵函數偏向事實回想,以及前沿規模下 rollout 成本可觀。此工作顯示混合策略 RL 能讓知識真正被吸收而非背誦,對終身學習具重要意義。
radar.title: From Memorization to Absorption: Mixed-Policy RL for Continual Knowledge Injection
radar.title_zh: 從記憶到吸收:以混合策略強化學習進行持續知識注入

links.title: HRGuard: Gating Relationship Manipulation in Multi-Turn Agentic AI Conversations

evidence: Abstract: 'Across eight generation models, HRGuard reduces harmful compliance while preserving victim-side protective guidance. It also outperforms a generic safety prompt and three general-purpose guard models.'

Table 1 (Results under the GPT-4o-mini judge): macro average Raw 41.44/44.70/31.94 vs Pregate+Postgate 2.21/93.04/80.31 with AtkH/VicP 0.00/86.10; Pregate fails on Llama-3.1-8B (72.6 AtkH) and Postgate fails on Qwen2.5-14B (79.6 AtkH).

Human Validation of the GPT-4o-mini Judge: 'Inter-annotator agreement is strong for appropriate refusal (98.8%, kappa=0.97) and moderate for protective intervention (83.1%, kappa=0.45) and harmful assistance (88.8%, kappa=0.52)'; GPT-human agreement for harmful assistance relies mostly on negative cases.

Cross-judge sensitivity: Llama-3.2-3B judge 'assigns higher harmful-compliance rates to several gated conditions than to Raw or GS' (Appendix D Table 9: Raw 50.24% vs Postgate 70.39%), which authors treat as evaluator-calibration sensitivity.
Oracle-role and role-agnostic gating: role-agnostic gating raises victim-side false-block rates 'from 0% to 7.6% and 5.2%', so oracle-role results are an upper bound.

Appendix G: 'Attacker turn-scores under the default weights are typically far above this band (median ~13-15), so the soft gate is saturated', showing soft cumulative machinery is largely redundant with hard triggers in the evaluated band.

Introduction: 'Prior work (Tan et al. 2026) introduced the concept of agentic relationship harm, a 110-prompt primarily single-turn benchmark, and a lightweight post-generation gate', indicating this paper is a scaled extension (1,000 five-turn dialogs, two-gate framework) of the authors' own prior benchmark and method.

Ethics Statement / Reproducibility: 'the complete dataset will use controlled access'; supplementary provides 'model and serving configurations, decoding settings, prompts, judge schemas, gate parameters'; code link https://github.com/noobasuna/hrguard.git.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent safety work squarely matching high-weight preferences (agentic AI conversations, multi-turn safety, guard models, safety benchmarks). Methodologically solid: 8 generators x 6 conditions x 1,000 dialogs, three industry guard baselines (Table 2), four-judge cross-evaluation, N=160 human validation, component/threshold ablations, and honest reporting of failures (Llama-3.1-8B Pregate leak, Qwen2.5-14B Postgate failure, Llama judge divergence). Main limitations: heavy build on authors' own prior work (codebook, concept, and initial gate from Tan et al. 2026), the gate itself is an LLM-judge-plus-rule layer whose soft thresholds are shown saturated (Appendix G: median turn-scores ~13-15 vs tau=5/6, so hard triggers do most work), primary-metric human agreement only moderate for harmful assistance (kappa=0.52, alpha~0.51), gate judge and outcome judge share GPT-4o-mini (partially mitigated by Qwen re-scoring), oracle-role setting is an upper bound with 5.2-7.6% victim false-blocks when role-agnostic, and the synthetic benchmark limits real-world claims, which the Limitations section concedes. Code link provided with documented gate parameters, prompts, and schemas, but dataset is controlled-access.

primary_link.title: HRGuard: Gating Relationship Manipulation in Multi-Turn Agentic AI Conversations

radar.summary: Agentic AI assistants are increasingly used in everyday life. However, they may also be misused to support harmful manipulation in interpersonal relationships. This problem is role-sensitive. Requests from users who seek to manipulate others should be blocked. Users who seek protection from manipulation should instead receive supportive guidance. We study agentic relationship harm, which describes harm to human-human relationships that is mediated or assisted by AI agents. In multi-turn settings
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討 agentic AI 助手可能被濫用於協助人際關係操縱的安全問題。此問題具角色敏感性：企圖操縱他人的攻擊方請求應被阻擋，而尋求自保指引的受害者則應獲得支持性協助。在多輪對話中，個別看似合理的動作可能逐步累積成有害的工作流程。作者建構包含 1,000 篇五輪對話的角色敏感基準，涵蓋攻擊方與受害者情境，並含直接與對抗性改寫兩種版本。提出的 HRGuard 設有兩道閘門：生成前的 Pregate 評估累積的使用者請求軌跡，觸發時不呼叫模型即發出固定拒絕；生成後的 Postgate 評估助理回應，維護帶衰減的累積風險狀態，一旦觸發即中止後續輪次。在八個生成模型上，HRGuard 將攻擊方有害配合率自原始的 35.9–53.9% 壓至接近零，同時保留對受害者的保護性指引，成效優於通用安全提示與 LlamaGuard、ShieldGemma、Qwen3Guard 等通用護欄。限制包括基準為合成情境、主要依賴 LLM 評審，且主實驗假設已知使用者角色；角色不可知的閘門會造成約 5–8% 的受害者誤擋率。此研究凸顯關係型危害是漸進浮現的順序性工作流程問題，需要逐輪且角色敏感的評估與治理。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A privacy-preserving dense-retrieval system for RAG: learned LoRA hash filter + directional metric-DP (pure-vMF) release + packed BFV exact scoring + active-secure k-out-of-K OT. It matches RAG & Knowledge (dense retrieval, semantic search, embedding) and AI Safety (embedding-inversion/property-inference attacks and defenses) preferences well, though the LLM is only a downstream consumer (Qwen3-32B, 128-token generation) rather than the methodology focus, and there is no Japanese-NLP component. Novelty is moderate-to-good: learned hashing as a DP-protected shortlist and exact pure-vMF calibration (Theorem 1, §6.2) are a sensible, differentiated combination versus Tiptoe/PANTHER/Pisces, but each ingredient (LoRA hashing, vMF metric DP, BFV, OOS OT) is established. Rigor is strong: formal theorems with proofs (§6.2-6.4), explicit assumptions and out-of-scope leakage (§3.2: scores, timing, Sybil, no query-code consistency check), broad baselines (Table 4), and matched comparisons whose favorable choices toward baselines are documented (§7.3, App. D.4). Evidence is extensive and specific: 98.84-100.21% NDCG@10 retention at K=500 over five BEIR corpora (Table 3), pure-vMF 99.4% retention at (ε=64,K=2000) with +0.73s RAG overhead (Table 5), EM/F1 within 0.2/0.20 of float (Table 6), 5-20x speedups and PANTHER OOM (Fig. 5), and attack suppression from 0.920 to 0.325 search success (Table 8). primary_link.title: Pointing the Way, Hiding the Destination: Practical Private Dense Retrieval at Scale

radar.summary: Hosted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search allow users to query valuable provider-held corpora, raising two competing demands: to hide each query and chosen result, yet reveal only the documents that the user is authorized to receive. Existing cryptographic approaches either make this costly by processing the entire corpus for every query, or sacrifice quality for efficiency by scanning a few clusters. We repurpose learned deep hashing as a private filter: a randomized binar
radar.summary_zh: 託管式 RAG 與語意搜尋讓使用者查詢服務商持有的珍貴語料，產生兩項衝突需求：既要隱藏查詢與所選結果，又只能揭露使用者有權取得的文件。既有密碼學方法若掃描整個語料庫成本高昂，若僅掃描少數叢集則犧牲品質。本文將學習式深度雜湊重新定位為私有過濾器：使用者以滿足方向性度量差分隱私的純 vMF 機制隨機化之二進位碼，引導服務商產生簡短候選清單；再以 int8 量化嵌入上的打包 BFV 同態加密評分保護乾淨查詢，並以主動安全的 k-out-of-K 不經意傳輸保護最終選擇。於 K=500 時，五個零樣本 BEIR 語料庫保留 98.84–100% 的全庫 NDCG@10；在 2.68M 段落的 NQ 語料上，整體僅為 128-token 的 Qwen3-32B RAG 流程增加 0.73 秒（約 10%）延遲。此機制也大幅降低嵌入反演與屬性推論攻擊的洩漏，線上延遲明顯快於 PANTHER、P2RAG 與 RemoteRAG。限制包括訊息長度與時間、明確分數向量仍屬洩漏面，且安全保證假設使用者遵循協定。此工作證明精心學習的短清單能讓私有稠密檢索兼顧準確與實用。

Section 4.3, Table 3: reasoning Average 45.66-46.82 for Our-Data CPT vs 46.32 direct OpenThoughts SFT and 44.30 FineWeb-Edu CPT, supporting the no-reasoning-regression claim.

Section 5 Limitations: experiments cover one base model and one mixture; writing metrics rely on an LLM judge; comprehension/long-context suites are small; trajectories are post-hoc reconstructions not the authors' actual deliberation.

Appendix B.2: decontamination removes benchmark source papers and applies n-gram overlap checks; Appendix F/Table 6 document CPT hyperparameters (64K context, 2e-5 peak LR, cosine decay, seed 42); Appendix E gives prompt contracts and pseudocode, but no explicit code or data release is stated.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology paper: a pipeline that reconstructs writing-process deliberations around verbatim paper text into multi-turn trajectories for continued pre-training, plus derived SFT data and the PAW-Bench benchmark. Strong topical fit to LLMs, reasoning/CoT data, training optimization, synthetic data curation, and LLM-based evaluation. The controlled plain-paper baseline (same papers as plaintext, same budget and hyperparameters) is the paper's best design feature, cleanly isolating the construction effect. Gains are consistent but moderate (Table 2: 54.34 vs 51.90 average over DeepWritingSFT; PAW-Bench +3.5 to +4.0) and reasoning is preserved (Table 3: 45.66-46.82 vs 46.32 direct SFT). Novelty is incremental: it lifts an existing reconstruct-the-thinking paradigm (cited prior web-text work) to document level with rhetorical structure, and the smaller-generator-better finding echoes prior results. Weaknesses: single base model (Qwen2.5-7B), single mixture ratio, one seed, all writing scores from a single LLM judge (GPT-5.5) without large-scale human validation, small comprehension/long-context suites, and no explicit code/data release despite a detailed appendix. Limitations are honestly stated in Section 5.

primary_link.title: Unfolding Scientific Papers into Multi-Turn Generation Trajectories for Continued Pre-Training

radar.summary: A recent line of synthetic-data work reconstructs the thinking behind existing text rather than rewriting the text itself, but it operates on short web passages, recovers only local thoughts, and leaves the structure of whole documents untouched. Scientific papers are written to a clear and largely uniform structure and make a natural substrate for lifting this paradigm to the document level. We present a pipeline that unfolds each paper into a multi-turn generation trajectory in which a teacher
radar.summary_zh: 近期的合成資料研究嘗試重建既有文字背後的思考過程，但多奠基於一兩千 token 的短網頁，僅能還原局部思緒，也未觸及整份文件的結構。本文提出管線，將每篇論文展開為多輪生成軌跡：由教師模型重建整篇論文的寫作過程，包括寫作請求、全局規劃、各節動筆前的思辨與摘要前的回顧；各節本文與摘要則逐字保留。套用於 1.8M 篇品質篩選後的 arXiv 論文，以 Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B 三種生成器將 30B token 的論文文本轉為約 57–60B token 的軌跡，中位數訓練文件長度自 11K 提升至約 28–29K。同一反向建構亦產出 20 萬筆 SFT 資料，以及以保留論文為錨、附評分準則與檢核清單的 PAW-Bench（Paper-Anchored Writing Benchmark，2,940 個任務）。在 Qwen2.5-7B 上的受控實驗顯示，以軌跡進行 CPT 再監督式微調，可全面提升寫作基準（含 WritingBench 與 PAW-Bench），同時維持一般推理能力並改善論文理解與長文本表現；即使所有模型再以專門寫作 SFT 資料微調，此增益依然存在。限制包括僅測試單一基礎模型與混合比例、寫作評分依賴 LLM 評審，且軌跡屬事後重建，未必對應作者真實思路。研究也顯示 4B 小型生成器即足夠，關鍵在建構方式而非生成器規模。
radar.title: Unfolding Scientific Papers into Multi-Turn Generation Trajectories for Continued Pre-Training

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper (Graph RAG with writable, verified experience reuse for online multi-hop QA), squarely matching RAG/knowledge-grounding and reasoning preferences; not a domain application. Novelty is moderate: memory-augmented RAG and agent memory exist (MemoRAG, REMem, Reflexion), but the combination of sparse activation-map fusion into graph retrieval, NLI-grounded novelty/grounding write-back gates, and template scaffolds is a distinct, useful contribution. Rigor is solid: motivating reuse-signal analysis (Table 1), five QA streams, five RAG baselines (Table 2), component ablations (Table 5), gate dynamics (Appendix D), runtime breakdown (Appendix G), and query-order robustness (Appendix K.2). Generalizability is tempered by the authors' own limitations: no fact-expiration handling, benchmarks are proxies for natural streams, and transfer to a second retriever is only a preliminary retrieval-level test (Appendix K.3). Reproducibility is middling: models, NLI checkpoint, prompts, and two thresholds are given, but key hyperparameters (alpha, beta, epsilon, K, lambda, tau_s) lack values and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: LivingRAG: Augmenting Graph RAG with Experience

radar.summary: Graph-based RAG improves multi-hop question answering by organizing evidence as a knowledge graph. However, most existing RAG systems process each query in isolation and discard useful reasoning from the LLM's response after inference. As a result, later related queries need to retrieve evidence and reason from scratch. We propose LivingRAG, a Graph RAG framework with writable and reusable reasoning experience. LivingRAG adds a writable experience store to a graph-based retrieval backbone, enabl
radar.summary_zh: 圖形化 RAG 藉知識圖譜組織證據以改善多跳問答，但多數系統逐筆孤立處理查詢，推論後即丟棄有用的推理訊號，使後續相關問題必須從零重新檢索與推理。本文提出 LivingRAG，在以 LinearRAG 為骨幹的圖形檢索上加入可寫入、可重複使用的推理經驗庫。每筆通過驗證的經驗保存來源查詢、查詢嵌入、稀疏實體激活圖、精簡推理摘要與驗證中繼資料；推論時以兩種方式重複使用：激活圖融合進初始圖激活以引導檢索，推理摘要則作為生成時的推理鷹架。寫回前須通過新穎性（NS）與以 NLI 模型驗證證據支持的品質閘門（GS），五個資料流中僅 27.4% 的候選被存入。在 2Wiki、HotpotQA、MuSiQue、MuSiQue-full 與 WixQA 上，LivingRAG 優於 Vanilla RAG、LightRAG、GFM-RAG、HippoRAG2 與 LinearRAG，例如 2Wiki 的 LLM 準確率達 87.0%、WixQA 達 70.25%；prompt token 約增加 3.5%，completion token 卻減少 22.7%，整體推估成本下降 12.1%。消融實驗證實激活融合、鷹架與品質閘門各有貢獻，且對查詢順序具穩健性。限制包括經驗庫隨時間線性成長、尚無時間感知的更新與剪枝，並以受控基準代理真實線上查詢流。

links.title: Beam Search, Self-Consistency, and the Limits of Inference-Time Scaling for Grammar-Constrained Text-to-SQL in Small Language Models

evidence: Abstract: reports both beam search and sample+vote improve accuracy (especially smaller models), inference compute does not substitute for parameters, and beam search outperforms sample+vote at matched budget, contrasting with unconstrained findings

Section 4: all configurations evaluated on full Spider dev set n=1034; paired comparisons via McNemar's exact test; 95% Wilson score intervals; sample+vote uses tau=0.7, top-p=0.9, beam length penalty -2.0, 160-token cap, 4-bit NF4 quantization

Section 5, Table 1: Qwen2.5-1.5B beam accuracy rises 0.351->0.505 from B=1 to B=8 vs sample+vote 0.299->0.450; no-grammar greedy baselines beat constrained greedy at 3B (0.477 vs 0.445) and 7B (0.643 vs 0.600)
Section 5, Table 2: beam significantly ahead in 11 of 16 McNemar comparisons, significantly behind in none; largest advantage at 1.5B (e.g., p=1.4e-17 at B=2)

Section 5: grammar-incompleteness mechanism — at 3B all 400 testable differing predictions rejected by the grammar and correct-but-rejected ones parse as valid SQLite; recalcitrant constructs include IN value lists, IS NOT NULL, outer joins, free-form aliases
Section 5: truncation-rate analysis (falls monotonically with beam width, 0.0-2.7% across sizes) used to reject the over-generation hypothesis for beam's advantage

Section 6: proposed mechanisms for beam advantage (grammar removes surface diversity; weak models concentrate on confident wrong consensus) are explicitly unverified and left to future work; small-subset evaluations reportedly favored sample+vote, flagging dataset-size sensitivity

Section 7 Limitations: scope limited to one model family (Qwen2.5-Instruct), one benchmark (Spider), and a single decoding run per configuration; Section 4 admits a single seed for sample+vote with seed-variance analysis left to future work
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology study that squarely matches multiple high-weight preferences: LLMs, self-consistency/reasoning, text-to-SQL code generation, and inference-time scaling. The empirical design is careful for its scale: full Spider dev set (n=1034), matched budgets {1,2,4,8}, paired McNemar exact tests instead of naive interval overlap, Wilson intervals, and a concrete mechanism analysis of grammar incompleteness (correct-but-rejected predictions re-parsed). The headline counter-result (beam search beats sample+vote under grammar constraints, inverting Wang et al. 2023) is a genuinely interesting empirical contribution but no new method is proposed, so novelty is moderate. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., gap-closure percentages of 50-76% match Table 1) and claims are appropriately hedged to the studied setting. Generalizability is explicitly limited: one model family, one benchmark, one grammar engine, single decoding run and single undisclosed seed for sampling. Reproducibility is hampered by no code/artifact release, an unnamed grammar/decoding library, and no prompt details.

primary_link.title: Beam Search, Self-Consistency, and the Limits of Inference-Time Scaling for Grammar-Constrained Text-to-SQL in Small Language Models

radar.summary: One common trade-off in the use of large language models involves reducing the size of the model while increasing the amount of computation at inference time, for example by using a wider beam search. In this paper, we examine the constrained case of this "model size vs. inference compute" trade-off, in which the model outputs are constrained by a strict grammar at inference time. Our results demonstrate that the constrained trade-off behaves differently from the unconstrained trade-off. We inve
radar.summary_zh: 本文研究文法約束解碼情境下的「模型大小 vs. 推論時間運算」權衡,以文字轉SQL為測試任務。作者使用Qwen2.5-Instruct系列(0.5B至7B參數、4-bit量化),在Spider開發集1,034題上比較束搜尋與sample+vote(取樣後依執行結果投票)兩種增加推論運算的方式。結果顯示:(1)兩種方法都能提升執行準確率,小模型受益最大;(2)推論運算無法替代參數規模:8束的束搜尋僅能縮小與下一級模型50%至76%的差距,三組階梯中只有1.5B到3B一組能完全追平;(3)在相同預算下束搜尋穩定優於sample+vote,16組配對比較中11組顯著勝出,與無約束情境下自我一致性較優的文獻結論相反。論文也發現文法約束本身會損害大模型準確率,原因在於文法覆蓋不完整(無法表達IN值列、IS NOT NULL、外部連接等)。限制為僅測試單一模型家族、單一基準與單次解碼執行。此研究提醒開發者:在結構化輸出場景中,以更寬的束搜尋彌補小模型的策略有其極限。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A retrieval-augmented generation method for long narrative reasoning, squarely in-scope for RAG/long-context/LLM-reasoning preferences. The triple-layer index with a bipartite 'Pons' bridge layer, Co-HITS cross-layer propagation, and Hungarian max-weight matching is a reasonable but incremental recombination of established techniques (PPR from HippoRAGv2, Co-HITS, Hungarian algorithm), closely parallel to ComoRAG's cognitive multi-layer RAG; the biological framing is decorative. Rigor is solid: four benchmarks (NarrativeQA, EN.QA, EN.MC, NoCha), three baseline families, single- and multi-step settings, component-wise ablations (Table 3), matching-constraint ablation (Table 5), sparsity-controller sweep (Table 4), cost analysis (Table 12), and human-validated query-type labels (κ=0.81, Table 11). Evidence is quantitatively consistent (e.g., 77.73 vs 70.31 ACC on EN.MC = 10.55% relative, 74.98 vs 67.21 MC avg = 11.56%). Caveats: single LLM backbone (GPT-4o-mini) at 6k context cap, small NoCha set (4 novels/126 questions), post-hoc task-specific τ selection despite a claimed validation-set protocol, and correlational (not causal) support for the cognitive-island analysis (Section 5.4). Generalizability is explicitly narrow per the Limitations section; no code release is mentioned, and LLM extraction steps at temperature 0.8 plus API dependence hamper exact reproduction, though hyperparameters and prompts are fully disclosed.

primary_link.title: PonsRAG: A Pons-Inspired RAG Bridging Cognitive Islands for Coordinated Long Narrative Reasoning

radar.summary: Long Narrative Reasoning is an essential capability for processing and reasoning over complex narratives. While retrieval-augmented generation provides a promising framework, existing methods still face two critical challenges: cognitive islanding and cross-layer evidence disconnection. To address these issues, we propose PonsRAG, a coordinated RAG framework inspired by the biological pons. PonsRAG consists of two key components: Triple-Layer Indexing, which organizes documents into a connected
radar.summary_zh: 處理超長敘事文本時,檢索增強生成(RAG)常面臨「認知孤島」問題:人物層與情節層的證據分屬不同索引層,彼此孤立且檢索時缺乏協調。本文提出受生物腦橋啟發的PonsRAG,包含兩大元件:三層索引(Char層捕捉人物特質、Plot層記錄事件進展、Pons層以二部圖連結前兩層)與協調推理流程(Query Anchor初步定位、Pons Awaken透過Co-HITS跨層傳播激活、Pons Match以匈牙利演算法做一對一配對、Flow Filter重建時間序列並過濾雜訊)。在NarrativeQA、∞BENCH(EN.QA、EN.MC)與NoCha四個長敘事基準上,PonsRAG全面超越最強基準ComoRAG,多選題平均準確率相對提升11.56%,且文件越長、跨層語義分離越大時優勢越明顯。消融實驗證實移除Pons層會使EN.MC準確率下滑約20%,一對一配對亦優於寬鬆的1對N策略。限制是目前僅評估長敘事任務,尚未驗證於多跳問答等更廣泛場景。此框架展示了顯式跨層橋接對整合碎片化證據的價值。
radar.title: PonsRAG: A Pons-Inspired RAG Bridging Cognitive Islands for Coordinated Long Narrative Reasoning
radar.title_zh: PonsRAG:受腦橋啟發、銜接認知孤島以協同長敘事推理的RAG框架

links.title: Unveiling Spectral Mechanisms in Training-Free LLM Text Detection

evidence: Section 3.3 Theorem 1 and Appendix B.1: fluctuation divergence derived via law of total variance, decomposing human-AI variance gap into tail-rate and mean-separation terms
Section 3.4 Corollary 2 and Appendix B.2: Parseval's identity maps the variance gap to average spectral energy (Eq. 17)
Section 4.1: three English datasets (XSum, WritingPrompts, Reddit ELI5) with 150 human examples each, 150/150 balanced sets, Llama2-13B source and GPT-J-6B proxy, AUC metric
Section 4.3 RQ2: length truncation L in {30,60,90,120,150} shows fluctuation-based metrics gain more with longer context; SpecDetect weak at L=30
Section 4.4 RQ3: Top-k/Top-p/Temperature sweeps show all metrics degrade with broader sampling, with performance inversion at T>1.2
Section 5.2 Table 2: sentence-level within-document AUC, LogLikelihood 0.9085 vs SpecDetect 0.8411 on SemEval; SpecDetect best at 0.7017 on CoAuthor H-vs-C
Section 5.3 Table 3: MixText pairwise accuracy; SpecDetect 81.00% on GPT-4 Complete but near chance 52.67% on GPT-4 token Polish
Appendix D.2: input-signal ablation showing fluctuation metrics collapse with LogRank input, requiring continuous LogLikelihood
Appendix D.7: WMT16 German cross-language length and decoding-scope checks
Appendix C.3: code available at github.com/luohaitong/SpecDetect and TrustMedia-zju/Lastde_Detector; single 80GB H800 GPU; Lastde hyperparameters specified
Limitations section: acknowledges dependence on proxy model choice, decoding strategy, text granularity, and untested languages/domains/generators
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solidly in-scope LLM/NLP work: training-free detection of LLM-generated text via proxy-LLM probability signals, touching LLM methodology (0.8 relevance), NLP, and detection/safety evaluation. Novelty is moderate: the paper is primarily a mechanism analysis and boundary-mapping of the authors' own prior method SpecDetect; the theory (law-of-total-variance decomposition plus Parseval's identity linking variance to spectral energy) is simple but correct and clearly derived (Appendix B.1-B.2). Rigor is good: formal theorem, systematic RQs, ablations (input-signal granularity, edit-density diagnostics), multiple proxies (GPT-J-6B, Llama3-8B), sources (Llama2-13B, GPT-4-Turbo, Qwen-3-8B), and a German cross-language check. Evidence is credible but built on small evaluation sets (150/150 per dataset, Section 4.1) and a simplifying shared-conditional-statistics assumption; quantitative claims are trend-level rather than SOTA claims. Generalizability is explicitly bounded (length, sampling scope, editing type), which the paper treats honestly in its Limitations. Reproducibility is aided by public code repositories and detailed hyperparameters (Appendix C.3). Overall a useful, well-executed analysis paper with limited conceptual novelty.

primary_link.title: Unveiling Spectral Mechanisms in Training-Free LLM Text Detection

radar.summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish human writing from machine-generated text. Training-free detection offers a scalable solution, yet common confidence-based metrics mainly measure average token probabilities and often miss the signal fluctuations that characterize human writing, which we call "generative vitality". Spectral analysis offers a way to capture this vitality, but its mechanism and practical boundaries remain underexpl
radar.summary_zh: LLM生成文字的偵測中,免訓練方法多依賴平均token機率等信心指標,忽略了人類寫作的「生成活力」——不可預測低機率詞造成的訊號波動。本文從理論與實證兩端解析頻譜偵測的運作機制:作者以代理LLM(如GPT-J-6B)計算token對數機率序列,證明人類文字因更常進入低機率尾部區域而變異數較高,經Parseval恆等式轉換為更高的頻譜能量,此即SpecDetect等方法可偵測的頻譜差距。實驗涵蓋XSum、WritingPrompts與Reddit三個資料集,並檢視混來源(SemEval、CoAuthor)與協作編輯(MixText)情境。核心發現:頻譜證據在長篇、連續且取樣範圍受限時最明確;短句與點狀潤飾下信心指標較佳,而AI連續補寫(Complete)時頻譜指標回升;高溫度取樣會讓所有方法效能下降,但頻譜指標衰減較慢;「破壞性人性化」(注入錯字)則暴露偵測器的脆弱性。本研究為未來多維度偵測器設計劃出了頻域方法的適用邊界。
radar.title: Unveiling Spectral Mechanisms in Training-Free LLM Text Detection
radar.title_zh: 揭露免訓練LLM文字偵測的頻譜機制

links.title: When RAG Fails to Equalize: Geo-bias in Factual Question Answering over Public Companies

evidence: Abstract: evaluates six LLMs on four atomic company attributes under four conditions (no-context, perfect, misleading, distraction) over ~2,000 firms from global equity indices
Section 4.1: benchmark of 2,135 unique companies mapped to 15 indices from Wikipedia; paired inductive/deductive MCQ construction with bge-large-en-v1.5 distractors
Section 5, Table 2: inductive accuracy exceeds deductive for most models (e.g., LLaMA-8B 0.67 vs 0.57, OR 0.66 [0.62,0.70], p=0.00), with unexplained GPT-5 exception reported as observed
Appendix B.3, Table 6: revenue-quintile regression with index fixed effects; quintile coefficient p<0.01 and index FE p<0.001 across all four conditions, supporting geo-disparity beyond company size
Appendix B.2.1, Table 5: perfect-context exclusion rates of 61.0% (Founding Year), 29.6% (Headquarters), 86.0% (Key People) due to facts absent from lead paragraphs
Appendix B.4, Table 7: model versions and decoding settings; LLaMA 3.1 and Claude Sonnet at temperature 1.0; OpenAI temperature not user-settable; queries via internal Bloomberg endpoints

Limitations: Wikipedia-derived synthetic misleading context, English-centric benchmark, US/European models, atomic facts only; dataset released at https://zenodo.org/records/19359640 (Section 1 and Conclusion)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/RAG evaluation study: it empirically tests whether retrieval equalizes uneven parametric knowledge across six LLMs (GPT-5 family, Claude Sonnet 4, LLaMA-8B/70B) using controlled context regimes (no/perfect/misleading/distraction), directly matching the RAG & Knowledge, LLM, and Evaluation preferences; finance entities are a testbed, not a capped pure-domain application. Novelty is moderate: the differential-gain question builds closely on ClashEval, Mallen et al., and WorldBench, with the geo-stratified entity-level framing as the main increment. Rigor is solid (pre-registered hypotheses, CIs, stratified bins, confound diagnostics including a revenue-quintile regression with index fixed effects in Appendix B.3), but weakened by a multiple-choice format, an unexplained GPT-5 deductive anomaly (Table 2), and heavy perfect-context exclusions (61% Founding Year, 86% Key People, Table 5) that complicate comparisons. Evidence is mostly consistent with claims, though the central 'gains correlated with baseline' coupling is shown via stratified accuracy tables rather than a formal gain-delta statistic. Generalizability is limited by English-centric Wikipedia data, MCQ atomic facts, and Western models, as the authors acknowledge in Limitations. Reproducibility is decent: Zenodo dataset URL, full prompt templates, model/version/temperature metadata (Table 7), though some models ran at temperature 1.0 and via internal endpoints.

primary_link.title: When RAG Fails to Equalize: Geo-bias in Factual Question Answering over Public Companies

radar.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely assumed to mitigate factual errors in large language models (LLMs), but it remains unclear whether retrieval uniformly compensates for missing knowledge. We study this question in a controlled factual QA setting over public companies, constructing a benchmark of approximately 2,000 firms across global equity indices. We evaluate six LLMs on four atomic attributes under four conditions: no-context, perfect context, misleading context, and distraction
radar.summary_zh: RAG常被視為補救LLM事實錯誤的通用解方,但檢索是否一致地補償知識缺口?本文建構涵蓋15個全球股票指數、約2,000家上市公司的基準,針對產業、創立年份、總部與關鍵人物四種屬性,以六個模型(含GPT-5系列、Claude Sonnet 4、LLaMA-8B/70B)在四種情境下測試:無上下文、完美上下文、誤導上下文與干擾上下文。發現:(1)無上下文準確率在市場間差異懸殊,反映參數知識分布不均;(2)歸納式問題(實體→屬性)一致地比演繹式容易;(3)完美上下文雖提升效能,但增益與基線準確率相關,跨市場差距未被消除,顯示檢索效果與既有表徵耦合;(4)誤導上下文誘發系統性的抄錄錯誤,模型可能比僅靠參數記憶更差;(5)模型規模提升整體表現與穩健度,卻不改變結構性不均。作者主張檢索是「條件式放大器」而非通用矯正器,高風險領域應進行分層評估並加入對誤導證據的驗證層。
radar.title: When RAG Fails to Equalize: Geo-bias in Factual Question Answering over Public Companies
radar.title_zh: 當RAG無法拉平差距:上市公司事實問答中的地理偏誤

links.title: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'experience-guided multi-agent framework that learns reusable scientific skills for automated hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing' without fine-tuning foundation models.

Experiments > Implementation Details: 'All agents are instantiated with DeepSeek-V4-Flash'; 1:1 train/test task split; training terminates after k=3 non-improving attempts; 'All reported results are averaged over three independent runs.'

Method > Multi-Dimensional Hypothesis Discriminator (Eq. 4-6): seven LLM-implemented dimensions combine hard constraints (falsifiability, theoretical consistency, verifiability) with four [0,1] scores into s_i; details deferred to 'supplement materials'.

Experiments > Metrics and Eq. 8: Q(H^t) is both the generator's training objective and the reported hypothesis-generation evaluation metric, creating train-test metric circularity; Hit@K against reference hypotheses is the more objective metric.
Experiments > Hypothesis Generation Evaluation, Table 2: HypoForge Q=0.785±0.030, Hit@K=0.648±0.142 vs AI-Generated-Skill 0.738±0.050 / 0.579±0.022 and No-Skill 0.724±0.040 / 0.409±0.079.
Experiments > Hypothesis Testing Evaluation, Table 3: HypoForge T_h=0.659±0.064, E_h=0.966±0.016 vs Human-Designed-Skill 0.612±0.096 and POPPER T_h=0.417±0.141 with E_h=0.984±0.000.
Ablation Study, Table 4: removing discriminator feedback drops Hit@K 0.648→0.491; removing execution outcomes drops T_h 0.659→0.565.

Discussion: limitations include reliance on feedback reliability, restriction to 'data-driven scientific discovery with executable computational experiments', and open questions on skill granularity/organization; no code or artifact availability is stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: a multi-agent skill-learning framework (HypoForge) for hypothesis generation and testing, strongly matching LLM, Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, and Code preferences; it is a general framework evaluated on a public benchmark, not a pure domain application, so it stays in scope. Novelty is moderate: agent skill libraries and self-evolving skills exist (Voyager, SkillRevise, CoEvoSkills cited in Related Work), and the contribution is the stage-specific split (adversarial generator-discriminator for unsupervised hypothesis generation vs ground-truth-supervised testing skills) plus distribution-level rather than instance-level feedback. Rigor is decent: HypoBench 13 tasks, 1:1 train/test task split, system-level (HypoGeniC, HypotheSAEs, POPPER, ReAct) and skill-level baselines, ablations (w/o Feedback, w/o Outcome), three runs with stds; but no significance tests, a single backbone (DeepSeek-V4-Flash), and a key circularity: the Q(H^t) evaluation metric is the same LLM discriminator score used as the training objective (Eq. 5/6 vs Eq. 8), inflating the headline generation result. Evidence is mixed: Hit@K 0.648±0.142 vs AI-Generated-Skill 0.579±0.022 and T_h 0.659±0.064 vs Human-Designed-Skill 0.612±0.096 have substantially overlapping error bars; testing-side E_h=0.984±0.000 for POPPER is suspicious. Generalizability is limited to tabular data-driven discovery within one benchmark (acknowledged in Discussion). Reproducibility is weakened by no code/artifact release and discriminator/prompts deferred to a supplement not present in the document.

primary_link.title: HypoForge: A Self-Improving Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Hypothesis Generation and Testing via Scientific Skill Learning

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled AI scientist systems to automate scientific discovery, yet existing approaches most rely on static prompting or fixed workflows and fail to accumulate experience for continual improvement. We propose HypoForge, an experience-guided multi-agent framework that learns reusable scientific skills for automated hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing. HypoForge is built on the observation that these two stages involve different supervision signals. For hy
radar.summary_zh: 現有AI科學家系統多依賴靜態提示或固定流程,無法累積經驗持續改進。本文提出HypoForge,一個透過科學技能學習實現自我改進的多代理框架。作者觀察到假說生成與假說測試的監督訊號本質不同,故設計兩種階段專屬的技能學習範式:假說生成缺乏顯式回饋,採對抗式生成器—判別器機制,以七個維度(經驗根據、因果合理性、可否證性等)進行分布層級的比較批判;假說測試則有可執行實驗與真值結果,據此從測試軌跡中蒸餾實驗設計與執行技能,全程無需微調基礎模型。在HypoBench的13個任務上(以DeepSeek-V4-Flash為骨幹),HypoForge的假說品質分數達0.785、Hit@K達0.648,Hit Rate分別超越HypoGeniC與HypotheSAEs達17.6%與44%;測試通過率0.659、執行成功率0.966,皆優於POPPER與ReAct。消融實驗證實判別器回饋與執行結果回饋缺一不可。限制包括技能改進仰賴回饋品質,且目前僅涵蓋可計算實驗驅動的資料科學發現。

links.title: Prefix-Denoising Consistency: Test-Time Verification for Diffusion Language Models

evidence: Abstract: PDC remasks the suffix after an exact prefix at keep rates rho in {0.1,0.5,0.9}, regenerates, and majority-votes over regenerated answers only, excluding the initial answer.
Section 3.2, Table 1: PDC is best or tied-best in all 15 model-dataset settings and beats the Init-selected baseline in 14, with gains up to +5.68 (LLaDA-1.5 GSM8K, L=256).

Section 3.3.1, Table 2: at L=128 PDC outperforms Init x4 in 13 of 15 pairs (e.g., LLaDA-1.5 GSM8K 65.88 vs 56.63) while using ~2.5T vs 4T denoising-step budget; ties one, loses one (CSQA LLaDA-1.5, -0.41).

Section 2.2, Theorem 2.2: improvement condition derived under a binary answer space and conditional independence of regenerations given the initial answer; assumptions are acknowledged as stylized but not empirically validated.

Appendix B, Table 4: correct-answer retention exceeds same-wrong persistence in most cells, but several negative deltas exist (e.g., SVAMP LLaDA-8B L=512 rho=0.1 delta=-3.8; SQA Dream-7B L=128 rho=0.9 delta=-0.9), qualifying the blanket Observation 2.1.
Appendix G, Table 11: at tau=1.0 PDC trails Init x4 on all three CSQA settings (-0.74 to -2.12 points) though it leads on 12 of 15 settings overall (+4.98 avg).

Appendix H: prompts, temperature (0.2 main, 1.0 robustness), length/step budgets, keep-rate tie-breaking, and SymPy-based answer equivalence are specified; model checkpoints are named (Dream-org/Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, GSAI-ML/LLaDA-1.5, GSAI-ML/LLaDA-8B-Instruct); no code or data release is stated.
Front matter: author affiliation/email pairings are inconsistent (e.g., Nagoya University author listed with an MBZUAI email), indicating metadata care issues.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: test-time verification (prefix-conditioned regeneration + majority vote) for diffusion LMs on math/commonsense reasoning, squarely matching high-weight LLM, reasoning/CoT, and test-time preferences. The core observation (correct answers more reproducible under regeneration than wrong ones) is a clean, DLM-specific signal, and the adaptation of prefix-consistency from the authors' AR companion work (Iwase et al.) to masked diffusion is moderately novel rather than groundbreaking. Experimental coverage is broad (3 DLMs x 5 benchmarks x 3 lengths, full-diffusion and semi-AR settings, temperature and unmasking ablations), and reporting is unusually honest (ties, one loss to Init x4, red-flagged negative deltas). Rigor is capped by: a stylized theory assuming conditional independence of regenerations (dubious at temperature 0.2), no significance testing for typically +1 to +2 point gains, Observation 2.1 stated without qualification despite several contradicted cells in Appendix Table 4, no explicit limitations section, and a cost comparison (2.5T vs 4T) that is conservative but not exactly matched. Evidence strength is solid for the full-diffusion claims but weakens at tau=1.0 on CSQA. Generalizability is limited to 7-8B diffusion LMs and QA-style tasks. Reproducibility details (prompts, keep rates, tie-breaking, extraction/equivalence rules) are thorough, but no code release is stated, and author affiliation/email metadata is inconsistent, a minor care flag.

primary_link.title: Prefix-Denoising Consistency: Test-Time Verification for Diffusion Language Models

radar.summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently become increasingly competitive with autoregressive (AR) models, and even outperform them on certain tasks. Unlike AR models, DLMs produce output through iterative denoising without a left-to-right order. To further improve the performance of DLMs, we introduce PDC (\emph{Prefix-Denoising Consistency}), a test-time self-verification method for DLMs. PDC exploits a distinctive test-time signal in DLMs under prefix conditioned regeneration, correct tr
radar.summary_zh: 擴散語言模型(DLM)以迭代去噪生成文字,常在低溫度下解碼,重複取樣多樣性低,使AR模型慣用的自我一致性難以直接套用。本文提出PDC(前綴去噪一致性):對初始輸出分別保留10%、50%、90%的前綴,遮罩其餘位置後重新去噪,再僅對三個重新生成的答案做多數投票(排除初始答案)。關鍵觀察是正確答案在再生成下更可重現(R+ > R-),作者以Bernoulli投票模型證明只要重現率差距存在,PDC即可超越初始答案。在Dream-7B、LLaDA-8B與LLaDA-1.5上,於GSM8K、MATH-500、SVAMP、CSQA與SQA五項任務,PDC在15個設定中全面達到最佳或並列最佳,相對初始樣本最多提升5.68個百分點;在L=128的計算受限比較中,13/15個設定勝過四次獨立生成的Init x4,最多領先9.25點。方法對不同解遮罩策略與τ=1.0高溫度解碼亦維持穩健,展現了DLM專屬的測試時間驗證原語之潛力。
radar.title: Prefix-Denoising Consistency: Test-Time Verification for Diffusion Language Models

links.title: The "Curse of Knowledge" in LLM Query Simulation: Concept Provenance for Tracing Answer-Side Intrusion

§5.2: strict precision 45.5% falls below pre-registered 50% threshold (weakened tier); relaxed precision 68.2%; high-specificity subset reaches 78.2%
